source.text: תִּקְע֨וּ שׁוֹפָ֜ר בְּצִיּ֗וֹן וְהָרִ֨יעוּ֙ בְּהַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֔י יִרְגְּז֕וּ כֹּ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־בָ֥א יוֹם־יְהוָ֖ה כִּ֥י קָרֽוֹב׃

records.literal_gloss: Blow a ram's horn in Zion, and sound an alarm on my holy mountain! Let tremble all [the] inhabitants of the land, for [is] coming [the] day of Yahweh, for near [it is].

en.L: Blow a trumpet in Zion; \q raise the alarm on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy mountain! \q Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, \q because the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} comes; it is near indeed.
en.B: Blow the ram's horn in Zion! \q Sound the battle alarm on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy mountain! \q Let everyone who lives in the land tremble, \q for the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is on its way; it is close at hand.
en.R: Blow the trumpet in Zion! \q Sound the alarm on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy mountain! \q Everyone who lives in the land should tremble with fear, \q because the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is coming. It is very near.

pt.L: Toquem o chifre de carneiro em Sião; \q deem o alarme no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} monte santo! \q Tremam todos os habitantes da terra, \q porque o dia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} vem; ele está perto, sim.
pt.B: Toquem o chifre de carneiro em Sião! \q Deem o toque de guerra no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} monte santo! \q Que tremam todos os que moram na terra, \q pois o dia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} está a caminho; ele está próximo.
pt.R: Toquem a trombeta em Sião! \q Deem o sinal de alarme no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} monte santo! \q Todos os que moram na terra devem tremer de medo, \q porque o dia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} está chegando. Ele está muito perto.

fr.L: Sonnez du cor dans Sion, \q donnez l’alarme sur {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} montagne sainte ! \q Que tous les habitants du pays tremblent, \q car le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} vient ; oui, il est proche.
fr.B: Sonnez du cor dans Sion ! \q Faites retentir l’alarme sur {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} montagne sainte ! \q Que tous ceux qui habitent le pays tremblent, \q car le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} approche ; il est tout près.
fr.R: Sonnez de la trompette à Sion ! \q Donnez l’alerte sur {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} montagne sainte ! \q Que tous les habitants du pays tremblent de peur, \q car le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} arrive. Il est tout proche.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} trompeta en Sion; \q {{plural_you:den|dad}} la alarma en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} monte santo! \q Tiemblen todos los habitantes de la tierra, \q porque viene el día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; ciertamente está cerca.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} el cuerno de carnero en Sion! \q ¡{{plural_you:Den|Dad}} el toque de guerra en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} monte santo! \q Que tiemble todo el que vive en el país, \q porque el día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ya viene; está a las puertas.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} la trompeta en Sion! \q ¡{{plural_you:Den|Dad}} la alarma en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} monte santo! \q Todos los que viven en el país deben temblar de miedo, \q porque el día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se acerca. Ya está muy cerca.

sw.L: Pigeni baragumu katika Sayuni; \q pigeni kelele ya hatari katika mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu! \q Wakaaji wote wa nchi na watetemeke, \q kwa maana siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inakuja; kwa kweli i karibu.
sw.B: Pigeni baragumu katika Sayuni! \q Pigeni kelele ya vita katika mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu! \q Wote wanaoishi katika nchi na watetemeke, \q kwa maana siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inakuja; imekaribia.
sw.R: Pigeni baragumu katika Sayuni! \q Toeni ishara ya hatari katika mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu! \q Kila mtu anayeishi katika nchi hii atetemeke kwa hofu, \q kwa sababu siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inakuja. Iko karibu sana.

vi.L: Hãy thổi kèn tại Si-ôn; \q hãy báo động trên núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! \q Hãy để mọi cư dân trong xứ run sợ, \q vì ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến; ngày ấy thật đã gần.
vi.B: Hãy thổi tù và tại Si-ôn! \q Hãy báo động trên núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! \q Hãy để mọi người sống trong xứ run rẩy, \q vì ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang đến; ngày ấy đã gần kề.
vi.R: Hãy thổi kèn tại Si-ôn! \q Hãy báo động trên núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! \q Mọi người sống trong xứ hãy run sợ, \q vì ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang đến. Ngày ấy đã gần lắm rồi.

ko.L: 시온에서 나팔을 불어라. \q 내 거룩한 산에서 경보를 울려라! \q 그 땅의 모든 주민은 떨어라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이 오기 때문이다. 참으로 그날이 가깝다.
ko.B: 시온에서 숫양 뿔 나팔을 불어라! \q 내 거룩한 산에서 전쟁 경보를 울려라! \q 그 땅에 사는 모든 사람은 떨어라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이 다가오고 있다. 그날이 바로 눈앞에 왔다.
ko.R: 시온에서 나팔을 불어라! \q 내 거룩한 산에서 위험을 알려라! \q 그 땅에 사는 사람은 모두 두려워 떨어야 한다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이 오고 있다. 그날이 아주 가까이 왔다.

am.L: በጽዮን መለከትን ንፉ፤ \q በተቀደሰው ተራራዬ ላይ የማስጠንቀቂያ ድምፅ አሰሙ! \q በምድሪቱ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ይንቀጥቀጡ፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀን ይመጣልና፤ በእርግጥ ቀርቧል።
am.B: በጽዮን የቀንድ መለከት ንፉ! \q በተቀደሰው ተራራዬ ላይ የጦርነት ማስጠንቀቂያ አሰሙ! \q በምድሪቱ የሚኖር ሁሉ ይንቀጥቀጥ፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀን እየመጣ ነውና፤ ደርሷል።
am.R: በጽዮን መለከት ንፉ! \q በተቀደሰው ተራራዬ ላይ የማስጠንቀቂያ ድምፅ አሰሙ! \q በምድሪቱ የሚኖር ሁሉ በፍርሃት ይንቀጥቀጥ፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀን እየመጣ ነውና። እጅግ ቀርቧል።

hi.L: सिय्योन में नरसिंगा फूँको; \q मेरे पवित्र पर्वत पर चेतावनी का शब्द करो! \q देश के सब निवासी काँप उठें, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दिन आ रहा है; वह सचमुच निकट है।
hi.B: सिय्योन में नरसिंगा फूँको! \q मेरे पवित्र पर्वत पर युद्ध की चेतावनी दो! \q देश के सब रहनेवाले काँप उठें, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दिन आ रहा है; वह निकट आ पहुँचा है।
hi.R: सिय्योन में नरसिंगा फूँको! \q मेरे पवित्र पर्वत पर ख़तरे की चेतावनी दो! \q देश के सब लोग डर से काँप उठें, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दिन आ रहा है। वह बहुत निकट है।

ru.L: Трубите в трубу на Сионе, \q поднимите тревогу на {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} святой горе! \q Пусть трепещут все жители земли, \q потому что идёт день {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, он поистине близок.
ru.B: Трубите в рог на Сионе! \q Бейте тревогу на {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} святой горе! \q Пусть трепещут все живущие в стране, \q потому что день {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} уже в пути, он совсем близко.
ru.R: Трубите в трубу на Сионе! \q Поднимите тревогу на {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} святой горе! \q Пусть все жители страны дрожат от страха, \q потому что день {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} приближается. Он уже совсем близко.

ja.L: シオンでラッパを吹け。 \q わたしの聖なる山で鬨の声を上げよ。 \q 地に住むすべての者はおののけ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の日が来るからだ。まことに、それは近い。
ja.B: シオンで角笛を吹き鳴らしなさい。 \q わたしの聖なる山で、戦いの警報を鳴らしなさい。 \q この地に住む者は皆、おののくがよい。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の日が迫っている。それは近づいている。
ja.R: シオンでラッパを吹きなさい！ \q わたしの聖なる山で、危険を知らせなさい！ \q この地に住む人は皆、恐れて震えるがよい。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の日が来るのだ。それはすぐそこまで来ている。

decisions.choice: the ram's horn and the alarm: the signal that an enemy is coming
decisions.reason: The ram's horn was blown, and a loud signal raised, to warn a city of attack and call it to arms (Numbers 10:9; Jeremiah 4:5; Hosea 5:8; Amos 3:6). The watchman on Zion is to sound it because an army is coming (verses 2-11).

decisions.choice: my holy mountain: the LORD speaks of Zion as his
decisions.reason: Zion, the hill of the temple in Jerusalem, is the LORD's holy mountain (Psalm 2:6; Isaiah 11:9; Joel 4:17). The "my" shows that the LORD gives the order, though the prophet goes on to speak of him in the third person.

decisions.choice: the day of the LORD is coming: now as an army against Zion
decisions.reason: The day announced in 1:15 now comes as an army that attacks Jerusalem itself (see the note at 1:15). The LORD leads it (verse 11).

decisions.choice: trumpet (L, R); ram's horn (B)
decisions.reason: The shofar, a ram's horn, follows the wording set in Isaiah when it stands alone: "trumpet" at Literal and Readable, "ram's horn" at Balanced. Balanced says "battle alarm" for the war signal.

decisions.choice: "cor" (L, B); "trompette" (R) for the ram's horn, "Sonnez du cor", for the whole of Joel
decisions.reason: The French prophets settled the shofar as "cor" at Literal and Balanced and "trompette" at Readable (Isaiah, Jeremiah). French Literal keeps "cor" where the English Literal says "trumpet", because "cor" names an animal horn and "trompette" a metal instrument.

decisions.choice: Joel's oracles are speech: present, future and passé composé at every level, never passé simple; only the narrative frame of 2:18-19 takes the passé simple at L and B and the passé composé at R
alternatives: passé simple for the past at L and B throughout
decisions.reason: As the other prophets in French: the prophet's poetry and God's words are spoken, not written narration; only the short report of the LORD's turning to his people is told as narrative.

decisions.choice: "trompeta" (L, R); "cuerno de carnero" (B)
decisions.reason: The shofar as the Spanish of Isaiah and Jeremiah has it, following the English choice at each level. Book-wide choice for Joel 2-4, Amos and Obadiah.

decisions.choice: "el día del SEÑOR" at every level; plural commands with plural_you
decisions.reason: The day of the LORD keeps one wording at every level, as Isaiah 13:6 in Spanish. The commands to the people (Blow, sound, gather) are plural in the Hebrew, so each takes a plural_you span through these books. Book-wide choice for Joel 2-4, Amos and Obadiah.

decisions.choice: "kèn" (L, R); "tù và" (B)
decisions.reason: The shofar follows the settled Vietnamese wording for Isaiah and Jeremiah (Jeremiah 4:5): "kèn" at Literal and Readable, "tù và" (ram's horn) at Balanced, matching the English trumpet / ram's horn split.

decisions.choice: "ngày của CHÚA" at every level, here and through Joel, Amos and Obadiah
decisions.reason: The day of the LORD keeps the published wording of Isaiah 13:6, 9 at every level, with the divine-name span on CHÚA only, so the phrase reads the same wherever the prophets use it.

decisions.choice: *shofar* is "나팔" (L, R) and "숫양 뿔 나팔" (B), through Joel, Amos and Obadiah
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for these books, as Jeremiah 4:5 and Ezekiel 33: the instrument was a ram's horn, which Balanced names; Literal and Readable say the familiar word, as the English "trumpet" does.

decisions.choice: God's first-person words in the oracles are 해라체 with "나" ("내 거룩한 산"); when the prophet speaks about God he gives him -시-, 께서 and "그분". No deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun spans have nothing to change in Korean (style guide 7); respect for God is carried by the honorific, and God never takes -시- in his own mouth. Recorded once for Joel, Amos and Obadiah.

decisions.choice: "baragumu" at every level
decisions.reason: The shofar is "baragumu" at every level, as in Isaiah and Jeremiah; the English varies trumpet / ram's horn, but "baragumu" is already the Swahili word for the horn. Recorded once for Joel, Amos and Obadiah.

decisions.choice: "siku ya BWANA" at every level, with the divine_name span on BWANA
decisions.reason: The day of the LORD keeps one wording in Joel, Amos and Obadiah, as Isaiah 13:6. Swahili marks most pronouns for God inside the verb, so it has fewer deity_pronoun spans than the English; they stand only on free pronouns such as "wangu" here. Mid-sentence, every free pronoun or possessive that means God takes the span, including "nami", "naye", "yeye" and "kwangu"; a word that opens a sentence is written plainly with its capital, and "naye" followed by a noun ("naye BWANA") is a conjunction with no span. This holds for Joel, Amos and Obadiah.

decisions.choice: o chifre de carneiro (L, B); a trombeta (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the ram's horn (m1) is "chifre de carneiro" at Literal and Balanced, naming the instrument as Exodus 19:13 and Jeremiah 4:5 do in Portuguese, and "trombeta" at Readable, where the English Readable says "trumpet". "Shofar" is known only to some readers, and "buzina" now means a car horn. The same holds in 2:15.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Joel 2.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns and verb forms for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: shofar as "መለከት" (L, R) and "የቀንድ መለከት" (B), here and in 2:15
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles list: Balanced names the ram's horn, as the English Balanced does; Literal and Readable say "trumpet", the common word.

decisions.choice: नरसिंगा at every level
decisions.reason: The shofar is नरसिंगा in Isaiah (18:3; 58:1) and the Psalms in this translation, at every level; Hindi needs no second word for it where the English varies "trumpet" and "ram's horn". Same in 2:15.

decisions.choice: труба (L, R); рог (B)
decisions.reason: The shofar as Jeremiah 4:5 in this translation: "труба" at Literal and Readable, the ram's horn "рог" at Balanced, following the English.

decisions.choice: shofar "ラッパ" (L, R), "角笛" (B), following the English per level as Hosea 8:1 and Amos 3:6; heria' "鬨の声を上げよ" (L, Hosea 5:8), "戦いの警報を鳴らしなさい" (B), "危険を知らせなさい" (R). The same forms return in 2:15.
decisions.reason: The English varies the word by level; the HOS and AMO notes follow it.

source.text: י֧וֹם חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וַאֲפֵלָ֗ה י֤וֹם עָנָן֙ וַעֲרָפֶ֔ל כְּשַׁ֖חַר פָּרֻ֣שׂ עַל־הֶֽהָרִ֑ים עַ֚ם רַ֣ב וְעָצ֔וּם כָּמֹ֗הוּ לֹ֤א נִֽהְיָה֙ מִן־הָ֣עוֹלָ֔ם וְאַֽחֲרָיו֙ לֹ֣א יוֹסֵ֔ף עַד־שְׁנֵ֖י דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: A day of darkness and gloom, a day of cloud and thick darkness! Like dawn spread over the mountains, a people great and mighty; like it there has not been from of old, and after it will not be again until [the] years of generation and generation.

en.L: A day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and thick darkness! \q Like dawn spread out on the mountains, \q a people great and mighty; \q its like has never been from of old, \q and after it there will not be again \q through the years of generation upon generation.
en.B: It is a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and deep darkness. \q Like the dawn spreading across the mountains \q comes a great and mighty people. \q Nothing like it has ever been before, \q and nothing like it will ever be again \q through all the generations to come.
en.R: It will be a dark and gloomy day, a day of black clouds. \q Like the first light of morning spreading across the mountains, \q a huge and powerful army is coming. \q There has never been anything like it before, \q and there will never be anything like it again, \q not for many, many years.

pt.L: Dia de trevas e escuridão, dia de nuvens e densas trevas! \q Como a aurora estendida sobre os montes, \q um povo grande e poderoso; \q semelhante a ele nunca houve desde a antiguidade, \q e depois dele não haverá outra vez \q pelos anos de geração em geração.
pt.B: É um dia de trevas e escuridão, um dia de nuvens e de escuridão profunda. \q Como a aurora que se espalha pelos montes, \q vem um povo grande e poderoso. \q Nunca houve nada igual antes, \q e nunca mais haverá \q por todas as gerações que virão.
pt.R: Vai ser um dia escuro e sombrio, um dia de nuvens negras. \q Como a primeira luz da manhã que se espalha pelos montes, \q vem chegando um exército enorme e poderoso. \q Nunca houve nada parecido antes, \q e nunca mais vai haver nada igual, \q por muitos e muitos anos.

fr.L: Un jour de ténèbres et d’obscurité, un jour de nuées et de brume épaisse ! \q Comme l’aurore étendue sur les montagnes, \q un peuple nombreux et puissant ; \q son pareil n’a jamais existé depuis les temps anciens, \q et après lui il n’y en aura plus \q jusqu’aux années de génération en génération.
fr.B: C’est un jour de ténèbres et d’obscurité, un jour de nuages et de nuit épaisse. \q Comme l’aube qui se répand sur les montagnes \q s’avance un peuple nombreux et puissant. \q Il n’y a jamais rien eu de pareil auparavant, \q et il n’y aura plus jamais rien de pareil \q au fil de toutes les générations à venir.
fr.R: Ce sera un jour sombre et triste, un jour de nuages noirs. \q Comme la première lumière du matin qui s’étend sur les montagnes, \q une armée immense et puissante arrive. \q On n’a jamais rien vu de pareil, \q et on ne verra plus jamais rien de pareil, \q même dans très, très longtemps.

es.L: ¡Día de tinieblas y de oscuridad, día de nubes y de densas tinieblas! \q Como la aurora extendida sobre los montes, \q un pueblo grande y poderoso; \q nunca hubo otro semejante desde antiguo, \q ni lo habrá después de él \q por los años de generación en generación.
es.B: Es un día de tinieblas y oscuridad, un día de nubes y negrura. \q Como el alba que se extiende por los montes \q llega un pueblo grande y poderoso. \q Nunca antes hubo nada semejante, \q ni lo habrá jamás \q por todas las generaciones venideras.
es.R: Será un día oscuro y sombrío, un día de nubes negras. \q Como la primera luz de la mañana que se extiende por los montes, \q se acerca un ejército enorme y poderoso. \q Nunca ha habido nada igual, \q y nunca volverá a haber nada igual, \q ni en muchísimos años.

sw.L: Siku ya giza na utusitusi, siku ya mawingu na giza nene! \q Kama mapambazuko yaliyotandazwa juu ya milima, \q [ndivyo walivyo] watu wengi na wenye nguvu; \q mfano wao haujawahi kuwako tangu zamani, \q wala baada yao hautakuwako tena \q hadi miaka ya kizazi baada ya kizazi.
sw.B: Ni siku ya giza na utusitusi, siku ya mawingu na giza nene. \q Kama mapambazuko yanavyotanda juu ya milima, \q ndivyo wanavyokuja watu wengi wenye nguvu. \q Hakujawahi kuwa na kitu kama hicho tangu zamani, \q wala hakutakuwa na kitu kama hicho tena \q katika vizazi vyote vijavyo.
sw.R: Itakuwa siku ya giza na huzuni, siku ya mawingu meusi. \q Kama mwanga wa kwanza wa asubuhi unavyoenea juu ya milima, \q ndivyo jeshi kubwa lenye nguvu linavyokuja. \q Hakujawahi kuwa na kitu kama hicho kamwe, \q wala hakutakuwa na kitu kama hicho tena, \q hata baada ya miaka mingi sana.

vi.L: Một ngày tối tăm và u ám, một ngày mây và mù mịt! \q Như rạng đông trải ra trên các núi, \q một dân đông đúc và hùng mạnh; \q như nó thì từ xưa chưa từng có, \q và sau nó sẽ không còn có nữa \q cho đến những năm của các thế hệ nối tiếp nhau.
vi.B: Đó là một ngày tối tăm và u ám, một ngày mây đen và tối mịt. \q Như bình minh trải khắp các núi, \q một dân đông đúc và hùng mạnh kéo đến. \q Trước nay chưa từng có điều gì như vậy, \q và về sau cũng sẽ không bao giờ có nữa \q dù trải qua bao nhiêu thế hệ.
vi.R: Đó sẽ là một ngày tối tăm và ảm đạm, một ngày đầy mây đen. \q Như ánh sáng đầu tiên của buổi sáng trải khắp các núi, \q một đạo quân đông đảo và mạnh mẽ đang kéo đến. \q Trước đây chưa từng có điều gì giống như vậy, \q và sau này cũng sẽ không bao giờ có lại, \q dù qua rất nhiều năm tháng.

ko.L: 어둠과 캄캄함의 날, 구름과 짙은 어둠의 날이다! \q 산들 위에 퍼진 새벽빛처럼 \q 크고 강한 백성이 [온다]. \q 그와 같은 것이 옛날부터 없었고, \q 그 뒤에도 다시 없을 것이다. \q 대대로 이어지는 해들에 이르기까지.
ko.B: 그날은 어둡고 캄캄한 날, 구름이 끼고 짙은 어둠이 덮인 날이다. \q 새벽빛이 산들 위로 퍼지듯 \q 크고 강한 백성이 몰려온다. \q 이런 일은 예전에 없었고, \q 앞으로도 다시 없을 것이다. \q 오고 오는 모든 세대에 이르기까지 없을 것이다.
ko.R: 그날은 어둡고 캄캄한 날, 시커먼 구름이 덮인 날이 될 것이다. \q 아침 햇살이 산들 위로 퍼져 나가듯 \q 크고 힘센 군대가 몰려온다. \q 이런 일은 전에 한 번도 없었고, \q 앞으로도 다시는 없을 것이다. \q 아주아주 오랜 세월이 지나도 없을 것이다.

am.L: የጨለማና የጽልመት ቀን፣ የደመናና የድቅድቅ ጨለማ ቀን! \q በተራሮች ላይ እንደ ተዘረጋ ንጋት \q ታላቅና ብርቱ ሕዝብ [ይመጣል]፤ \q ከጥንት ጀምሮ እንደ እርሱ ያለ አልነበረም፤ \q ከእርሱም በኋላ ዳግመኛ አይሆንም፤ \q እስከ ትውልድ ትውልድ ዓመታት ድረስ።
am.B: የጨለማና የጽልመት ቀን፣ የደመናና የድቅድቅ ጨለማ ቀን ነው። \q በተራሮች ላይ እንደሚዘረጋ ንጋት \q ታላቅና ብርቱ ሕዝብ ይመጣል። \q ከዚህ በፊት እንደ እርሱ ያለ ፈጽሞ አልነበረም፤ \q ከእርሱም በኋላ እንደ እርሱ ያለ ዳግመኛ አይኖርም፤ \q በሚመጡት ትውልዶች ሁሉ።
am.R: ጨለማና ጭጋጋማ ቀን፣ ጥቁር ደመና የሞላበት ቀን ይሆናል። \q በተራሮች ላይ እንደሚዘረጋ የማለዳ ብርሃን \q ታላቅና ብርቱ ሠራዊት እየመጣ ነው። \q ከዚህ በፊት እንደ እርሱ ያለ ፈጽሞ አልነበረም፤ \q ወደ ፊትም እንደ እርሱ ያለ ፈጽሞ አይኖርም፤ \q ለብዙ ብዙ ዓመታት።

hi.L: अंधकार और उदासी का दिन, बादलों और घोर अंधकार का दिन! \q पहाड़ों पर फैली भोर के समान, \q एक बड़ी और सामर्थी जाति; \q उसके समान प्राचीन काल से कभी नहीं हुआ, \q और उसके बाद फिर न होगा, \q पीढ़ी पर पीढ़ी के वर्षों तक।
hi.B: वह अंधकार और उदासी का दिन है, बादलों और घने अंधकार का दिन। \q जैसे भोर का उजाला पहाड़ों पर फैलता है, \q वैसे ही एक विशाल और शक्तिशाली दल आता है। \q उसके जैसा पहले कभी नहीं हुआ, \q और न फिर कभी होगा, \q आनेवाली सब पीढ़ियों तक।
hi.R: वह अंधेरा और उदासी भरा दिन होगा, काले बादलों का दिन। \q जैसे सुबह की पहली रोशनी पहाड़ों पर फैलती है, \q वैसे ही एक विशाल और शक्तिशाली सेना आ रही है। \q उसके जैसा पहले कभी कुछ नहीं हुआ, \q और न फिर कभी होगा, \q बहुत-बहुत वर्षों तक नहीं।

ru.L: День тьмы и мрака, день облака и густой тьмы! \q Как заря, разлитая по горам, \q народ многочисленный и сильный; \q подобного ему не бывало от века \q и после него не будет \q до лет из рода в род.
ru.B: Это день тьмы и мрака, день туч и густой тьмы. \q Как заря, что разливается по горам, \q идёт народ великий и могучий. \q Подобного ему никогда не бывало \q и никогда больше не будет \q во всех грядущих поколениях.
ru.R: Это будет тёмный и мрачный день, день чёрных туч. \q Как первый утренний свет разливается по горам, \q так идёт огромное и сильное войско. \q Никогда не было ничего подобного \q и никогда больше не будет, \q ещё очень-очень долго.

ja.L: 闇と暗黒の日、雲と密雲の日だ！ \q 山々の上に広がる暁のように、 \q 大いなる強い民が[来る]。 \q このようなものは昔から一度もなく、 \q この後も再びない、 \q 代々の年に至るまで。
ja.B: それは闇と暗黒の日、雲と深い闇の日だ。 \q 夜明けの光が山々に広がるように、 \q 大いなる強い民がやって来る。 \q このようなことは、昔から一度もなかった。 \q これから後にも、決してないだろう。 \q 世々代々に至るまで。
ja.R: それは暗く陰気な日、黒い雲におおわれた日になる。 \q 朝の最初の光が山々に広がるように、 \q 大きくて強い軍隊がやって来る。 \q こんなことは、これまで一度もなかった。 \q これからも、決して起こらない。 \q 何年たっても、ずっと起こらない。

decisions.choice: darkness and gloom, cloud and thick darkness: the darkness of the LORD's coming
decisions.reason: The same four words describe the day of the LORD in Zephaniah 1:15, and cloud and thick darkness surrounded the LORD on Sinai (Deuteronomy 4:11; 5:22). A swarm of locusts darkened the land of Egypt (Exodus 10:15). The darkness here is both: the swarm that blots out the sun, and the day of the LORD it announces.

decisions.choice: like dawn spread over the mountains: the army spreads as fast and far as the first light
alternatives: like blackness spread over the mountains
decisions.reason: The army covers the hills as quickly and widely as dawn spreads across them. Some read a word with almost the same letters, "blackness", which would match the darkness of the first line, but the Hebrew has "dawn".

decisions.choice: nothing like it before or after: as the locusts of Egypt
decisions.reason: Exodus 10:14 says of the locust plague in Egypt that there had never been such a swarm before, nor would there be again. Joel uses the same kind of words for the army now coming.

decisions.choice: a great and mighty people: the locust army, as in 1:6
decisions.reason: As in 1:6, the swarm is called a "people" and described as an army. In verse 11 it is named as the LORD's own army, and in 2:25 he calls the locusts "my great army".

decisions.choice: army (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "army" for "people", which is the picture the verses develop (m4).

decisions.choice: "ከጥንት ጀምሮ እንደ እርሱ ያለ አልነበረም፤ ከእርሱም በኋላ ዳግመኛ አይሆንም" (L), close to Exodus 10:14
decisions.reason: The line recalls the locusts of Egypt (the meaning decision); Literal keeps the shape of Exodus 10:14 on main ("ከእርሱ በፊት እንደ እርሱ ያለ ... አልነበረም፤ ከእርሱም በኋላ ...") so the echo can be heard.

decisions.choice: जाति (L); दल (B); सेना (R)
decisions.reason: The "people" is the locust army (meaning decision m4). Literal says जाति as in 1:6; Balanced says दल, a host on the move, avoiding जाति (also "caste"); Readable says सेना, as the English Readable says "army".

decisions.choice: войско
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, the people is called an army, the locust swarm of 1:6.

decisions.choice: R "軍隊" for 'am, as the English R "army"; L, B "民".
decisions.reason: The people is the locust army (m4).

source.text: לְפָנָיו֙ אָ֣כְלָה אֵ֔שׁ וְאַחֲרָ֖יו תְּלַהֵ֣ט לֶֽהָבָ֑ה כְּגַן־עֵ֨דֶן הָאָ֜רֶץ לְפָנָ֗יו וְאַֽחֲרָיו֙ מִדְבַּ֣ר שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְגַם־פְּלֵיטָ֖ה לֹא־הָ֥יְתָה לּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Before it fire consumes, and after it a flame sets ablaze; like [the] garden of Eden [is] the land before it, and after it a wilderness of desolation; and also escape there is none from it.

en.L: Before it fire devours, \q and behind it a flame burns; \q like the garden of Eden [is] the land before it, and behind it a desolate wilderness, \q and nothing at all escapes it.
en.B: Fire devours in front of them, \q and behind them a flame blazes. \q Ahead of them the land is like the garden of Eden; behind them it is a desolate wilderness; \q nothing escapes them.
en.R: In front of them a fire destroys everything. \q Behind them flames burn everything up. \q Before they come, the land looks like the garden of Eden. After they pass, it is an empty desert. \q Nothing escapes them.

pt.L: Diante dele o fogo devora, \q e atrás dele uma chama queima; \q como o jardim do Éden [é] a terra diante dele, e atrás dele, um deserto desolado, \q e nada lhe escapa.
pt.B: Diante deles o fogo devora, \q e atrás deles uma chama arde. \q À frente deles a terra é como o jardim do Éden; atrás deles, é um deserto desolado; \q nada escapa deles.
pt.R: Na frente deles, um fogo destrói tudo. \q Atrás deles, as chamas queimam tudo. \q Antes de eles chegarem, a terra parece o jardim do Éden. Depois que eles passam, é um deserto vazio. \q Nada escapa deles.

fr.L: Devant lui un feu dévore, \q et derrière lui une flamme brûle ; \q comme le jardin d’Éden [est] le pays devant lui, et derrière lui un désert désolé, \q et rien ne lui échappe.
fr.B: Devant eux, un feu dévore, \q et derrière eux, une flamme embrase tout. \q Devant eux, le pays est comme le jardin d’Éden ; derrière eux, c’est un désert dévasté ; \q rien ne leur échappe.
fr.R: Devant eux, un feu détruit tout. \q Derrière eux, des flammes brûlent tout. \q Avant leur arrivée, le pays ressemble au jardin d’Éden. Après leur passage, c’est un désert vide. \q Rien ne leur échappe.

es.L: Delante de él consume el fuego, \q y detrás de él arde la llama; \q como el jardín del Edén [es] la tierra delante de él, y detrás de él, un desierto desolado, \q y nada en absoluto escapa de él.
es.B: Delante de ellos el fuego devora, \q y detrás de ellos arde una llama. \q Ante ellos la tierra es como el jardín del Edén; detrás de ellos queda un desierto desolado; \q nada se les escapa.
es.R: Delante de ellos un fuego lo destruye todo. \q Detrás de ellos las llamas lo queman todo. \q Antes de que lleguen, la tierra parece el jardín del Edén. Cuando han pasado, es un desierto vacío. \q Nada se les escapa.

sw.L: Mbele yake moto unateketeza, \q na nyuma yake mwali unawaka; \q nchi [ni] kama bustani ya Edeni mbele yake, na nyuma yake jangwa la ukiwa, \q wala hakuna kitu kinachoponyoka kutoka kwake.
sw.B: Moto unateketeza mbele yao, \q na nyuma yao mwali unawaka. \q Mbele yao nchi ni kama bustani ya Edeni; nyuma yao ni jangwa tupu; \q hakuna kinachowaponyoka.
sw.R: Mbele yao moto unaharibu kila kitu. \q Nyuma yao miali ya moto inateketeza kila kitu. \q Kabla hawajafika, nchi inaonekana kama bustani ya Edeni. Baada ya kupita, ni jangwa tupu. \q Hakuna kinachowaponyoka.

vi.L: Trước nó lửa thiêu nuốt, \q và sau nó ngọn lửa cháy rực; \q đất trước nó [giống] như vườn Ê-đen, còn sau nó là một hoang mạc tiêu điều, \q và chẳng có gì thoát khỏi nó.
vi.B: Phía trước chúng lửa thiêu nuốt, \q phía sau chúng ngọn lửa bừng cháy. \q Trước mặt chúng, đất như vườn Ê-đen; sau lưng chúng, đất thành hoang mạc tiêu điều; \q không gì thoát khỏi chúng.
vi.R: Phía trước chúng, lửa thiêu hủy mọi thứ. \q Phía sau chúng, ngọn lửa đốt cháy tất cả. \q Trước khi chúng đến, đất trông như vườn Ê-đen. Sau khi chúng đi qua, đất chỉ còn là sa mạc trống trơn. \q Không gì thoát khỏi chúng.

ko.L: 그 앞에서는 불이 삼키고, \q 그 뒤에서는 불꽃이 탄다. \q 그 앞의 땅은 에덴동산 같고, 그 뒤는 황폐한 광야이니, \q 그것에게서 피하는 것이 하나도 없다.
ko.B: 그들 앞에서는 불이 삼키고, \q 그들 뒤에서는 불꽃이 타오른다. \q 그들 앞의 땅은 에덴동산 같으나, 그들이 지나간 뒤에는 황폐한 광야가 된다. \q 그들에게서 벗어나는 것은 아무것도 없다.
ko.R: 그들 앞에서는 불이 모든 것을 태워 버린다. \q 그들 뒤에서는 불꽃이 모든 것을 살라 버린다. \q 그들이 오기 전에는 땅이 에덴동산 같았으나, 그들이 지나간 뒤에는 텅 빈 사막이 된다. \q 그들을 피할 수 있는 것은 아무것도 없다.

am.L: በፊቱ እሳት ይበላል፤ \q በኋላውም ነበልባል ያቃጥላል፤ \q ምድሪቱ በፊቱ እንደ ኤደን የአትክልት ስፍራ [ናት]፤ በኋላው ግን ባድማ ምድረ በዳ [ናት]፤ \q ከእርሱም ምንም የሚያመልጥ የለም።
am.B: በፊታቸው እሳት ይበላል፤ \q በኋላቸውም ነበልባል ይንቀለቀላል። \q ከፊታቸው ያለችው ምድር እንደ ኤደን የአትክልት ስፍራ ናት፤ ከኋላቸው ግን ባድማ ምድረ በዳ ትሆናለች፤ \q ከእነርሱ የሚያመልጥ ምንም የለም።
am.R: ከፊታቸው እሳት ሁሉን ያጠፋል። \q ከኋላቸው ነበልባል ሁሉን ያቃጥላል። \q ከመምጣታቸው በፊት ምድሪቱ እንደ ኤደን የአትክልት ቦታ ትመስላለች። ካለፉ በኋላ ግን ባዶ በረሃ ትሆናለች። \q ከእነርሱ የሚያመልጥ ምንም የለም።

hi.L: उसके आगे आग भस्म करती है, \q और उसके पीछे लौ जलाती है; \q उसके आगे देश अदन के बाग़ के समान [है], और उसके पीछे उजाड़ निर्जन प्रदेश, \q और उससे कुछ भी नहीं बचता।
hi.B: उनके आगे आग सब कुछ भस्म करती है, \q और उनके पीछे लपटें धधकती हैं। \q उनके आगे देश अदन के बाग़ जैसा है; उनके पीछे वह उजाड़ निर्जन प्रदेश है; \q उनसे कुछ नहीं बचता।
hi.R: उनके आगे-आगे आग सब कुछ नष्ट करती है। \q उनके पीछे लपटें सब कुछ जला देती हैं। \q उनके आने से पहले देश अदन के बाग़ जैसा दिखता है। उनके जाने के बाद वह सूना रेगिस्तान बन जाता है। \q उनसे कुछ भी नहीं बचता।

ru.L: Перед ним пожирает огонь, \q и позади него палит пламя; \q как сад Эдемский — земля перед ним, а позади него — пустыня опустошённая, \q и нет от него спасения.
ru.B: Перед ними всё пожирает огонь, \q а позади них пылает пламя. \q Впереди них земля как Эдемский сад, а позади — опустошённая пустыня, \q и ничто от них не спасётся.
ru.R: Перед ними огонь уничтожает всё. \q Позади них всё сжигает пламя. \q До их прихода земля похожа на Эдемский сад. А когда они пройдут, остаётся пустая пустыня. \q Ничто не может от них спастись.

ja.L: その前を火が焼き尽くし、 \q その後ろを炎が燃やす。 \q その前では地はエデンの園のようであり、その後ろでは荒れ果てた荒野となる。 \q まことに、それから逃れるものはない。
ja.B: 彼らの前では火が焼き尽くし、 \q その後ろでは炎が燃え上がる。 \q 彼らが来る前、地はエデンの園のようだが、過ぎた後は荒れ果てた荒野となる。 \q 彼らから逃れられるものは何もない。
ja.R: 彼らの前では、火がすべてを焼き尽くす。 \q 彼らの後ろでは、炎がすべてを燃やしてしまう。 \q 彼らが来る前、その地はエデンの園のように見える。彼らが通り過ぎた後は、何もない荒れ地になる。 \q 彼らから逃れられるものは何もない。

decisions.choice: like the garden of Eden: the promise of Eden turned around
decisions.reason: Eden is the garden God planted (Genesis 2:8-15). The prophets promise that the ruined land will become like Eden (Isaiah 51:3; Ezekiel 36:35). Here the picture is reversed: a land like Eden is left a desert.

decisions.choice: fire and flame: the swarm destroys like fire
decisions.reason: The army leaves the land as bare as if a fire had swept it, as the drought did in 1:19-20. A swarm of locusts can strip a region as completely as fire.

decisions.choice: escape: none escapes it
decisions.reason: The word means what escapes or survives. The same word returns in 3:5, where those who call on the LORD's name escape on Mount Zion.

decisions.choice: them (B, R); it (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of the army as "it", one people. Balanced and Readable say "they" and "them", which is natural English for an army or a swarm.

decisions.choice: "nó" (L); "chúng" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of the locust army as "it"; Literal keeps "nó", while Balanced and Readable use "chúng", the pronoun the oracles use for enemies and for a swarm, as the English moves to "them".

decisions.choice: अदन का बाग़; वह (L), वे (B, R)
decisions.reason: The garden of Eden keeps the words of Genesis 2 in this translation. Literal keeps the Hebrew "it" for the army; Balanced and Readable say "they", as the English does.

decisions.choice: сад Эдемский (L); Эдемский сад (B, R)
decisions.reason: Eden by name, as Genesis in this translation, so that the reversal of the garden is heard.

decisions.choice: The army as "その" (L, singular as the Hebrew) and "彼ら" (B, R), as the English it / them.
decisions.reason: Follows the English per level.

source.text: כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה סוּסִ֖ים מַרְאֵ֑הוּ וּכְפָרָשִׁ֖ים כֵּ֥ן יְרוּצֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: Like [the] appearance of horses [is] its appearance, and like war horses, so they run.

en.L: Its appearance [is] like the appearance of horses, \q and like war horses, so they run.
en.B: They look like horses; \q like war horses they charge.
en.R: They look like horses, \q and they run like horses charging into battle.

pt.L: Como a aparência de cavalos [é] a sua aparência, \q e como cavalos de guerra, assim eles correm.
pt.B: Eles parecem cavalos; \q como cavalos de guerra, avançam a galope.
pt.R: Eles parecem cavalos \q e correm como cavalos que avançam para a batalha.

fr.L: Son aspect [est] comme l’aspect de chevaux, \q et comme des chevaux de guerre, ainsi ils courent.
fr.B: Ils ont l’allure de chevaux ; \q ils foncent comme des chevaux de guerre.
fr.R: Ils ressemblent à des chevaux, \q et ils courent comme des chevaux qui partent au combat.

es.L: Su aspecto [es] como el aspecto de caballos, \q y como corceles de guerra, así corren.
es.B: Parecen caballos; \q como caballos de guerra se lanzan al galope.
es.R: Parecen caballos, \q y corren como caballos que se lanzan a la batalla.

sw.L: Sura yake [ni] kama sura ya farasi, \q na kama farasi wa vita, ndivyo wanavyokimbia.
sw.B: Wanaonekana kama farasi; \q wanashambulia kama farasi wa vita.
sw.R: Wanaonekana kama farasi, \q nao wanakimbia kama farasi wanaokwenda vitani kwa kasi.

vi.L: Hình dạng nó như hình dạng của ngựa, \q và như ngựa chiến, chúng chạy như vậy.
vi.B: Chúng trông như ngựa; \q chúng xông tới như ngựa chiến.
vi.R: Chúng trông giống như ngựa, \q và chúng chạy như ngựa đang lao vào trận.

ko.L: 그 모습은 말들의 모습 같고, \q 군마들처럼 그렇게 달린다.
ko.B: 그들은 말처럼 생겼고, \q 군마처럼 내달린다.
ko.R: 그들은 말처럼 생겼다. \q 전쟁터로 달려가는 말처럼 달린다.

am.L: መልኩ እንደ ፈረሶች መልክ [ነው]፤ \q እንደ ጦር ፈረሶችም እንዲሁ ይሮጣሉ።
am.B: ፈረሶችን ይመስላሉ፤ \q እንደ ጦር ፈረሶችም ይገሰግሳሉ።
am.R: ፈረሶችን ይመስላሉ፤ \q ወደ ጦርነት እንደሚገሰግሱ ፈረሶችም ይሮጣሉ።

hi.L: उसका रूप घोड़ों के रूप के समान [है], \q और युद्ध के घोड़ों के समान वे दौड़ते हैं।
hi.B: वे घोड़ों जैसे दिखते हैं; \q युद्ध के घोड़ों की तरह वे धावा बोलते हैं।
hi.R: वे घोड़ों जैसे दिखते हैं, \q और युद्ध में धावा बोलते घोड़ों की तरह दौड़ते हैं।

ru.L: Вид его — как вид коней, \q и как боевые кони, так бегут они.
ru.B: Они похожи на коней, \q несутся, как боевые кони.
ru.R: Они похожи на коней \q и бегут, как кони, которые мчатся в бой.

ja.L: その姿は馬の姿のようで、 \q 軍馬のように、そのように彼らは走る。
ja.B: 彼らは馬のように見え、 \q 軍馬のように突進する。
ja.R: 彼らは馬のように見え、 \q 戦いに向かって走る馬のように走る。

decisions.choice: like horses: the head of a locust looks like a horse's head
decisions.reason: The resemblance between a locust's head and a horse's is often noticed. Revelation 9:7 takes up the picture: "the locusts were like horses prepared for battle."

decisions.choice: war horses: horses trained for battle
decisions.reason: The word can mean horsemen or the horses they ride. Next to "horses" it is most likely the swift horses of the cavalry.

decisions.choice: They look like horses (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "they look like" for "its appearance [is] like the appearance of".

source.text: כְּק֣וֹל מַרְכָּב֗וֹת עַל־רָאשֵׁ֤י הֶֽהָרִים֙ יְרַקֵּד֔וּן כְּקוֹל֙ לַ֣הַב אֵ֔שׁ אֹכְלָ֖ה קָ֑שׁ כְּעַ֣ם עָצ֔וּם עֱר֖וּךְ מִלְחָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Like [the] sound of chariots on [the] tops of the mountains they leap, like [the] sound of a flame of fire consuming stubble, like a people mighty, arrayed for battle.

en.L: Like the sound of chariots on the tops of the mountains they leap, \q like the sound of a flame of fire devouring stubble, \q like a mighty people drawn up for battle.
en.B: With a noise like chariots they leap over the mountaintops, \q like the crackling of a blazing fire that burns up stubble, \q like a mighty army lined up for battle.
en.R: They leap over the mountaintops with a noise like rumbling chariots. \q They sound like a fire roaring through dry stalks. \q They are like a strong army ready for battle.

pt.L: Como o som de carros sobre os cumes dos montes eles saltam, \q como o som de uma chama de fogo que devora a palha, \q como um povo poderoso posto em ordem para a batalha.
pt.B: Com um barulho de carros de guerra, eles saltam sobre os topos dos montes, \q como o crepitar de um fogo ardente que queima a palha, \q como um exército poderoso em formação de batalha.
pt.R: Eles saltam sobre os topos dos montes com um barulho de carros de guerra. \q O som deles é como o de um fogo que avança sobre a palha seca. \q São como um exército forte, pronto para a batalha.

fr.L: Comme le bruit de chars sur les sommets des montagnes ils bondissent, \q comme le bruit d’une flamme de feu qui dévore le chaume, \q comme un peuple puissant rangé pour le combat.
fr.B: Avec un bruit de chars, ils bondissent sur le sommet des montagnes, \q comme le crépitement d’un feu ardent qui consume le chaume, \q comme une armée puissante rangée pour la bataille.
fr.R: Ils sautent sur le sommet des montagnes avec un bruit de chars qui grondent. \q On dirait le bruit d’un feu qui dévore la paille sèche. \q Ils sont comme une armée forte, prête pour la bataille.

es.L: Como estruendo de carros sobre las cumbres de los montes saltan, \q como el crepitar de una llama de fuego que consume el rastrojo, \q como un pueblo poderoso dispuesto para la batalla.
es.B: Con un estrépito como de carros saltan por las cumbres de los montes, \q como el chasquido de un fuego ardiente que devora el rastrojo, \q como un ejército poderoso formado para la batalla.
es.R: Saltan sobre las cumbres de los montes con un ruido como de carros que retumban. \q Suenan como un fuego que arrasa los tallos secos. \q Son como un ejército fuerte, listo para la batalla.

sw.L: Kama sauti ya magari ya vita juu ya vilele vya milima wanarukaruka, \q kama sauti ya mwali wa moto unaoteketeza mabua, \q kama watu wenye nguvu waliojipanga kwa vita.
sw.B: Kwa kishindo kama cha magari ya vita wanarukaruka juu ya vilele vya milima, \q kama mlio wa moto unaowaka na kuteketeza mabua, \q kama jeshi lenye nguvu lililojipanga kwa vita.
sw.R: Wanarukaruka juu ya vilele vya milima kwa kelele kama ya magari ya vita yanayonguruma. \q Sauti yao ni kama ya moto unaowaka katika mabua makavu. \q Wao ni kama jeshi lenye nguvu lililo tayari kwa vita.

vi.L: Như tiếng xe chiến mã trên các đỉnh núi, chúng nhảy vọt, \q như tiếng ngọn lửa thiêu nuốt rơm rạ, \q như một dân hùng mạnh dàn trận để chiến đấu.
vi.B: Với tiếng ầm ầm như xe chiến mã, chúng nhảy vọt qua các đỉnh núi, \q như tiếng lửa cháy lách tách thiêu rụi rơm rạ, \q như một đạo quân hùng mạnh dàn trận.
vi.R: Chúng nhảy qua các đỉnh núi với tiếng ầm ầm như xe chiến mã. \q Tiếng của chúng như tiếng lửa cháy rần rật trong đám rơm khô. \q Chúng như một đạo quân mạnh mẽ sẵn sàng ra trận.

ko.L: 산들의 꼭대기에서 병거들의 소리처럼 그들이 뛰고, \q 그루터기를 삼키는 불꽃의 소리처럼, \q 전투 대형을 갖춘 강한 백성처럼 [뛴다].
ko.B: 그들은 병거들이 덜컹거리는 소리를 내며 산꼭대기를 뛰어넘는다. \q 그루터기를 태우는 맹렬한 불길이 타닥거리는 소리 같고, \q 전투 대형을 갖춘 강한 군대 같다.
ko.R: 그들은 병거가 우르릉거리는 소리를 내며 산꼭대기를 뛰어넘는다. \q 그 소리는 마른 줄기를 태우며 번지는 불길 소리 같다. \q 그들은 싸울 준비가 된 강한 군대 같다.

am.L: በተራሮች ራሶች ላይ እንደ ሰረገሎች ድምፅ ይዘልላሉ፤ \q ገለባን እንደሚበላ የእሳት ነበልባል ድምፅ፣ \q ለጦርነት እንደ ተሰለፈ ብርቱ ሕዝብ።
am.B: እንደ ሰረገሎች ባለ ድምፅ በተራሮች ጫፎች ላይ ይዘልላሉ፤ \q ገለባን እንደሚያቃጥል የሚንቀለቀል እሳት ድምፅ፣ \q ለጦርነት እንደ ተሰለፈ ብርቱ ሠራዊት።
am.R: እንደሚንጓጓ ሰረገላ ባለ ድምፅ በተራሮች ጫፎች ላይ ይዘልላሉ። \q ድምፃቸው ደረቅ ገለባን እንደሚያቃጥል እሳት ነው። \q ለጦርነት እንደ ተዘጋጀ ብርቱ ሠራዊት ናቸው።

hi.L: पहाड़ों की चोटियों पर रथों के शब्द के समान वे उछलते हैं, \q भूसे को भस्म करती आग की लौ के शब्द के समान, \q युद्ध के लिए पाँति बाँधे सामर्थी जाति के समान।
hi.B: रथों के-से शोर के साथ वे पहाड़ों की चोटियों पर उछलते हैं, \q ठूँठों को जलाती धधकती आग की चटचटाहट के समान, \q युद्ध के लिए पंक्ति बाँधे शक्तिशाली सेना के समान।
hi.R: वे गड़गड़ाते रथों के-से शोर के साथ पहाड़ों की चोटियों पर उछलते हैं। \q उनकी आवाज़ सूखे डंठलों में भड़कती आग जैसी है। \q वे युद्ध के लिए तैयार शक्तिशाली सेना जैसे हैं।

ru.L: Как с грохотом колесниц по вершинам гор скачут они, \q как треск пламени огня, пожирающего солому, \q как народ сильный, выстроенный для битвы.
ru.B: С грохотом, как колесницы, скачут они по вершинам гор, \q с треском, как пламя, пожирающее солому, \q как могучее войско, выстроенное для битвы.
ru.R: Они скачут по вершинам гор с грохотом, как колесницы. \q Они шумят, как огонь, который бежит по сухой соломе. \q Они как сильное войско, готовое к битве.

ja.L: 山々の頂の上で、戦車の響きのように彼らは跳びはねる。 \q 刈り株を焼き尽くす火の炎の響きのように、 \q 戦いのために整列した強い民のように。
ja.B: 戦車のようなとどろきを立てて、彼らは山々の頂を跳び越える。 \q 刈り株を焼き尽くす燃え盛る火のはぜる音のように。 \q 戦いに備えて並んだ強い軍勢のように。
ja.R: 彼らは、戦車が鳴り響くような音を立てて、山々の頂を跳び越える。 \q その音は、乾いた茎を焼いていく火のごう音のようだ。 \q 彼らは、戦いの準備ができた強い軍隊のようだ。

decisions.choice: the sound of chariots: the roar of a swarm on the move
decisions.reason: A great swarm of locusts makes a loud roaring and crackling sound that can be heard from far away. Revelation 9:9 says of its locusts that the noise of their wings was like the noise of many chariots rushing into battle.

decisions.choice: stubble: dry stalks left in the field
decisions.reason: Stubble burns fast and loudly. It is used for what fire consumes in an instant (Isaiah 5:24; Obadiah 18).

decisions.choice: army (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "army" for "people", as Readable does in verse 2.

source.text: מִפָּנָ֖יו יָחִ֣ילוּ עַמִּ֑ים כָּל־פָּנִ֖ים קִבְּצ֥וּ פָארֽוּר׃

records.literal_gloss: Before it are in anguish peoples; all faces gather a glow.

en.L: Before it peoples writhe in anguish; \q all faces grow pale.
en.B: At the sight of them nations writhe in anguish; \q every face turns pale.
en.R: When the people of the nations see them, they shake with fear. \q Every face turns pale.

pt.L: Diante dele os povos se contorcem de angústia; \q todos os rostos empalidecem.
pt.B: Ao vê-los, as nações se contorcem de angústia; \q todos os rostos ficam pálidos.
pt.R: Quando os povos das nações os veem, tremem de medo. \q Todos os rostos ficam pálidos.

fr.L: Devant lui les peuples se tordent de douleur ; \q tous les visages pâlissent.
fr.B: À leur vue, les nations se tordent d’angoisse ; \q tous les visages blêmissent.
fr.R: Quand les gens des nations les voient, ils tremblent de peur. \q Tous les visages deviennent pâles.

es.L: Delante de él se angustian los pueblos; \q todos los rostros palidecen.
es.B: Al verlos, las naciones se retuercen de angustia; \q todo rostro palidece.
es.R: Cuando la gente de las naciones los ve, tiembla de miedo. \q Todas las caras se ponen pálidas.

sw.L: Mbele yake mataifa yanagaagaa kwa uchungu; \q nyuso zote zinasawijika.
sw.B: Mataifa yanapowaona yanagaagaa kwa uchungu; \q kila uso unasawijika.
sw.R: Watu wa mataifa wanapowaona, wanatetemeka kwa hofu. \q Kila uso unageuka rangi.

vi.L: Trước nó các dân quằn quại đau đớn; \q mọi mặt đều tái nhợt.
vi.B: Thấy chúng, các dân tộc quằn quại đau đớn; \q mặt mày ai nấy đều tái xanh.
vi.R: Khi dân các nước thấy chúng, họ run rẩy sợ hãi. \q Mặt ai nấy đều tái mét.

ko.L: 그 앞에서 백성들이 몸부림치고, \q 모든 얼굴이 하얗게 질린다.
ko.B: 그들을 보고 민족들이 고통으로 몸부림치고, \q 모든 얼굴이 하얗게 질린다.
ko.R: 여러 민족 사람들이 그들을 보고 두려워 떤다. \q 모두 얼굴이 하얗게 질린다.

am.L: በፊቱ ሕዝቦች ይጨነቃሉ፤ \q ፊቶች ሁሉ ይገረጣሉ።
am.B: ሕዝቦች ሲያዩአቸው እንደ ወላድ ይጨነቃሉ፤ \q ፊት ሁሉ ይገረጣል።
am.R: የሕዝቦች ሰዎች ሲያዩአቸው በፍርሃት ይንቀጠቀጣሉ። \q ፊት ሁሉ ይገረጣል።

hi.L: उसके सामने जातियाँ पीड़ा से छटपटाती हैं; \q सब चेहरे पीले पड़ जाते हैं।
hi.B: उन्हें देखकर देश-देश के लोग पीड़ा से छटपटाते हैं; \q हर चेहरा पीला पड़ जाता है।
hi.R: जब देशों के लोग उन्हें देखते हैं, तो डर से काँप उठते हैं। \q हर चेहरा पीला पड़ जाता है।

ru.L: Перед ним мучаются народы, \q все лица бледнеют.
ru.B: При виде их корчатся от муки народы, \q всякое лицо бледнеет.
ru.R: Когда люди из разных народов видят их, они дрожат от страха. \q Все лица бледнеют.

ja.L: その前で、諸国の民はもだえ苦しみ、 \q すべての顔は色を失う。
ja.B: 彼らを見て、諸国の民はもだえ苦しみ、 \q どの顔も青ざめる。
ja.R: 国々の人々は彼らを見て、恐れて震える。 \q どの顔も青ざめる。

decisions.choice: all faces grow pale: they lose their color in fear
decisions.reason: The phrase, literally "gather a glow", is found again only in Nahum 2:11. It most likely means that the faces draw in their color and turn pale. Some take it the other way: the faces flush red with fear.

decisions.choice: writhe in anguish: the word for the pains of childbirth
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a woman in labor and of people seized by terror (Isaiah 13:8; Jeremiah 4:31).

decisions.choice: At the sight of them (B); When the people of the nations see them (R)
decisions.reason: "Before it" means at its approach. Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: जातियाँ (L); देश-देश के लोग (B); देशों के लोग (R)
decisions.reason: The poetry note's rule for "the peoples": जातियाँ at Literal, the peoples of the countries at Balanced and Readable, where जाति would also suggest caste. Same through Joel.

decisions.choice: корчатся от муки
decisions.reason: The verb is the one for the pains of childbirth (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: 'ammim "諸国の民" (L, B), "国々の人々" (R), as Hosea 7:8; goyim "国々" (2:17, 2:19, 4:2), never "異邦人" in the oracles.
decisions.reason: The prophetic key-word table (ISA, HOS).

source.text: כְּגִבּוֹרִ֣ים יְרֻצ֔וּן כְּאַנְשֵׁ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה יַעֲל֣וּ חוֹמָ֑ה וְאִ֤ישׁ בִּדְרָכָיו֙ יֵֽלֵכ֔וּן וְלֹ֥א יְעַבְּט֖וּן אֹרְחוֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Like warriors they run; like men of war they go up a wall; and each in his ways they go, and not they change their paths.

en.L: Like warriors they run; \q like men of war they climb the wall; \q each one goes on its own way, \q and they do not swerve from their paths.
en.B: They charge like warriors; \q they scale the wall like soldiers. \q Each one marches straight ahead; \q none of them breaks rank.
en.R: They run like warriors. \q They climb walls like soldiers. \q Each one marches straight ahead, \q and none of them gets out of line.

pt.L: Como guerreiros eles correm; \q como homens de guerra sobem o muro; \q cada um anda no seu caminho, \q e não se desviam das suas trilhas.
pt.B: Atacam como guerreiros; \q escalam o muro como soldados. \q Cada um marcha em frente; \q nenhum deles sai da fileira.
pt.R: Eles correm como guerreiros. \q Sobem os muros como soldados. \q Cada um marcha sempre em frente, \q e nenhum deles sai da fila.

fr.L: Comme des guerriers ils courent ; \q comme des hommes de guerre ils escaladent le rempart ; \q chacun avance dans sa voie, \q et ils ne dévient pas de leurs sentiers.
fr.B: Ils chargent comme des guerriers ; \q ils escaladent le rempart comme des soldats. \q Chacun marche droit devant lui ; \q aucun ne rompt les rangs.
fr.R: Ils courent comme des guerriers. \q Ils grimpent sur les murs comme des soldats. \q Chacun marche droit devant lui, \q et aucun ne sort du rang.

es.L: Como valientes corren; \q como hombres de guerra suben el muro; \q cada uno va por su camino, \q y no se desvían de sus sendas.
es.B: Atacan como guerreros; \q escalan el muro como soldados. \q Cada uno avanza derecho; \q ninguno rompe la fila.
es.R: Corren como guerreros. \q Trepan los muros como soldados. \q Cada uno marcha derecho hacia adelante, \q y ninguno se sale de la fila.

sw.L: Kama mashujaa wanakimbia; \q kama watu wa vita wanapanda ukuta; \q kila mmoja anakwenda katika njia zake, \q wala hawageuki kutoka mapito yao.
sw.B: Wanashambulia kama mashujaa; \q wanapanda ukuta kama askari. \q Kila mmoja anasonga mbele moja kwa moja; \q hakuna anayeiacha safu yake.
sw.R: Wanakimbia kama mashujaa. \q Wanapanda kuta kama askari. \q Kila mmoja anasonga mbele moja kwa moja, \q wala hakuna anayetoka katika mstari.

vi.L: Như những dũng sĩ, chúng chạy; \q như những người lính chiến, chúng trèo lên tường thành; \q mỗi con đi theo đường riêng của mình, \q và chúng không rẽ khỏi lối đi của chúng.
vi.B: Chúng xông tới như những dũng sĩ; \q chúng leo tường thành như binh lính. \q Con nào cũng tiến thẳng phía trước; \q không con nào rời hàng ngũ.
vi.R: Chúng chạy như những chiến binh. \q Chúng leo tường thành như binh lính. \q Con nào cũng tiến thẳng về phía trước, \q và không con nào ra khỏi hàng.

ko.L: 그들이 용사들처럼 달리고, \q 군인들처럼 성벽을 기어오른다. \q 각각 자기 길로 가며, \q 자기들의 길에서 벗어나지 않는다.
ko.B: 그들은 용사처럼 돌격하고, \q 군인처럼 성벽을 기어오른다. \q 저마다 앞만 보고 행진하며, \q 하나도 대열을 벗어나지 않는다.
ko.R: 그들은 용사처럼 달린다. \q 군인처럼 성벽을 기어오른다. \q 저마다 똑바로 앞으로 나아가고, \q 아무도 줄에서 벗어나지 않는다.

am.L: እንደ ኃያላን ይሮጣሉ፤ \q እንደ ጦረኞች ቅጥሩን ይወጣሉ፤ \q እያንዳንዱም በየመንገዱ ይሄዳል፤ \q ከመንገዳቸውም ፈቀቅ አይሉም።
am.B: እንደ ጦረኞች ይገሰግሳሉ፤ \q እንደ ወታደሮች ቅጥሩን ይወጣሉ። \q እያንዳንዱ ቀጥ ብሎ ይጓዛል፤ \q አንዳቸውም ከሰልፋቸው አይወጡም።
am.R: እንደ ጦረኞች ይሮጣሉ፤ \q እንደ ወታደሮች ቅጥርን ይወጣሉ። \q እያንዳንዱ ቀጥ ብሎ ይጓዛል፤ \q አንዳቸውም ከሰልፍ አይወጡም።

hi.L: वे शूरवीरों के समान दौड़ते हैं; \q योद्धाओं के समान वे शहरपनाह पर चढ़ते हैं; \q हर एक अपने मार्ग पर चलता है, \q और वे अपने रास्तों से नहीं हटते।
hi.B: वे शूरवीरों की तरह धावा बोलते हैं; \q सैनिकों की तरह शहरपनाह पर चढ़ जाते हैं। \q हर एक सीधा आगे बढ़ता है; \q कोई अपनी पाँति नहीं तोड़ता।
hi.R: वे योद्धाओं की तरह दौड़ते हैं। \q वे सैनिकों की तरह दीवारों पर चढ़ जाते हैं। \q हर एक सीधा आगे बढ़ता है, \q और कोई अपनी पंक्ति से बाहर नहीं निकलता।

ru.L: Как воины, бегут они, \q как люди войны, взбираются на стену; \q и каждый идёт своими путями, \q и не меняют они своих стезей.
ru.B: Они несутся, как воины, \q взбираются на стену, как солдаты. \q Каждый идёт прямо вперёд, \q никто не нарушает строя.
ru.R: Они бегут, как воины. \q Они лезут на стены, как солдаты. \q Каждый идёт прямо вперёд, \q и никто не выходит из строя.

ja.L: 勇士のように彼らは走り、 \q 戦士のように城壁をよじ登る。 \q それぞれ自分の道を進み、 \q その道筋から外れない。
ja.B: 彼らは勇士のように突進し、 \q 兵士のように城壁をよじ登る。 \q それぞれがまっすぐに進み、 \q どれも隊列を乱さない。
ja.R: 彼らは勇士のように走る。 \q 兵士のように城壁をよじ登る。 \q それぞれが、まっすぐに進んで行き、 \q どれも列からはみ出さない。

decisions.choice: they do not swerve: they do not turn aside from their paths
decisions.reason: The verb, as the Hebrew text has it, elsewhere means to take a pledge. Here it must mean something like turn aside or change course, which fits the parallel line; the ancient translations understood it so. The swarm keeps perfect order, like a disciplined army.

decisions.choice: the wall: a city wall
decisions.reason: Locusts climb over walls and into houses (Exodus 10:6). Verse 9 shows the army taking a city.

decisions.choice: each one ... its (L); Each one (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "each man", the usual way to say "each". Since the army is of locusts, every level says "each one", and Literal says "its" for "his".

decisions.choice: gibborim "ኃያላን", anshei milḥamah "ጦረኞች" (L), as in 4:9
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the two Hebrew expressions apart and gives each one word through the book; Balanced and Readable follow the English ("warriors", "soldiers").

source.text: וְאִ֤ישׁ אָחִיו֙ לֹ֣א יִדְחָק֔וּן גֶּ֥בֶר בִּמְסִלָּת֖וֹ יֵֽלֵכ֑וּן וּבְעַ֥ד הַשֶּׁ֛לַח יִפֹּ֖לוּ לֹ֥א יִבְצָֽעוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And each his brother they do not jostle; each man in his path they go; and through the weapons they fall, not they break off.

en.L: They do not jostle one another; \q each goes in its own track; \q they plunge through the weapons and are not halted.
en.B: They do not push one another; \q each marches in its own track. \q They plunge through the weapons and do not stop.
en.R: They do not bump into each other. \q Each one goes straight ahead. \q Weapons cannot stop them as they rush forward.

pt.L: Não se empurram uns aos outros; \q cada um anda na sua trilha; \q lançam-se por entre as armas e não são detidos.
pt.B: Não se empurram uns aos outros; \q cada um marcha na sua própria trilha. \q Lançam-se por entre as armas e não param.
pt.R: Eles não esbarram uns nos outros. \q Cada um segue sempre em frente. \q As armas não conseguem detê-los enquanto avançam.

fr.L: Ils ne se bousculent pas l’un l’autre ; \q chacun va dans sa piste ; \q ils foncent à travers les armes et ne sont pas arrêtés.
fr.B: Ils ne se poussent pas les uns les autres ; \q chacun avance dans sa propre trace. \q Ils foncent à travers les armes et ne s’arrêtent pas.
fr.R: Ils ne se cognent pas les uns contre les autres. \q Chacun va droit devant lui. \q Les armes ne peuvent pas les arrêter quand ils se précipitent en avant.

es.L: No se empujan unos a otros; \q cada uno va por su propia senda; \q se lanzan a través de las armas y no se detienen.
es.B: No se atropellan entre sí; \q cada uno marcha por su propio camino. \q Se lanzan entre las armas y no se detienen.
es.R: No chocan unos con otros. \q Cada uno va derecho hacia adelante. \q Las armas no pueden detenerlos mientras avanzan a toda prisa.

sw.L: Hawasukumani mmoja na mwenzake; \q kila mmoja anakwenda katika njia yake; \q wanapenya kati ya silaha wala hawazuiliki.
sw.B: Hawasukumani; \q kila mmoja anatembea katika njia yake. \q Wanapita katikati ya silaha wala hawasimami.
sw.R: Hawagongani. \q Kila mmoja anakwenda moja kwa moja. \q Silaha haziwezi kuwazuia wanapokimbia mbele.

vi.L: Chúng không chen lấn nhau; \q mỗi con đi trong đường riêng của mình; \q chúng lao qua giữa các vũ khí mà không bị chặn lại.
vi.B: Chúng không xô đẩy nhau; \q mỗi con tiến bước theo đường của mình. \q Chúng lao qua giữa các vũ khí mà không dừng lại.
vi.R: Chúng không va vào nhau. \q Con nào cũng đi thẳng tới trước. \q Vũ khí không thể chặn chúng lại khi chúng lao tới.

ko.L: 그들은 서로 밀치지 않고, \q 각각 자기 길로 간다. \q 무기들 사이로 뛰어들어도 멈추지 않는다.
ko.B: 그들은 서로 밀치지 않고, \q 저마다 제 길로 나아간다. \q 무기들을 뚫고 뛰어들며 멈추지 않는다.
ko.R: 그들은 서로 부딪치지 않는다. \q 저마다 똑바로 나아간다. \q 그들이 돌진할 때 어떤 무기도 그들을 막지 못한다.

am.L: እርስ በርሳቸው አይገፋፉም፤ \q እያንዳንዱ በየጎዳናው ይሄዳል፤ \q በጦር መሣሪያዎች መካከል ዘልቀው ይገባሉ፤ አይገቱምም።
am.B: እርስ በርሳቸው አይገፋፉም፤ \q እያንዳንዱ በራሱ መስመር ይጓዛል። \q የጦር መሣሪያዎችን ጥሰው ያልፋሉ፤ አይቆሙምም።
am.R: እርስ በርሳቸው አይጋጩም። \q እያንዳንዱ ቀጥ ብሎ ይሄዳል። \q ወደ ፊት ሲገሰግሱ የጦር መሣሪያ ሊያስቆማቸው አይችልም።

hi.L: वे एक दूसरे को धक्का नहीं देते; \q हर एक अपनी लीक पर चलता है; \q वे हथियारों के बीच से घुस पड़ते हैं और रोके नहीं जाते।
hi.B: वे एक दूसरे को धकेलते नहीं; \q हर एक अपनी ही लीक पर बढ़ता है। \q वे हथियारों के बीच से घुस जाते हैं और रुकते नहीं।
hi.R: वे एक दूसरे से टकराते नहीं। \q हर एक सीधा आगे जाता है। \q जब वे आगे झपटते हैं, तो हथियार भी उन्हें रोक नहीं पाते।

ru.L: Друг друга они не толкают, \q каждый идёт своей стезёй; \q сквозь оружие прорываются и не останавливаются.
ru.B: Они не толкают друг друга, \q каждый идёт своей дорогой. \q Они прорываются сквозь оружие и не останавливаются.
ru.R: Они не сталкиваются друг с другом. \q Каждый идёт прямо вперёд. \q Оружие не может остановить их, когда они рвутся вперёд.

ja.L: 互いに押し合わず、 \q それぞれ自分の道筋を進む。 \q 武器の間を突き進んでも、止められない。
ja.B: 互いに押し合うことなく、 \q それぞれ自分の道を進む。 \q 武器の中に突っ込んでも、止まらない。
ja.R: 互いにぶつかり合うこともない。 \q それぞれが、まっすぐに進む。 \q 彼らが突き進むのを、武器で止めることはできない。

decisions.choice: they plunge through the weapons and are not halted
alternatives: they plunge through the water channels and are not cut off
decisions.reason: The word for "weapons" names a thrown weapon such as a javelin, and the line pictures the swarm plunging through the defenders' missiles without being stopped. The same word can mean a water channel, and the last verb can mean "be cut off" or "be wounded", so the line could also mean that they go down through the channels and are not cut off. The sense is clear either way: nothing stops them.

decisions.choice: each his brother, each man: each one of the swarm
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the words "brother" and "man" to say "one another" and "each". The subject is still the locust army.

decisions.choice: one another, each, its (all levels)
decisions.reason: As in verse 7, the words "brother" and "man" are given as "one another" and "each", and Literal says "its" for "his".

source.text: בָּעִ֣יר יָשֹׁ֗קּוּ בַּֽחוֹמָה֙ יְרֻצ֔וּן בַּבָּתִּ֖ים יַעֲל֑וּ בְּעַ֧ד הַחַלּוֹנִ֛ים יָבֹ֖אוּ כַּגַּנָּֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: On the city they rush; on the wall they run; into the houses they go up; through the windows they enter like a thief.

en.L: They rush upon the city; they run on the wall; \q they climb into the houses; \q through the windows they enter like a thief.
en.B: They swarm over the city; they run along the wall; \q they climb into the houses; \q they come in through the windows like a thief.
en.R: They rush into the city and run along the walls. \q They climb into the houses. \q They come in through the windows like thieves.

pt.L: Sobre a cidade eles se lançam; sobre o muro correm; \q nas casas sobem; \q pelas janelas entram como um ladrão.
pt.B: Eles invadem a cidade; correm sobre o muro; \q sobem nas casas; \q entram pelas janelas como um ladrão.
pt.R: Eles invadem a cidade e correm pelos muros. \q Sobem nas casas. \q Entram pelas janelas como ladrões.

fr.L: Ils se ruent sur la ville ; ils courent sur le rempart ; \q ils montent dans les maisons ; \q par les fenêtres ils entrent comme un voleur.
fr.B: Ils envahissent la ville, ils courent le long du rempart ; \q ils grimpent dans les maisons ; \q ils entrent par les fenêtres comme un voleur.
fr.R: Ils se précipitent dans la ville et courent le long des murs. \q Ils grimpent dans les maisons. \q Ils entrent par les fenêtres comme des voleurs.

es.L: Se lanzan sobre la ciudad; corren por el muro; \q suben a las casas; \q por las ventanas entran como el ladrón.
es.B: Invaden la ciudad; corren por el muro; \q trepan a las casas; \q entran por las ventanas como un ladrón.
es.R: Entran a toda prisa en la ciudad y corren por los muros. \q Trepan a las casas. \q Entran por las ventanas como ladrones.

sw.L: Wanaurukia mji; wanakimbia juu ya ukuta; \q wanapanda kuingia katika nyumba; \q wanaingia kupitia madirisha kama mwizi.
sw.B: Wanaujaa mji; wanakimbia juu ya ukuta; \q wanapanda kuingia ndani ya nyumba; \q wanaingia kupitia madirisha kama mwizi.
sw.R: Wanaingia mjini kwa kasi na kukimbia juu ya kuta. \q Wanapanda kuingia ndani ya nyumba. \q Wanaingia kupitia madirisha kama wezi.

vi.L: Chúng xông vào thành; chúng chạy trên tường thành; \q chúng trèo vào các nhà; \q chúng vào qua các cửa sổ như kẻ trộm.
vi.B: Chúng tràn khắp thành; chúng chạy dọc theo tường thành; \q chúng leo vào các nhà; \q chúng lọt vào qua cửa sổ như kẻ trộm.
vi.R: Chúng xông vào thành và chạy dọc theo các bức tường. \q Chúng leo vào nhà. \q Chúng chui qua cửa sổ mà vào như những tên trộm.

ko.L: 그들이 성읍 위로 달려들고 성벽 위를 달리며, \q 집들로 기어오르고, \q 도둑처럼 창문들로 들어간다.
ko.B: 그들은 성읍을 뒤덮고 성벽 위를 내달리며, \q 집들로 기어오르고, \q 도둑처럼 창문으로 들어온다.
ko.R: 그들은 성 안으로 몰려들어 성벽 위를 달린다. \q 집들로 기어오른다. \q 도둑처럼 창문으로 들어온다.

am.L: በከተማዪቱ ላይ ይጣደፋሉ፤ በቅጥሩ ላይ ይሮጣሉ፤ \q ወደ ቤቶች ይወጣሉ፤ \q እንደ ሌባ በመስኮቶች ይገባሉ።
am.B: ከተማዪቱን ይወርራሉ፤ በቅጥሩ ላይ ይሮጣሉ፤ \q ወደ ቤቶቹ ይወጣሉ፤ \q እንደ ሌባ በመስኮቶች ይገባሉ።
am.R: ወደ ከተማዪቱ እየተጣደፉ ገብተው በቅጥሮቹ ላይ ይሮጣሉ። \q ወደ ቤቶቹ ይወጣሉ። \q እንደ ሌቦች በመስኮቶች ይገባሉ።

hi.L: वे नगर पर टूट पड़ते हैं; वे शहरपनाह पर दौड़ते हैं; \q वे घरों में चढ़ जाते हैं; \q वे चोर के समान खिड़कियों से भीतर घुसते हैं।
hi.B: वे नगर पर छा जाते हैं; वे शहरपनाह पर दौड़ते हैं; \q वे घरों में चढ़ जाते हैं; \q वे चोर की तरह खिड़कियों से भीतर आ जाते हैं।
hi.R: वे नगर में घुस आते हैं और दीवारों पर दौड़ते हैं। \q वे घरों में चढ़ जाते हैं। \q वे चोरों की तरह खिड़कियों से भीतर आ जाते हैं।

ru.L: На город бросаются, по стене бегут, \q в дома взбираются, \q через окна входят, как вор.
ru.B: Они заполняют город, бегают по стене, \q взбираются в дома, \q влезают в окна, как вор.
ru.R: Они врываются в город и бегают по стенам. \q Они забираются в дома. \q Они влезают через окна, как воры.

ja.L: 彼らは町に襲いかかり、城壁の上を走り、 \q 家々によじ登り、 \q 窓から盗人のように入り込む。
ja.B: 彼らは町に群がり、城壁の上を走り回り、 \q 家々によじ登り、 \q 盗人のように窓から入り込む。
ja.R: 彼らは町に駆け込み、城壁の上を走る。 \q 家々によじ登る。 \q どろぼうのように、窓から入って来る。

decisions.choice: windows: openings in the wall, with lattices but no glass
decisions.reason: Windows in houses of the time were openings closed with wooden lattice, not glass. Nothing keeps the swarm out (Exodus 10:6).

decisions.choice: like a thief: unannounced and unstoppable
decisions.reason: A thief comes in where no one expects. The New Testament uses the same picture for the coming of the day of the Lord (1 Thessalonians 5:2; 2 Peter 3:10).

decisions.choice: thieves (R)
decisions.reason: Readable uses the plural to match "they".

source.text: לְפָנָיו֙ רָ֣גְזָה אֶ֔רֶץ רָעֲשׁ֖וּ שָׁמָ֑יִם שֶׁ֤מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֨חַ֙ קָדָ֔רוּ וְכוֹכָבִ֖ים אָסְפ֥וּ נָגְהָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Before it trembles [the] earth; shake [the] heavens; sun and moon become dark, and stars withdraw their brightness.

en.L: Before it the earth trembles; \q the heavens shake; \q the sun and the moon grow dark, \q and the stars withdraw their shining.
en.B: Before them the earth quakes \q and the sky shakes; \q the sun and moon go dark, \q and the stars lose their brightness.
en.R: The earth shakes in front of them, \q and the sky trembles. \q The sun and the moon become dark, \q and the stars stop shining.

pt.L: Diante dele a terra treme; \q os céus estremecem; \q o sol e a lua se escurecem, \q e as estrelas recolhem o seu brilho.
pt.B: Diante deles a terra se abala \q e o céu estremece; \q o sol e a lua escurecem, \q e as estrelas perdem o seu brilho.
pt.R: A terra treme diante deles, \q e o céu estremece. \q O sol e a lua ficam escuros, \q e as estrelas param de brilhar.

fr.L: Devant lui la terre tremble, \q les cieux sont ébranlés ; \q le soleil et la lune s’obscurcissent, \q et les étoiles retirent leur éclat.
fr.B: Devant eux la terre tremble \q et le ciel est ébranlé ; \q le soleil et la lune s’assombrissent, \q et les étoiles perdent leur éclat.
fr.R: La terre tremble devant eux, \q et le ciel est secoué. \q Le soleil et la lune deviennent sombres, \q et les étoiles cessent de briller.

es.L: Delante de él tiembla la tierra; \q se estremecen los cielos; \q el sol y la luna se oscurecen, \q y las estrellas retiran su resplandor.
es.B: Ante ellos la tierra se sacude \q y el cielo se estremece; \q el sol y la luna se oscurecen, \q y las estrellas pierden su brillo.
es.R: La tierra tiembla delante de ellos, \q y el cielo se estremece. \q El sol y la luna se ponen oscuros, \q y las estrellas dejan de brillar.

sw.L: Mbele yake nchi inatetemeka; \q mbingu zinatikisika; \q jua na mwezi vinatiwa giza, \q na nyota zinazuia mwangaza wao.
sw.B: Mbele yao dunia inatetemeka \q na anga linatikisika; \q jua na mwezi vinakuwa giza, \q na nyota zinapoteza mwangaza wao.
sw.R: Dunia inatikisika mbele yao, \q na anga linatetemeka. \q Jua na mwezi vinakuwa giza, \q na nyota zinaacha kung'aa.

vi.L: Trước nó đất rúng động; \q các tầng trời rung chuyển; \q mặt trời và mặt trăng tối sầm, \q và các ngôi sao thu lại ánh sáng của chúng.
vi.B: Trước mặt chúng, đất rung chuyển \q và bầu trời lay động; \q mặt trời và mặt trăng tối sầm lại, \q các ngôi sao mất hết ánh sáng.
vi.R: Đất rung chuyển trước mặt chúng, \q và bầu trời run rẩy. \q Mặt trời và mặt trăng trở nên tối đen, \q và các ngôi sao thôi chiếu sáng.

ko.L: 그 앞에서 땅이 떨고 \q 하늘이 흔들리며, \q 해와 달이 어두워지고, \q 별들이 그 빛을 거둔다.
ko.B: 그들 앞에서 땅이 진동하고 \q 하늘이 흔들린다. \q 해와 달이 캄캄해지고, \q 별들이 빛을 잃는다.
ko.R: 그들 앞에서 땅이 흔들리고 \q 하늘이 떤다. \q 해와 달이 어두워지고 \q 별들이 더 이상 빛나지 않는다.

am.L: በፊቱ ምድር ትንቀጠቀጣለች፤ \q ሰማያት ይናወጣሉ፤ \q ፀሐይና ጨረቃ ይጨልማሉ፤ \q ከዋክብትም ብርሃናቸውን ይሰበስባሉ።
am.B: በፊታቸው ምድር ትናወጣለች፤ \q ሰማዩም ይንቀጠቀጣል፤ \q ፀሐይና ጨረቃ ይጨልማሉ፤ \q ከዋክብትም ብርሃናቸውን ያጣሉ።
am.R: ምድር በፊታቸው ትናወጣለች፤ \q ሰማዩም ይንቀጠቀጣል። \q ፀሐይና ጨረቃ ይጨልማሉ፤ \q ከዋክብትም ማብራታቸውን ያቆማሉ።

hi.L: उसके आगे पृथ्वी काँपती है; \q आकाश थरथराता है; \q सूर्य और चंद्रमा काले पड़ जाते हैं, \q और तारे अपनी चमक रोक लेते हैं।
hi.B: उनके आगे पृथ्वी डोल उठती है \q और आकाश काँप उठता है; \q सूर्य और चंद्रमा अंधेरे हो जाते हैं, \q और तारों की चमक जाती रहती है।
hi.R: उनके सामने धरती काँपती है, \q और आकाश थरथराता है। \q सूरज और चाँद अँधेरे हो जाते हैं, \q और तारे चमकना बंद कर देते हैं।

ru.L: Перед ним дрожит земля, \q сотрясаются небеса, \q солнце и луна темнеют, \q и звёзды теряют своё сияние.
ru.B: Перед ними сотрясается земля \q и колеблется небо, \q солнце и луна меркнут, \q и звёзды теряют свой блеск.
ru.R: Земля трясётся перед ними, \q и небо дрожит. \q Солнце и луна темнеют, \q и звёзды перестают светить.

ja.L: その前で地は震え、 \q 天は揺れ動く。 \q 太陽も月も暗くなり、 \q 星々はその輝きを収める。
ja.B: 彼らの前で地はおののき、 \q 空は揺れ動く。 \q 太陽も月も暗くなり、 \q 星はその輝きを失う。
ja.R: 彼らの前で、地は揺れ、 \q 空は震える。 \q 太陽も月も暗くなり、 \q 星は光らなくなる。

decisions.choice: the earth quakes and the lights of the sky go dark: the signs of the LORD's coming
decisions.reason: When the LORD comes, the earth shakes and the heavens tremble (Judges 5:4; Psalm 18:8; Isaiah 13:10, 13). A swarm can blot out the sun, but the words go beyond the locusts: the day of the LORD itself is here. The second half of the verse returns word for word in 4:15, and 3:4 speaks of the sun and moon in the same way.

decisions.choice: before it: at the army's approach
decisions.reason: The "it" is the army of verses 2-9. In the next verse the LORD himself is at its head.

decisions.choice: the sky (B, R); the heavens (L)
decisions.reason: The word means both the sky and heaven. Balanced and Readable say "the sky", set against the earth. The same wording is used in 4:15.

decisions.choice: os céus (L), o céu (B, R); the second half as in 4:15
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the plural of the Hebrew; Balanced and Readable say "o céu", set against the earth, as the English. The words about the sun, moon and stars are written to be repeated unchanged in 4:15, where the Hebrew repeats them (m1).

decisions.choice: the last two lines in the same words as 4:15: "ፀሐይና ጨረቃ ይጨልማሉ፤ ከዋክብትም ብርሃናቸውን ይሰበስባሉ" (L), "... ያጣሉ" (B), "... ማብራታቸውን ያቆማሉ" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of the two lines is the same in 4:15. Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of the stars "gathering in" their light.

decisions.choice: आकाश; सूर्य और चंद्रमा (L, B), सूरज और चाँद (R)
decisions.reason: The heavens set against the earth are the sky, आकाश at every level; sun and moon take the learned words at Literal and Balanced and the everyday words at Readable, as Isaiah 13:10. The same wording returns in 3:4 and 4:15.

source.text: וַֽיהוָ֗ה נָתַ֤ן קוֹלוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י חֵיל֔וֹ כִּ֣י רַ֤ב מְאֹד֙ מַחֲנֵ֔הוּ כִּ֥י עָצ֖וּם עֹשֵׂ֣ה דְבָר֑וֹ כִּֽי־גָד֧וֹל יוֹם־יְהוָ֛ה וְנוֹרָ֥א מְאֹ֖ד וּמִ֥י יְכִילֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And Yahweh gives his voice before his army; for very great [is] his camp; for mighty [is the one] doing his word; for great [is the] day of Yahweh and very fearful, and who can endure it?

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} utters {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} army, \q for very great is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} camp, \q for mighty is the one who does {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word; \q for great [is] the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and very fearful, and who can endure it?
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} thunders at the head of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} army; \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} forces are vast, \q and mighty is the one who carries out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} command. \q The day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is great and very terrible. Who can endure it?
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} shouts out orders to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} army. \q There are so many soldiers in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} army! \q Those who obey {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commands are very strong. \q The day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is great and terrible. Who can live through it?

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dá a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} voz diante do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} exército, \q porque muito grande é o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} acampamento, \q porque poderoso é aquele que executa a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} palavra; \q porque grande [é] o dia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e muito temível, e quem pode suportá-lo?
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} troveja à frente do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} exército; \q as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} tropas são imensas, \q e poderoso é aquele que cumpre a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ordem. \q O dia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} é grande e muito terrível. Quem poderá suportá-lo?
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} grita ordens para o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} exército. \q Há tantos soldados no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} exército! \q Os que obedecem às {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} ordens são muito fortes. \q O dia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} é grande e terrível. Quem vai conseguir sobreviver a ele?

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fait entendre {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix devant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} armée, \q car très grand est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} camp, \q car puissant est celui qui exécute {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole ; \q car grand [est] le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et très redoutable, et qui peut le supporter ?
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fait gronder {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix à la tête de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} armée ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} troupes sont innombrables, \q et puissant est celui qui accomplit {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ordres. \q Le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est grand et très redoutable. Qui pourra le supporter ?
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} crie {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ordres à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} armée. \q Il y a tant de soldats dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} armée ! \q Ceux qui obéissent à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ordres sont très forts. \q Le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est grand et terrible. Qui pourra y survivre ?

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} da {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz delante de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ejército, \q porque muy grande es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} campamento, \q porque poderoso es el que ejecuta {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra; \q porque grande [es] el día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y muy temible, ¿y quién lo podrá soportar?
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} truena al frente de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ejército; \q {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} tropas son inmensas, \q y poderoso es el que cumple {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} orden. \q El día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es grande y muy terrible. ¿Quién lo podrá soportar?
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} da órdenes a gritos a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ejército. \q ¡Hay muchísimos soldados en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ejército! \q Los que obedecen {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} órdenes son muy fuertes. \q El día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es grande y terrible. ¿Quién podrá sobrevivir a ese día?

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anatoa sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mbele ya jeshi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, \q kwa maana kambi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ni kubwa mno, \q kwa maana ana nguvu yule anayetekeleza neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q kwa maana siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] kuu, na ya kutisha mno, naye ni nani awezaye kuistahimili?
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ananguruma mbele ya jeshi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q majeshi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ni makubwa mno, \q na mwenye nguvu ni yule anayetekeleza amri {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni kuu na ya kutisha sana. Ni nani awezaye kuistahimili?
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapiga kelele kutoa amri kwa jeshi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. \q Askari wa jeshi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni wengi mno! \q Wale wanaotii amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} wana nguvu sana. \q Siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni kuu na ya kutisha. Ni nani atakayeipita akiwa hai?

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cất tiếng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trước đạo quân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q vì trại quân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rất đông, \q vì kẻ thi hành lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật hùng mạnh; \q vì ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lớn lao và rất đáng sợ, và ai có thể chịu nổi ngày ấy?
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cất tiếng như sấm trước đạo quân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q binh lực của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đông vô số, \q và kẻ thi hành mệnh lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật hùng mạnh. \q Ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lớn lao và vô cùng khủng khiếp. Ai chịu nổi ngày ấy?
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hô lớn ra lệnh cho đạo quân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Quân lính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đông vô số! \q Những kẻ vâng theo mệnh lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rất mạnh mẽ. \q Ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lớn lao và khủng khiếp. Ai có thể sống sót qua ngày ấy?

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 군대 앞에서 그분의 목소리를 내신다. \q 그분의 진영이 매우 크고, \q 그분의 말씀을 행하는 자가 강하기 때문이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이 크고 매우 두려우니, 누가 그날을 견딜 수 있겠느냐?
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 군대 앞에서 우렛소리를 내신다. \q 그분의 군대는 셀 수 없이 많고, \q 그분의 명령을 수행하는 자는 강하다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날은 크고 몹시 두렵다. 누가 그날을 견딜 수 있겠느냐?
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 군대에게 큰 소리로 명령하신다. \q 그분의 군대에는 군사가 정말 많다! \q 그분의 명령에 따르는 자들은 아주 강하다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날은 크고 무서운 날이다. 누가 그날을 견디고 살아남을 수 있겠느냐?

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም በሠራዊቱ ፊት ድምፁን ያሰማል፤ \q ሰፈሩ እጅግ ታላቅ ነውና፤ \q ቃሉን የሚፈጽም ብርቱ ነውና፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀን ታላቅና እጅግ የሚያስፈራ ነውና፤ ማንስ ሊቋቋመው ይችላል?
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሠራዊቱ ፊት ያንጎደጉዳል፤ \q ጭፍሮቹ እጅግ ብዙ ናቸው፤ \q ትእዛዙንም የሚፈጽም ብርቱ ነው። \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀን ታላቅና እጅግ አስፈሪ ነው። ማን ሊቋቋመው ይችላል?
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለሠራዊቱ እየጮኸ ትእዛዝ ይሰጣል። \q በሠራዊቱ ውስጥ እጅግ ብዙ ወታደሮች አሉ! \q ትእዛዙን የሚፈጽሙት እጅግ ብርቱዎች ናቸው። \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀን ታላቅና አስፈሪ ነው። ከዚያ ቀን ማን በሕይወት ሊተርፍ ይችላል?

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपनी सेना के आगे अपनी आवाज़ सुनाते हैं, \q क्योंकि उनकी छावनी बहुत बड़ी है, \q क्योंकि जो उनका वचन पूरा करता है वह सामर्थी है; \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दिन महान और बहुत भयावना [है], और कौन उसे सह सकता है?
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपनी सेना के आगे गरजते हैं; \q उनकी सेनाएँ अनगिनत हैं, \q और जो उनकी आज्ञा पूरी करता है वह सामर्थी है। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दिन महान और अति भयानक है। कौन उसे सह सकता है?
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपनी सेना को ऊँची आवाज़ में आज्ञाएँ देते हैं। \q उनकी सेना में कितने सारे सैनिक हैं! \q जो उनकी आज्ञाएँ मानते हैं, वे बहुत शक्तिशाली हैं। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दिन महान और भयानक है। कौन उसमें जीवित बच सकता है?

ru.L: И {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} подаёт свой голос перед своим войском, \q ведь весьма велик {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} стан, \q ведь силён исполняющий {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} слово; \q ведь велик день {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и весьма страшен, и кто вынесет его?
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} гремит во главе своего войска; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} полчища бесчисленны, \q и могуч тот, кто исполняет {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} повеление. \q Велик день {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и очень страшен. Кто его вынесет?
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} громко отдаёт приказы своему войску. \q Как много воинов в {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} войске! \q Те, кто исполняет {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} приказы, очень сильны. \q Велик и страшен день {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Кто сможет его пережить?

ja.L: そして、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はご自分の軍勢の前で声を発せられる。 \q その陣営は非常に大きく、 \q その言葉を行う者は強いからだ。 \q まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の日は大いなるもので、非常に恐ろしい。だれがそれに耐えられようか？
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分の軍勢の先頭で雷のような声を上げられる。 \q その軍勢は数えきれず、 \q その命令を行う者は強い。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の日は大いなる日、まことに恐ろしい日だ。だれがそれに耐えられようか？
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分の軍勢に大声で命令を下される。 \q その方の軍勢の兵士は、なんと多いことか！ \q その方の命令に従う者たちは、とても強い。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の日は大いなる、恐ろしい日だ。だれが、その日を生き延びることができるだろうか？

decisions.choice: the LORD's army: the LORD himself leads the invaders
decisions.reason: The army of verses 2-10 is the LORD's own, and he leads it. In 2:25 he calls the locusts "my great army, which I sent among you". The disaster is his judgment, so only turning to him can avert it (verses 12-14).

decisions.choice: gives his voice: thunders, or shouts his command
decisions.reason: To "give one's voice" is to shout or roar; with God as subject it often means thunder (Psalm 18:14; 46:7). Here it is the battle cry of a commander at the head of his army. 4:16 uses the same words.

decisions.choice: mighty is the one who does his word: the army that carries out his command
alternatives: the LORD, who carries out his word
decisions.reason: The one who "does his word" is the army, carrying out the LORD's order (compare Psalm 103:20). The phrase could also describe the LORD, who carries out what he has said.

decisions.choice: great and very fearful, and who can endure it?
decisions.reason: The day is "great and fearful" again in 3:4 and Malachi 3:23. Malachi 3:2 asks the same question: "who can endure the day of his coming?"

decisions.choice: fearful (L); terrible (B, R); thunders (B)
decisions.reason: The word means "to be feared". Literal says "fearful", Balanced and Readable "terrible", the same at 3:4. Balanced says "thunders" for "gives his voice" (m2), as at 4:16; Readable says he shouts orders.

decisions.choice: "redoutable" (L, B); "terrible" (R) for the fearful day, the wording also of 3:4
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for "great and fearful" (Joel 3:4; Malachi 3:23): "redoutable" says the fear the day inspires; Readable uses the commoner "terrible".

decisions.choice: "temible" (L); "terrible" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Follows the English split for the fear-inspiring day; "grande y terrible" is the wording the terms note sets for 3:4 at B and R.

decisions.choice: "ya kutisha" at every level
decisions.reason: "Kutisha" (terrifying) is used for the Hebrew "fearful" at all three levels; it is the word the term sheet sets for "the great and terrible day" in Joel 3:4.

decisions.choice: "kẻ thi hành lời của Ngài" (L, B); "Những kẻ vâng theo mệnh lệnh của Ngài" (R)
decisions.reason: The one who carries out his word is the army, not God himself (meaning decision), so the plain "kẻ" is used, not the capitalised "Đấng" that would point to God.

decisions.choice: "the day of the LORD" is "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날" at every level; "great and very fearful" is "크고 매우 두려운" (L), "크고 몹시 두려운" (B), "크고 무서운" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording (Isaiah 13:6). The same adjectives return in 3:4, where Acts 2:20 has "영광스러운" from the Greek.

decisions.choice: temível (L); terrível (B, R), also in 3:4; dá a sua voz (L); troveja (B), also in 4:16
decisions.reason: The word means "to be feared": Literal says "temível", Balanced and Readable "terrível", and 3:4 keeps the same pair. Literal keeps the idiom "dar a sua voz"; Balanced says "troveja" (m2), the word 4:16 repeats.

decisions.choice: noraʾ "የሚያስፈራ" (L), "አስፈሪ" (B, R), here and in 3:4
decisions.reason: The day is fearful, to be dreaded; the same word describes it in 3:4, where Acts 2:20 reads "glorious".

decisions.choice: gives his voice: "ድምፁን ያሰማል" (L), "ያንጎደጉዳል" (B), as in 4:16
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom; Balanced says "thunders", as the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: भयावना (L); भयानक (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means "to be feared"; Literal says भयावना, Balanced and Readable the everyday भयानक, as the English has "fearful" and "terrible". The same in 3:4.

decisions.choice: The LORD in the third person in the prophet's words takes light respect forms ("声を発せられる", "上げられる", "下される", "ご自分の"), as the ISA notes; nora' "恐ろしい" every level.
decisions.reason: God's acts in the third person take light respect forms (ISA-ISA-1); the LORD speaking of himself (2:26) takes none.

source.text: וְגַם־עַתָּה֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה שֻׁ֥בוּ עָדַ֖י בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וּבְצ֥וֹם וּבְבְכִ֖יוּבְמִסְפֵּֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And even now, declaration of Yahweh, return to me with all your heart, and with fasting and with weeping and with mourning.

en.L: And even now, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q turn back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with all your heart, \q with fasting, and with weeping, and with lamenting.
en.B: Yet even now, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q turn back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with all your heart, \q with fasting and weeping and mourning.
en.R: But even now, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q come back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with all your heart. \q Go without food, weep, and mourn.

pt.L: E mesmo agora, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q voltem para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} com todo o coração de vocês, \q com jejum, e com choro, e com lamento.
pt.B: Mas ainda agora, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q voltem para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} com o coração inteiro, \q jejuando, chorando e lamentando.
pt.R: Mas mesmo agora, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q voltem para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} de coração. \q Fiquem sem comer, chorem e lamentem.
