fr.L: Et maintenant encore, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q revenez à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} de tout votre cœur, \q avec jeûne, et avec pleurs, et avec lamentations.
fr.B: Maintenant encore, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q revenez à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} de tout votre cœur, \q avec des jeûnes, des pleurs et des cris de deuil.
fr.R: Mais même maintenant, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q revenez à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} de tout votre cœur. \q Privez-vous de nourriture, pleurez et prenez le deuil.

es.L: Y aun ahora, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} con todo {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}}, \q con ayuno, con llanto y con lamento.
es.B: Pero aun ahora, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q {{plural_you:vuélvanse|volveos}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} de todo corazón, \q con ayuno, llanto y duelo.
es.R: Pero todavía ahora, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q {{plural_you:regresen|regresad}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} de todo corazón. \q {{plural_you:Ayunen|Ayunad}}, {{plural_you:lloren|llorad}} y {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} duelo.

sw.L: Na hata sasa, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q rudini {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} kwa moyo wenu wote, \q kwa kufunga, na kwa kulia, na kwa kuomboleza.
sw.B: Lakini hata sasa, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q rudini {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} kwa moyo wenu wote, \q kwa kufunga, kwa kulia na kwa kuomboleza.
sw.R: Lakini hata sasa, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q rudini {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} kwa moyo wenu wote. \q Fungeni, lieni na kuomboleza.

vi.L: Dù vậy ngay cả bây giờ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q hãy quay về với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hết lòng các ngươi, \q với sự kiêng ăn, với khóc lóc, và với than van.
vi.B: Dù vậy, ngay cả bây giờ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q hãy hết lòng quay về với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q bằng sự kiêng ăn, khóc lóc và than van.
vi.R: Nhưng ngay cả bây giờ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, \q hãy hết lòng trở về với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Hãy nhịn ăn, khóc lóc và than van.

ko.L: 그러나 지금이라도, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다, \q 너희는 마음을 다하여 나에게 돌아오너라. \q 금식하며 울며 애곡하며 [돌아오너라].
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그러나 지금이라도 \q 너희는 마음을 다하여 나에게 돌아오너라. \q 금식하고 울고 슬퍼하며 돌아오너라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그래도 아직 늦지 않았다. \q 너희는 온 마음으로 나에게 돌아오너라. \q 음식을 끊고 울며 슬퍼하여라.

am.L: አሁንም ቢሆን፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ \q በፍጹም ልባችሁ ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ፤ \q በጾምም፣ በልቅሶም፣ በዋይታም።
am.B: አሁንም ቢሆን፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ \q በፍጹም ልባችሁ ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ፤ \q እየጾማችሁ፣ እያለቀሳችሁና እያዘናችሁ።
am.R: አሁንም ቢሆን፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ \q በሙሉ ልባችሁ ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ። \q ጹሙ፤ አልቅሱ፤ እዘኑም።

hi.L: पर अब भी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, \q अपने पूरे मन से मेरी ओर लौट आओ, \q उपवास के साथ, और रोने के साथ, और छाती पीटने के साथ।
hi.B: फिर भी अब भी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, \q अपने पूरे मन से मेरी ओर लौट आओ, \q उपवास करते, रोते और शोक मनाते हुए।
hi.R: पर अब भी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं, \q अपने पूरे मन से मेरे पास लौट आओ। \q उपवास करो, रोओ और शोक मनाओ।

ru.L: Но и теперь, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — \q обратитесь ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} всем вашим сердцем, \q и с постом, и с плачем, и с рыданием.
ru.B: Но даже и теперь, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — \q вернитесь ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} всем сердцем, \q с постом, плачем и рыданием.
ru.R: Но даже теперь, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — \q вернитесь ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} всем сердцем. \q Поститесь, плачьте и горюйте.

ja.L: しかし今でも――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉―― \q 心を尽くしてわたしに立ち帰れ。 \q 断食と、泣くことと、嘆くことをもって。
ja.B: しかし今からでも、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。 \q 心を尽くして、わたしに立ち帰りなさい。 \q 断食し、泣き、嘆き悲しんで。
ja.R: しかし今からでも、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q 心を尽くして、わたしのもとに立ち帰りなさい。 \q 食事をとらずに、泣き、悲しみなさい。

decisions.choice: return to me with all your heart: turn back to God in repentance
decisions.reason: To "return" is to turn back to God after turning away from him. Deuteronomy 4:30 and 30:2, 10 promise that if the people return to the LORD with all their heart, he will have compassion on them. Joel names no particular sin; the call is for a whole-hearted return.

decisions.choice: yet even now: though the day is near, it is not too late
decisions.reason: After the terror of verses 1-11, the LORD himself speaks. Even with the army at the gates there is still time to turn.

decisions.choice: fasting, weeping and mourning: the signs of grief and repentance
decisions.reason: These were the outward acts of people who humbled themselves before God, as in the fast called in 1:14. Verse 13 says what must go with them.

decisions.choice: declares the LORD (L, B); says the LORD (R)
decisions.reason: The prophetic formula follows the wording set in Isaiah. The LORD's own words take no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: "revenez" at every level for the call to return (shuv), here and in 2:13-14
decisions.reason: The French prophets keep "revenir" at every level for this verb, so the call to come back to God and God's own turning in 2:14 use the same word.

decisions.choice: "volver(se) a mí" (L, B); "regresar a mí" (R)
decisions.reason: Shuv of repentance is "volver" / "volverse", never "arrepentirse", as the Spanish terms note for Jeremiah sets; Readable "regresar" as Jeremiah 3 R.

decisions.choice: "asema BWANA" (L, B); "anasema BWANA" (R)
decisions.reason: The prophets' formula ne'um YHWH, as 2 Kings 19:33 and the Isaiah and Jeremiah blocks; recorded once for Joel, Amos and Obadiah.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA phán vậy" (L, B); "CHÚA phán" (R)
decisions.reason: The formula for "declares the LORD" (ne'um YHWH) is the one settled for Isaiah and Jeremiah; mid-verse it follows a comma. Recorded once for Joel, Amos and Obadiah.

decisions.choice: "các ngươi" for the people at every level
decisions.reason: God speaking to the people as a group says "các ngươi" at every level, as in the Isaiah and Jeremiah note; "các con" is kept for places where the Hebrew calls them children. Recorded once for Joel, Amos and Obadiah.

decisions.choice: *ne'um YHWH* is "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다" (L) and "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다" (B, R), standing as its own clause; God names himself without -시-
decisions.reason: The prophetic formula as Isaiah and Jeremiah settled it, used through Joel, Amos and Obadiah.

decisions.choice: *shuv* is "돌아오다" at every level
decisions.reason: As Jeremiah: the Hebrew pictures turning back to God; "회개하다" stays for the Greek of the New Testament.

decisions.choice: declara o SENHOR (L, B); diz o SENHOR (R); voltem (vocês)
decisions.reason: The formula takes the wording Isaiah and Jeremiah use in Portuguese, "declara o SENHOR" at Literal and Balanced and "diz o SENHOR" at Readable. The LORD speaks to the whole people, so the plural "vocês"; his words take no quotation marks, as in the English.

decisions.choice: "ይላል እግዚአብሔር" for neʾum YHWH, after the words, and "ተመለሱ" for shuv
decisions.reason: The prophets' formulas as Isaiah and Jeremiah have them in Amharic.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है (L, B); {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं (R)
decisions.reason: The prophets note's formula for neum YHWH, as in Isaiah, one wording per level through Joel. God speaks to the people with तुम.

decisions.choice: — слово ГОСПОДА, — (L); — говорит ГОСПОДЬ, — (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Prophets' formula for "declares the LORD" (neum YHWH), one wording per level through the books.

decisions.choice: ne'um YHWH "――主の言葉――" (L), "と主は告げる" (B), "と主は言う" (R), the ISA formula; shuv "立ち帰る" every level (ISA, AMO 4:6).
decisions.reason: The prophetic formula table.

source.text: וְקִרְע֤וּ לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְאַל־בִּגְדֵיכֶ֔ם וְשׁ֖וּבוּ אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־חַנּ֤וּן וְרַחוּם֙ ה֔וּא אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֨יִם֙ וְרַב־חֶ֔סֶד וְנִחָ֖ם עַל־הָרָעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And tear your heart and not your garments, and return to Yahweh your God; for gracious and compassionate [is] he, long of anger and great of loyal love, and relenting over the evil.

en.L: And tear your heart and not your clothes, \q and return to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, \q for gracious and compassionate [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}, \q long of anger and great in loyal love, \q and relenting over disaster.
en.B: Tear your hearts, not your clothes, \q and turn back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, \q for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is gracious and full of tender compassion, \q slow to grow angry and rich in loyal love, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} relents from sending disaster.
en.R: Do not just tear your clothes to show your sorrow. Let your hearts be torn. \q Come back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. \q He is kind and full of tender mercy. \q He is slow to become angry, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love is great. \q He is ready to change {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mind and not send disaster.

pt.L: E rasguem o coração de vocês, e não as suas roupas, \q e voltem para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, \q porque misericordioso e compassivo [é] {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, \q longo de ira e grande em amor leal, \q e que volta atrás quanto à desgraça.
pt.B: Rasguem o coração, e não as suas roupas, \q e voltem para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é misericordioso e compassivo, \q lento para se irar e cheio de amor leal, \q e desiste de mandar a desgraça.
pt.R: Não basta rasgar as roupas para mostrar a sua tristeza. Deixem que o coração de vocês seja rasgado. \q Voltem para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês. \q Ele é bondoso e cheio de compaixão. \q Ele demora a ficar irado, e o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor fiel é grande. \q Ele está pronto a mudar de ideia e não mandar a desgraça.

fr.L: Et déchirez votre cœur et non vos vêtements, \q et revenez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu, \q car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [est] favorable et compatissant, \q lent à la colère et grand en amour loyal, \q et renonçant au malheur.
fr.B: Déchirez vos cœurs et non vos vêtements, \q et revenez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu, \q car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est plein de grâce et de tendre compassion, \q lent à se mettre en colère et riche en amour fidèle, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} renonce à envoyer le malheur.
fr.R: Ne vous contentez pas de déchirer vos vêtements pour montrer votre tristesse. C’est votre cœur qui doit être déchiré. \q Revenez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu. \q Il est plein de bonté et de tendresse. \q Il ne {{deity_pronoun:se|Se}} met pas vite en colère, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle est grand. \q Il est prêt à renoncer à envoyer le malheur.

es.L: {{plural_you:Rasguen|Rasgad}} {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}} y no {{plural_you:sus vestidos|vuestros vestidos}}, \q y {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, \q porque benévolo y compasivo [es] {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q lento para la ira y grande en amor leal, \q y se retracta del mal.
es.B: {{plural_you:Desgarren|Desgarrad}} {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}}, no solo {{plural_you:su ropa|vuestra ropa}}, \q y {{plural_you:vuélvanse|volveos}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es benévolo y lleno de tierna compasión, \q lento para enojarse y rico en amor fiel, \q y desiste de enviar el desastre.
es.R: No {{plural_you:rasguen|rasguéis}} solo {{plural_you:su ropa|vuestra ropa}} para mostrar {{plural_you:su dolor|vuestro dolor}}. {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} que se desgarre {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}}. \q {{plural_you:Regresen|Regresad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}. \q Él es bondadoso y lleno de tierna compasión. \q No se enoja fácilmente, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel es grande. \q Está dispuesto a cambiar de parecer y no enviar el desastre.

sw.L: Na rarueni mioyo yenu wala si mavazi yenu, \q mkamrudie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, \q kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ni] mwenye neema na mwenye huruma, \q mkawivu wa hasira na mwingi wa upendo usiokoma, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} anaghairi kuhusu mabaya.
sw.B: Rarueni mioyo yenu, wala si mavazi yenu, \q mkamrudie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, \q kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mwenye neema na mwenye huruma ya moyoni, \q anayechelewa kukasirika na aliyejaa upendo usiokoma, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} hughairi kuleta maafa.
sw.R: Msirarue mavazi yenu tu ili kuonyesha huzuni yenu. Mioyo yenu na iraruke. \q Mrudieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu. \q Yeye ni mwema, tena amejaa huruma. \q Hakasiriki upesi, na upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma ni mkubwa. \q Yuko tayari kubadili nia {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} asilete maafa.

vi.L: Hãy xé lòng các ngươi chứ đừng xé áo các ngươi, \q và hãy quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hay ban ơn và đầy lòng thương xót, \q chậm giận và dồi dào tình yêu thương thành tín, \q và đổi ý về tai họa.
vi.B: Hãy xé lòng mình, đừng xé áo, \q và hãy quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đầy ân điển và lòng trắc ẩn, \q chậm nóng giận và giàu tình yêu thương thành tín, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đổi ý, không giáng tai họa.
vi.R: Đừng chỉ xé áo để tỏ lòng buồn rầu. Hãy để lòng các ngươi tan vỡ. \q Hãy trở về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi. \q Ngài nhân từ và đầy lòng thương xót. \q Ngài chậm giận, và tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn lao. \q Ngài sẵn lòng đổi ý và không giáng tai họa.

ko.L: 너희 마음을 찢고 너희 옷은 찢지 말아라. \q 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아오너라. \q 그분은 은혜롭고 긍휼이 많으시며, \q 분노를 오래 참으시고 한결같은 사랑이 크시며, \q 재앙에 대하여 뜻을 돌이키신다.
ko.B: 옷을 찢지 말고 마음을 찢어라. \q 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아오너라. \q 그분은 은혜를 베푸시고 불쌍히 여기시며, \q 쉽게 노하지 않으시고 한결같은 사랑이 넘치신다. \q 그분은 재앙을 내리시려다가도 뜻을 돌이키신다.
ko.R: 슬픔을 나타내려고 옷만 찢지 말고, 너희 마음을 찢어라. \q 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아오너라. \q 그분은 친절을 베푸시고 따뜻한 사랑으로 불쌍히 여기신다. \q 좀처럼 화를 내지 않으시고, 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 크다. \q 그분은 마음을 바꾸셔서 재앙을 내리지 않으신다.

am.L: ልባችሁን ቅደዱ እንጂ ልብሳችሁን አይደለም፤ \q ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላካችሁም ተመለሱ፤ \q እርሱ ቸርና ርኅሩኅ [ነው]ና፤ \q ለቁጣ የዘገየ፣ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም የበዛ፣ \q ስለ ጥፋትም የሚጸጸት [ነው]።
am.B: ልብሳችሁን ሳይሆን ልባችሁን ቅደዱ፤ \q ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላካችሁ ተመለሱ፤ \q እርሱ ጸጋ የሞላውና ርኅሩኅ ነውና፤ \q ቶሎ የማይቆጣ፣ በጽኑ ፍቅርም የበለጸገ፣ \q ጥፋትንም ከማምጣት የሚጸጸት ነው።
am.R: ሐዘናችሁን ለማሳየት ልብሳችሁን ብቻ አትቅደዱ፤ ልባችሁ ይቀደድ። \q ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላካችሁ ተመለሱ። \q እርሱ ቸርና እጅግ የሚራራ ነው። \q ቶሎ አይቆጣም፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ታላቅ ነው። \q ሐሳቡን ለውጦ ጥፋትን ላለማምጣት ዝግጁ ነው።

hi.L: और अपना मन फाड़ो, अपने कपड़े नहीं, \q और अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर लौट आओ, \q क्योंकि वे अनुग्रहकारी और दयालु [हैं], \q कोप करने में धीरजवंत और अटल प्रेम से भरपूर, \q और विपत्ति के विषय में पछतानेवाले।
hi.B: अपने कपड़े नहीं, अपने मन फाड़ो, \q और अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर लौट आओ, \q क्योंकि वे अनुग्रह और कोमल करुणा से भरे हैं, \q क्रोध करने में धीमे और अटल प्रेम के धनी, \q और विपत्ति भेजने से अपना मन बदल लेते हैं।
hi.R: दुख दिखाने के लिए केवल अपने कपड़े मत फाड़ो। अपने मन को टूटने दो। \q अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के पास लौट आओ। \q वे कृपालु हैं और कोमल दया से भरे हैं। \q वे जल्दी क्रोधित नहीं होते, और उनका अटल प्रेम महान है। \q वे अपना मन बदलने और विपत्ति न भेजने को तैयार रहते हैं।

ru.L: И разорвите ваше сердце, а не ваши одежды, \q и обратитесь к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вашему Богу, \q потому что милостив и сострадателен {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}, \q долгий на гнев и великий в неизменной любви, \q и сожалеющий о бедствии.
ru.B: Разорвите сердца ваши, а не одежды \q и вернитесь к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вашему Богу, \q потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} полон милости и сострадания, \q медленный на гнев, богатый неизменной любовью, \q и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} отказывается от того, чтобы послать бедствие.
ru.R: Не только одежды рвите в знак скорби. Пусть разорвутся ваши сердца. \q Вернитесь к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вашему Богу. \q Он добр и полон нежного сострадания. \q Он не спешит гневаться, и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} верная любовь велика. \q Он готов изменить своё решение и не посылать беду.

ja.L: あなたがたの衣ではなく、あなたがたの心を引き裂け。 \q あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に立ち帰れ。 \q その方は恵み深く、あわれみ深く、 \q 怒るのに長くかかり、誠実に富み、 \q 災いについて思い直される[方]だからだ。
ja.B: 衣ではなく、心を引き裂きなさい。 \q あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に立ち帰りなさい。 \q その方は、恵みと優しいあわれみに満ちた方であり、 \q 怒るのに遅く、変わることのないいつくしみに富み、 \q 災いを下すことを思い直される方だからだ。
ja.R: 悲しみを表すために、衣を裂くだけではいけない。心を引き裂きなさい。 \q あなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に立ち帰りなさい。 \q その方は優しく、あわれみ深い方だ。 \q なかなか怒られない。その変わらない愛は大きい。 \q その方は、災いを下すことについて、考えを変えてくださる方だ。

decisions.choice: tear your heart and not your garments: inward sorrow, not only its outward sign
decisions.reason: Tearing one's clothes was the usual sign of grief or horror (Genesis 37:34; 2 Kings 22:11). The prophet does not forbid it, but asks for what it was meant to show: a heart broken over sin.

decisions.choice: gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and great in loyal love: the words the LORD proclaimed to Moses
decisions.reason: These words come from Exodus 34:6, where the LORD tells Moses his name and what he is like. They are repeated through Scripture (Numbers 14:18; Psalm 103:8; 145:8; Nehemiah 9:17). Joel, like Jonah 4:2, puts "gracious" first, leaves out "and faithfulness", and adds "and relenting over disaster". The reason to return is who the LORD has shown himself to be.

decisions.choice: relenting over disaster: willing to hold back the harm he has threatened
decisions.reason: To "relent" is to change one's mind and hold back what was planned. The LORD relented from the disaster he had threatened against Israel at Sinai (Exodus 32:12, 14), and he promises to relent when a nation turns from its evil (Jeremiah 18:8; compare Amos 7:3, 6). The word for "disaster" is the common word for evil, here meaning harm, not wrongdoing, as in Jeremiah 4:6.

decisions.choice: the wording of Exodus 34:6 at each level, with hesed as loyal love (L, B) and faithful love (R)
decisions.reason: Where Joel quotes Exodus 34:6, each level reuses the published wording: "compassionate and gracious", "long of anger" and "great in" (L); "tender compassion" and "slow to grow angry" (B); "tender mercy", "kindness", "slow to become angry" and "his faithful love is great" (R). Joel's order, "gracious" first, is kept at Literal and Balanced. The word hesed follows the wording set for the prophets: "loyal love" at Literal and Balanced, where Exodus has "steadfast love" and "faithful love", and "faithful love" at Readable, as Exodus.

decisions.choice: Do not just tear your clothes to show your sorrow. Let your hearts be torn.
decisions.reason: Readable explains why people tore their clothes (m1) and puts the command for the heart second, so that the contrast is clear.

decisions.choice: "mkawivu wa hasira", "mwingi wa upendo usiokoma" (L); "anayechelewa kukasirika", "aliyejaa upendo usiokoma" (B); "Hakasiriki upesi", "upendo wake usiokoma" (R)
decisions.reason: Joel quotes Exodus 34:6, so each level reuses the published Swahili of that verse; only the Hebrew order "gracious and compassionate" differs from Exodus. Hesed is "upendo usiokoma" at every level, so the English open question about loyal / steadfast love does not arise in Swahili.

decisions.choice: "anaghairi", "hughairi" (L, B); "kubadili nia yake" (R)
decisions.reason: As Jeremiah 18:8: "kughairi" is to call off what one intended; "kutubu" is avoided because it means repenting of sin.

decisions.choice: the words of the published Vietnamese Exodus 34:6 at each level ("thương xót", "ban ơn", "chậm giận", "tình yêu thương thành tín" at L; "ân điển", "lòng trắc ẩn", "chậm nóng giận" at B; "nhân từ", "thương xót", "tình thương không hề thay đổi" at R), in Joel's order
alternatives: Exodus 34:6 copied in its own order
decisions.reason: Joel quotes the LORD's self-description to Moses, so the Vietnamese reuses the Exodus 34:6 wording at each level. Joel puts "gracious" before "compassionate" (Exodus has the reverse), so the two words follow Joel's order. The prophets' "tình yêu thương thành tín" for hesed is already the Exodus word.

decisions.choice: "đổi ý về tai họa" (L); "đổi ý, không giáng tai họa" (B); "sẵn lòng đổi ý và không giáng tai họa" (R)
decisions.reason: As Exodus 32:12, 14: "đổi ý" for God relenting, never "ăn năn" or "hối hận", which would suggest God had done wrong.

decisions.choice: The phrases of the Korean Exodus 34:6 at each level ("긍휼이 많고 은혜로운", "분노를 오래 참고", "한결같은 사랑" L; "불쌍히 여기며 은혜를 베푸는", "쉽게 노하지 않으며" B; "따뜻한 사랑으로 불쌍히 여기고 친절을 베푸는", "좀처럼 화를 내지 않는", "변함없는 사랑" R), in Joel's order (gracious first) and with -시- because the prophet speaks about God
decisions.reason: The term sheet asks the Exodus 34:6 echoes to reuse the published Korean so the quotation is visible. In Exodus God proclaims his own name and takes no -시-; here the prophet speaks of him. Korean says "한결같은 사랑" for both "loyal" and "steadfast" love, so the English open question does not change the Korean.

decisions.choice: "benévolo y compasivo ... lento para la ira y grande en amor leal" (L); "rico en amor fiel" (B); "amor fiel" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of Spanish Exodus 34:6 L ("compasivo y benévolo, lento para la ira") in Joel's Hebrew order; hesed is "amor leal" (L) and "amor fiel" (B, R), Exodus 34:6's words level by level. Every quotation of Exodus 34:6-7 in these books (Joel 2:13, Jonah 4:2, Micah 7:18-20) takes Exodus' wording.

decisions.choice: "Rasguen su corazón y no sus vestidos" (L); "Desgarren su corazón, no solo su ropa" (B)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets, so that Balanced and Readable stay clear of the familiar older wording. "No solo" at B says what the contrast means: the outward sign is not condemned, only an outward sign alone.

decisions.choice: "se retracta del mal"
decisions.reason: God relenting is "retractarse" at Literal, as Jeremiah 18:8 and 26:13 L; B "desiste", R "cambiar de parecer".

decisions.choice: the French words of Exodus 34:6 in Joel's order: "favorable et compatissant, lent à la colère" (L); "plein de grâce et de tendre compassion, lent à se mettre en colère" (B); "plein de bonté et de tendresse ... ne se met pas vite en colère" (R); hesed "amour loyal" (L) / "amour fidèle" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Joel quotes the confession of Exodus 34:6 with its first two words swapped (gracious before compassionate), so French reuses the published Exodus wording at each level in Joel's order. Hesed follows the prophets: "amour loyal" at Literal, "amour fidèle" at Balanced and Readable, as Exodus 34:6 reads too.

decisions.choice: "renonçant au malheur" (L); "renonce à envoyer le malheur" (B, R)
decisions.reason: God relenting is "renoncer à" in the French prophets, never "se repentir", which would suggest a fault in God.

decisions.choice: the Portuguese of Exodus 34:6: misericordioso e compassivo, longo de ira, grande em amor leal (L); lento para se irar, cheio de amor leal (B); bondoso, cheio de compaixão, demora a ficar irado (R); amor fiel (R)
decisions.reason: Joel quotes Exodus 34:6 (m2), so each level reuses its Portuguese words: "compassivo" for the tender love and "misericordioso" for kindness not earned, "longo de ira" (L) / "lento para se irar" (B) / "demora a ficar irado" (R). Joel puts "gracious" first, so the pair is "misericordioso e compassivo" (L, B) and Readable says "bondoso e cheio de compaixão". Readable says "amor fiel", the Readable word for hesed set for the prophets, where Exodus Readable says "amor leal". Joel leaves out "and faithfulness", and so does the Portuguese.

decisions.choice: volta atrás (L); desiste (B); mudar de ideia (R)
decisions.reason: To relent (m3) takes the words of Exodus 32:12-14 in Portuguese: "voltar atrás" (L), "desistir" (B), "mudar de ideia" (R). "Arrepender-se" is avoided, since it suggests sorrow for a wrong done. Verse 14 repeats the verb.

decisions.choice: the formula of Exodus 34:6 in Joel's order (gracious first): L "ቸርና ርኅሩኅ ... ለቁጣ የዘገየ፣ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም የበዛ"; B "ጸጋ የሞላውና ርኅሩኅ ... ቶሎ የማይቆጣ፣ በጽኑ ፍቅርም የበለጸገ"; R "ቸርና እጅግ የሚራራ ... ቶሎ አይቆጣም፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ታላቅ ነው"
decisions.reason: The words are those the LORD proclaimed to Moses (Exodus 34:6 on main); the Hebrew here puts "gracious" before "compassionate", as Psalm 145:8 and Nehemiah 9:17 do, and their Amharic is kept.

decisions.choice: niḥam "የሚጸጸት" (relents), the same verb as 2:14
decisions.reason: Relenting is turning from the harm he had threatened (the meaning decision); "ተጸጸተ" is the verb Jeremiah's Amharic uses for it, and verse 14 picks it up.

decisions.choice: the wording of Exodus 34:6 at each level: अनुग्रहकारी, दयालु, कोप करने में धीरजवंत, अटल प्रेम (L); अनुग्रह, कोमल करुणा, क्रोध करने में धीमे, अटल प्रेम के धनी (B); कृपालु, दयालु, जल्दी क्रोधित नहीं होते, उनका अटल प्रेम महान है (R)
decisions.reason: Joel quotes the LORD's words to Moses (meaning decision m2), so each level reuses the Hindi of Exodus 34:6 in this translation, in Joel's order (gracious before compassionate), with hesed as अटल प्रेम. The LORD's relenting is worded at Balanced as in Jonah 4:2, which has the same line (विपत्ति भेजने से अपना मन बदल लेते हैं).

decisions.choice: the wording of Exodus 34:6: долгий на гнев, великий в неизменной любви (L); медленный на гнев, богатый неизменной любовью (B); не спешит гневаться, верная любовь (R)
alternatives: благ и милосерд, долготерпелив и многомилостив
decisions.reason: Joel quotes the LORD's words to Moses, so each level reuses Exodus 34:6 in this translation, in Joel's order (gracious before compassionate). Hesed is "неизменная любовь" for God at L and B, "верная любовь" at R, as Exodus 34:6.

decisions.choice: The Exodus 34:6 formula in the forms Jonah 4:2 settled, per level, in the third person: "恵み深く、あわれみ深く、怒るのに長くかかり、誠実に富み、災いについて思い直される" (L); "恵みと優しいあわれみに満ちた方…怒るのに遅く、変わることのないいつくしみに富み、災いを下すことを思い直される" (B); "優しく、あわれみ深い…なかなか怒られない。その変わらない愛は大きい…考えを変えてくださる" (R).
decisions.reason: The English gives Exodus 34:6's wording at each level; the JON notes fixed the Japanese for Joel 2:13 so that the confession reads the same wherever it is quoted.

decisions.choice: R "悲しみを表すために、衣を裂くだけではいけない。心を引き裂きなさい。", as the English R.
decisions.reason: Explains the gesture of tearing clothes (m1).

source.text: מִ֥י יוֹדֵ֖עַ יָשׁ֣וּב וְנִחָ֑ם וְהִשְׁאִ֤יר אַֽחֲרָיו֙ בְּרָכָ֔ה מִנְחָ֣ה וָנֶ֔סֶךְ לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Who knows? He will turn and relent, and leave behind him a blessing, a grain offering and a drink offering for Yahweh your God.

en.L: Who knows [whether] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will turn and relent, \q and leave behind {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a blessing, \q a grain offering and a drink offering \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God?
en.B: Who knows? He may turn back and relent, \q and leave behind {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a blessing: \q grain offerings and drink offerings \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.R: Who knows? Perhaps {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will change {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mind and not punish you. \q Perhaps {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will leave you a blessing. \q Then you will have grain and wine to offer \q to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.

pt.L: Quem sabe [se] {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não se virará e voltará atrás, \q e deixará atrás de {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}} uma bênção, \q oferta de cereal e oferta de bebida \q para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês?
pt.B: Quem sabe? Talvez {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se volte e desista, \q e deixe atrás de {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}} uma bênção: \q ofertas de cereal e ofertas de bebida \q para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês.
pt.R: Quem sabe? Talvez {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mude de ideia e não castigue vocês. \q Talvez {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deixe uma bênção para vocês. \q Então vocês vão ter cereal e vinho para oferecer \q {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus de vocês.

fr.L: Qui sait s’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} reviendra et renoncera, \q et laissera derrière {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} une bénédiction, \q une offrande de grain et une libation \q pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu ?
fr.B: Qui sait ? Il pourrait revenir et renoncer, \q et laisser derrière {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} une bénédiction : \q des offrandes de grain et des libations \q pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.
fr.R: Qui sait ? Peut-être qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} changera d’avis et ne vous punira pas. \q Peut-être qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous laissera une bénédiction. \q Alors vous aurez du grain et du vin à offrir \q {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu.

es.L: ¿Quién sabe [si] {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se volverá y se retractará, \q y dejará tras {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}} una bendición, \q ofrenda de cereal y libación \q para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}?
es.B: ¿Quién sabe? Tal vez se vuelva y desista, \q y deje tras {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}} una bendición: \q ofrendas de cereal y libaciones \q para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.
es.R: ¿Quién sabe? Tal vez {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cambie de parecer y no {{plural_you:los|os}} castigue. \q Tal vez {{plural_you:les|os}} deje una bendición. \q Entonces {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} grano y vino para ofrecer \q {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.

sw.L: Ni nani ajuaye [kama] {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atageuka na kughairi, \q na kuacha baraka nyuma {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q sadaka ya nafaka na sadaka ya kinywaji \q kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu?
sw.B: Ni nani ajuaye? Huenda akageuka na kughairi, \q akaacha baraka nyuma {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}: \q sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za kinywaji \q kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.
sw.R: Ni nani ajuaye? Huenda atabadili nia {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} asiwaadhibu. \q Huenda atawaachia baraka. \q Ndipo mtakuwa na nafaka na divai ya kumtolea \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.

vi.L: Ai biết được [liệu] {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ quay lại và đổi ý, \q và để lại sau {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một phước lành, \q một tế lễ ngũ cốc và một lễ quán \q cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi?
vi.B: Ai biết được? Có thể {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ quay lại và đổi ý, \q để lại sau {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một phước lành: \q những tế lễ ngũ cốc và lễ quán \q dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.
vi.R: Ai biết được? Có lẽ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đổi ý và không trừng phạt các ngươi. \q Có lẽ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ để lại cho các ngươi một phước lành. \q Bấy giờ các ngươi sẽ có lúa và rượu \q để dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.

ko.L: 누가 알겠느냐? 그분께서 돌이키시고 뜻을 돌이키셔서 \q 그분 뒤에 복을 남겨 두실지. \q 곡식 제물과 부어 드리는 제물을 \q 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 [드리게 하실지].
ko.B: 누가 알겠느냐? 그분께서 돌아서서 뜻을 돌이키시고 \q 지나가신 자리에 복을 남겨 주실지. \q 그러면 곡식 제물과 부어 드리는 제물을 \q 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바칠 수 있을 것이다.
ko.R: 누가 알겠느냐? 그분께서 마음을 바꾸셔서 너희를 벌하지 않으실지도 모른다. \q 너희에게 복을 남겨 주실지도 모른다. \q 그러면 너희는 곡식과 포도주를 \q 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바칠 수 있을 것이다.

am.L: ይመለስና ይጸጸት እንደ ሆነ፣ \q ከኋላውም በረከትን፣ \q የእህል ቁርባንንና የመጠጥ ቁርባንን \q {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አምላካችሁ ይተው እንደ ሆነ ማን ያውቃል?
am.B: ማን ያውቃል? ተመልሶ ይጸጸት ይሆናል፤ \q ከኋላውም በረከትን ይተው ይሆናል፤ \q የእህል ቁርባንንና የመጠጥ ቁርባንን \q {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አምላካችሁ።
am.R: ማን ያውቃል? ምናልባት ሐሳቡን ለውጦ አይቀጣችሁም። \q ምናልባት በረከትን ይተውላችሁ ይሆናል። \q ያን ጊዜ እህልና የወይን ጠጅ ይኖራችኋል፤ \q {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አምላካችሁ የምታቀርቡት።

hi.L: कौन जानता है [कि] वे फिरकर पछताएँ, \q और अपने पीछे आशीष छोड़ जाएँ, \q अन्नबलि और अर्घ \q तुम्हारे परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए?
hi.B: कौन जानता है? हो सकता है वे फिरें और पछताएँ, \q और अपने पीछे आशीष छोड़ जाएँ: \q अन्नबलि और अर्घ \q तुम्हारे परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए।
hi.R: कौन जानता है? शायद वे अपना मन बदल लें और तुम्हें दंड न दें। \q शायद वे तुम्हारे लिए आशीष छोड़ जाएँ। \q तब तुम्हारे पास अनाज और दाखमधु होगा, \q जिसे तुम अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को चढ़ा सको।

ru.L: Кто знает, [не] повернёт ли {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} и не пожалеет ли, \q и не оставит ли после себя благословение, \q хлебное приношение и возлияние \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вашему Богу?
ru.B: Кто знает? Может быть, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} повернёт назад и смилуется \q и оставит после себя благословение: \q хлебные приношения и возлияния \q для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, вашего Бога.
ru.R: Кто знает? Может быть, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} изменит своё решение и не накажет вас. \q Может быть, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} оставит вам благословение. \q Тогда у вас будет зерно и вино, чтобы принести их в дар \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вашему Богу.

ja.L: だれが知ろうか、その方が立ち帰って思い直し、 \q 後に祝福を残されるかどうかを。 \q [それは]穀物のささげ物と注ぎの供え物、 \q あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}への[ささげ物だ]。
ja.B: だれにわかるだろう。その方が立ち帰って思い直し、 \q 後に祝福を残してくださるかもしれない。 \q 穀物のささげ物と注ぎの供え物を、 \q あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にささげるために。
ja.R: だれにわかるだろう。もしかすると、その方は考えを変えて、あなたたちを罰するのをやめてくださるかもしれない。 \q もしかすると、祝福を残してくださるかもしれない。 \q そうすれば、穀物とぶどう酒を、 \q あなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にささげることができる。

decisions.choice: who knows?: hope that does not presume on God
decisions.reason: The same words are spoken by the king of Nineveh (Jonah 3:9) and by David (2 Samuel 12:22). The people cannot force God's hand; they turn to him and hope in his mercy.

decisions.choice: leave behind him a blessing: as he turns back, he leaves a harvest behind
decisions.reason: The LORD is pictured as turning around and leaving a blessing in his tracks, where the locusts left ruin. The blessing is enough grain and wine for the offerings of 1:9 and 1:13 to be made again.

decisions.choice: change his mind and not punish you; grain and wine to offer
decisions.reason: Readable says what "turn and relent" means here (see verse 13) and what the grain offering and drink offering are made of.

decisions.choice: "ofrenda de cereal y libación"
decisions.reason: The grain offering and the drink offering in the words of the Spanish Pentateuch (Leviticus 23:13, 18).

decisions.choice: yashuv venicham "立ち帰って思い直し" (L, B), "考えを変えて" (R), as Jonah 3:9; mi yodea' "だれが知ろうか" (L), "だれにわかるだろう" (B, R).
decisions.reason: The same words as the king of Nineveh's hope in Jonah 3:9.

source.text: תִּקְע֥וּ שׁוֹפָ֖ר בְּצִיּ֑וֹן קַדְּשׁוּ־צ֖וֹם קִרְא֥וּ עֲצָרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Blow a ram's horn in Zion; consecrate a fast; call an assembly.

en.L: Blow a trumpet in Zion; \q set apart a fast; call a solemn assembly.
en.B: Blow the ram's horn in Zion! \q Proclaim a holy fast; call a solemn assembly.
en.R: Blow the trumpet in Zion! \q Announce a holy fast, a time to go without food. Call everyone to a special meeting.

pt.L: Toquem o chifre de carneiro em Sião; \q consagrem um jejum; convoquem uma reunião solene.
pt.B: Toquem o chifre de carneiro em Sião! \q Proclamem um jejum sagrado; convoquem uma reunião solene.
pt.R: Toquem a trombeta em Sião! \q Anunciem um jejum sagrado, um tempo de ficar sem comer. Chamem todo mundo para uma reunião especial.

fr.L: Sonnez du cor dans Sion ; \q consacrez un jeûne, convoquez une assemblée solennelle.
fr.B: Sonnez du cor dans Sion ! \q Proclamez un jeûne sacré, convoquez une assemblée solennelle.
fr.R: Sonnez de la trompette à Sion ! \q Annoncez un jeûne sacré, un temps où l’on se prive de nourriture. Appelez tout le monde à une réunion spéciale.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} trompeta en Sion; \q {{plural_you:consagren|consagrad}} un ayuno, {{plural_you:convoquen|convocad}} una asamblea solemne!
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} el cuerno de carnero en Sion! \q {{plural_you:Proclamen|Proclamad}} un ayuno santo; {{plural_you:convoquen|convocad}} una asamblea solemne.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} la trompeta en Sion! \q {{plural_you:Anuncien|Anunciad}} un ayuno santo, un tiempo para no comer. {{plural_you:Llamen|Llamad}} a todos a una reunión especial.

sw.L: Pigeni baragumu katika Sayuni; \q takaseni mfungo; iteni mkutano mtakatifu.
sw.B: Pigeni baragumu katika Sayuni! \q Tangazeni mfungo mtakatifu; iteni mkutano mtakatifu.
sw.R: Pigeni baragumu katika Sayuni! \q Tangazeni mfungo mtakatifu, wakati wa kutokula chakula. Waiteni watu wote waje kwenye mkutano maalum.

vi.L: Hãy thổi kèn tại Si-ôn; \q hãy biệt riêng một kỳ kiêng ăn; hãy triệu tập một buổi nhóm họp trọng thể.
vi.B: Hãy thổi tù và tại Si-ôn! \q Hãy công bố một kỳ kiêng ăn thánh; hãy triệu tập một buổi nhóm họp trọng thể.
vi.R: Hãy thổi kèn tại Si-ôn! \q Hãy công bố một kỳ kiêng ăn thánh, một thời gian nhịn ăn. Hãy kêu gọi mọi người đến một buổi họp đặc biệt.

ko.L: 시온에서 나팔을 불어라. \q 금식을 거룩하게 구별하고, 거룩한 모임을 소집하여라.
ko.B: 시온에서 숫양 뿔 나팔을 불어라! \q 거룩한 금식을 선포하고, 거룩한 모임을 소집하여라.
ko.R: 시온에서 나팔을 불어라! \q 음식을 먹지 않는 거룩한 금식을 알려라. 모든 사람을 특별한 모임에 불러 모아라.

am.L: በጽዮን መለከትን ንፉ፤ \q ጾምን ቀድሱ፤ የተከበረ ጉባኤን ጥሩ።
am.B: በጽዮን የቀንድ መለከት ንፉ! \q የተቀደሰ ጾም አውጁ፤ የተከበረ ጉባኤ ጥሩ።
am.R: በጽዮን መለከት ንፉ! \q የተቀደሰ ጾም አውጁ፤ ይህም ምግብ የማትበሉበት ጊዜ ነው። ሁሉም ሰው ወደ ልዩ ስብሰባ እንዲመጣ ጥሩ።

hi.L: सिय्योन में नरसिंगा फूँको; \q उपवास को पवित्र ठहराओ; पवित्र सभा बुलाओ।
hi.B: सिय्योन में नरसिंगा फूँको! \q पवित्र उपवास का प्रचार करो; पवित्र सभा बुलाओ।
hi.R: सिय्योन में नरसिंगा फूँको! \q पवित्र उपवास की घोषणा करो, ऐसा समय जब लोग भोजन नहीं करते। सब लोगों को एक विशेष सभा के लिए बुलाओ।

ru.L: Трубите в трубу на Сионе, \q освятите пост, созовите торжественное собрание.
ru.B: Трубите в рог на Сионе! \q Объявите святой пост, созовите торжественное собрание.
ru.R: Трубите в трубу на Сионе! \q Объявите святой пост — время, когда никто не ест. Созовите всех на особое собрание.

ja.L: シオンでラッパを吹け。 \q 断食を聖別せよ。聖なる集会を召集せよ。
ja.B: シオンで角笛を吹き鳴らしなさい。 \q 聖なる断食を布告し、聖なる集会を召集しなさい。
ja.R: シオンでラッパを吹きなさい！ \q 聖なる断食を知らせなさい。食事をとらずに祈る時だ。みんなを特別な集まりに呼びなさい。

decisions.choice: the trumpet of 2:1 and the fast of 1:14, now together
decisions.reason: The first words repeat 2:1, the rest repeat 1:14. The trumpet that sounded the alarm of war now calls the people to the fast and assembly of repentance.

decisions.choice: trumpet (L, R); ram's horn (B); the wording of 1:14 for the fast
decisions.reason: The shofar, a ram's horn, follows the wording set in Isaiah when it stands alone: "trumpet" at Literal and Readable, "ram's horn" at Balanced. The call to the fast and the assembly uses the wording of 1:14 at each level.

decisions.choice: "asamblea solemne"
decisions.reason: The solemn assembly as in 2 Kings 10:20 and 2 Chronicles 7:9.

decisions.choice: *'atsarah* is "거룩한 모임" (L, B) and "특별한 모임" (R), settled for Joel here
decisions.reason: The published Korean for the festival assembly (Exodus 12:16; 2 Chronicles 7:9); "성회" is the older church word. Readable explains it as a special gathering, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: the horn as 2:1; the fast and assembly in the words of 1:14
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 2:1 and 1:14 (m1), so each level repeats their Portuguese.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2:1 and 1:14
decisions.reason: The trumpet of 2:1 and the fast and assembly of 1:14 return together (meaning decision m1), so each level repeats their Hindi words.

source.text: אִסְפוּ־עָ֞ם קַדְּשׁ֤וּ קָהָל֙ קִבְצ֣וּ זְקֵנִ֔ים אִסְפוּ֙ עֽוֹלָלִ֔ים וְיֹנְקֵ֖י שָׁדָ֑יִם יֵצֵ֤א חָתָן֙ מֵֽחֶדְר֔וֹ וְכַלָּ֖ה מֵחֻפָּתָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Gather [the] people; consecrate [the] congregation; assemble [the] elders; gather [the] children and those sucking [the] breasts; let go out [the] bridegroom from his room and [the] bride from her chamber.

en.L: Gather the people; consecrate the congregation; assemble the elders; \q gather the children, \q even infants at the breast; \q let the bridegroom come out of his room, \q and the bride out of her chamber.
en.B: Gather the people; make the assembly holy; bring together the elders; \q gather the children, \q even babies nursing at the breast. \q Let the bridegroom leave his own room \q and the bride her wedding chamber.
en.R: Bring all the people together. Prepare them for the holy meeting. Gather the elders, \q the children, and even the babies who are still nursing. \q Let the bridegroom and the bride leave their rooms and come too.

pt.L: Reúnam o povo; consagrem a assembleia; ajuntem os anciãos; \q reúnam as crianças, \q até os bebês que mamam no peito; \q saia o noivo do seu quarto, \q e a noiva do seu aposento.
pt.B: Reúnam o povo; santifiquem a assembleia; juntem os anciãos; \q reúnam as crianças, \q até os bebês que ainda mamam. \q Que o noivo deixe o seu quarto, \q e a noiva, o seu aposento nupcial.
pt.R: Juntem todo o povo. Preparem todos para a reunião sagrada. Reúnam os anciãos, \q as crianças e até os bebês que ainda mamam. \q Que o noivo e a noiva saiam dos seus quartos e venham também.

fr.L: Rassemblez le peuple ; consacrez l’assemblée ; réunissez les anciens ; \q rassemblez les enfants, \q même ceux qui tètent les seins ; \q que l’époux sorte de sa chambre, \q et l’épouse de son alcôve.
fr.B: Rassemblez le peuple, sanctifiez l’assemblée, réunissez les anciens ; \q rassemblez les enfants, \q même les bébés qu’on allaite. \q Que le jeune marié quitte sa chambre, \q et la mariée sa chambre nuptiale.
fr.R: Rassemblez tout le peuple. Préparez-le pour la réunion sacrée. Réunissez les anciens, \q les enfants, et même les bébés qu’on allaite encore. \q Que le jeune marié et la jeune mariée quittent leur chambre et viennent eux aussi.

es.L: {{plural_you:Reúnan|Reunid}} al pueblo; {{plural_you:santifiquen|santificad}} la congregación; {{plural_you:junten|juntad}} a los ancianos; \q {{plural_you:reúnan|reunid}} a los niños, \q aun a los que maman del pecho; \q salga el novio de su alcoba, \q y la novia de su cámara.
es.B: {{plural_you:Reúnan|Reunid}} al pueblo; {{plural_you:purifiquen|purificad}} a la asamblea; {{plural_you:congreguen|congregad}} a los ancianos; \q {{plural_you:junten|juntad}} a los niños, \q aun a los bebés que todavía maman. \q Que el novio deje su habitación \q y la novia su cámara nupcial.
es.R: {{plural_you:Reúnan|Reunid}} a todo el pueblo. {{plural_you:Prepárenlo|Preparadlo}} para la reunión santa. {{plural_you:Junten|Juntad}} a los ancianos, \q a los niños y aun a los bebés que todavía maman. \q Que también el novio y la novia salgan de sus habitaciones y vengan.

sw.L: Kusanyeni watu; takaseni kusanyiko; kusanyeni wazee; \q kusanyeni watoto, \q hata wanaonyonya matiti; \q bwana arusi na atoke chumbani mwake, \q na bibi arusi katika chumba chake.
sw.B: Wakusanyeni watu; litakaseni kusanyiko; waleteni pamoja wazee; \q wakusanyeni watoto, \q hata watoto wachanga wanaonyonya. \q Bwana arusi na atoke chumbani mwake, \q na bibi arusi katika chumba chake cha arusi.
sw.R: Waleteni watu wote pamoja. Waandaeni kwa ajili ya mkutano mtakatifu. Wakusanyeni wazee, \q watoto, na hata watoto wachanga ambao bado wananyonya. \q Bwana arusi na bibi arusi waache vyumba vyao, nao waje pia.

vi.L: Hãy tập hợp dân chúng; hãy thánh hóa hội chúng; hãy nhóm các trưởng lão; \q hãy tập hợp trẻ con, \q cả trẻ còn bú; \q hãy để chàng rể ra khỏi phòng mình, \q và cô dâu ra khỏi phòng cưới của nàng.
vi.B: Hãy nhóm họp dân chúng; hãy làm cho hội chúng nên thánh; hãy quy tụ các trưởng lão; \q hãy tập hợp trẻ con, \q cả những em bé đang bú mẹ. \q Hãy để chàng rể rời phòng riêng \q và cô dâu rời phòng cưới.
vi.R: Hãy tập hợp toàn dân lại. Hãy chuẩn bị họ cho buổi họp thánh. Hãy quy tụ các trưởng lão, \q trẻ con, và cả những em bé còn bú mẹ. \q Hãy bảo chàng rể và cô dâu rời phòng mình mà đến dự nữa.

ko.L: 백성을 모으고, 회중을 거룩하게 하며, 장로들을 불러 모아라. \q 아이들을 모으고, \q 젖 먹는 아기들까지 [모아라]. \q 신랑은 자기 방에서 나오게 하고, \q 신부도 자기 신방에서 나오게 하여라.
ko.B: 백성을 모으고, 회중을 거룩하게 구별하며, 장로들을 불러 모아라. \q 아이들도 모으고, \q 젖을 먹는 아기들까지 모아라. \q 신랑도 자기 방에서 나오게 하고, \q 신부도 신방에서 나오게 하여라.
ko.R: 모든 백성을 불러 모아라. 거룩한 모임을 위해 그들을 준비시켜라. 장로들을 모으고, \q 아이들과 아직 젖을 먹는 아기들까지 모아라. \q 신랑과 신부도 자기 방에서 나와 함께 오게 하여라.

am.L: ሕዝቡን ሰብስቡ፤ ጉባኤውን ቀድሱ፤ ሽማግሌዎችን አከማቹ፤ \q ሕፃናትን ሰብስቡ፤ \q ጡት የሚጠቡትንም እንኳ፤ \q ሙሽራው ከእልፍኙ ይውጣ፤ \q ሙሽሪቱም ከጫጉላ ቤቷ።
am.B: ሕዝቡን ሰብስቡ፤ ጉባኤውን ቀድሱ፤ ሽማግሌዎችን አሰባስቡ፤ \q ልጆችን፣ \q ጡት የሚጠቡ ሕፃናትንም እንኳ ሰብስቡ። \q ሙሽራው ከክፍሉ ይውጣ፤ \q ሙሽሪቱም ከጫጉላ ቤቷ።
am.R: ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ሰብስቡ። ለተቀደሰው ስብሰባ አዘጋጁአቸው። ሽማግሌዎችን፣ \q ልጆችን፣ ገና ጡት የሚጠቡትን ሕፃናትም እንኳ ሰብስቡ። \q ሙሽራውና ሙሽሪቱም ከክፍላቸው ወጥተው ይምጡ።

hi.L: लोगों को इकट्ठा करो; मंडली को पवित्र करो; पुरनियों को जमा करो; \q बच्चों को इकट्ठा करो, \q दूध पीते शिशुओं को भी; \q दूल्हा अपनी कोठरी से निकल आए, \q और दुल्हन अपने कमरे से।
hi.B: लोगों को इकट्ठा करो; सभा को पवित्र करो; बुज़ुर्ग अगुवों को एकत्र करो; \q बच्चों को इकट्ठा करो, \q दूध पीते शिशुओं को भी। \q दूल्हा अपना कमरा छोड़ दे \q और दुल्हन अपना विवाह-कक्ष।
hi.R: सब लोगों को एक साथ लाओ। उन्हें पवित्र सभा के लिए तैयार करो। बुज़ुर्गों को इकट्ठा करो, \q बच्चों को, और उन शिशुओं को भी जो अभी दूध पीते हैं। \q दूल्हा और दुल्हन भी अपने कमरे छोड़कर आ जाएँ।

ru.L: Соберите народ, освятите общину, созовите старейшин, \q соберите детей \q и сосущих грудь; \q пусть выйдет жених из своей комнаты \q и невеста из своего покоя.
ru.B: Соберите народ, освятите собрание, созовите старейшин, \q соберите детей, \q даже младенцев у груди. \q Пусть жених выйдет из своей комнаты \q и невеста — из брачного покоя.
ru.R: Соберите весь народ. Подготовьте людей к святому собранию. Созовите старейшин, \q детей и даже грудных младенцев. \q Пусть жених и невеста тоже выйдут из своих комнат и придут.

ja.L: 民を集めよ。会衆を聖別せよ。長老たちを呼び集めよ。 \q 幼子たちを集めよ、 \q 乳房を吸う乳飲み子までも。 \q 花婿はその部屋から、 \q 花嫁はその寝室から出よ。
ja.B: 民を集め、会衆を聖別し、長老たちを呼び集めなさい。 \q 子どもたちを集めなさい。 \q 乳を飲む赤ん坊までも。 \q 花婿は自分の部屋を出、 \q 花嫁も婚礼の部屋を出て来るように。
ja.R: すべての民を集めなさい。聖なる集まりのために、民の身を清めさせなさい。長老たちを集め、 \q 子どもたちも、まだ乳を飲んでいる赤ちゃんまでも集めなさい。 \q 花婿も花嫁も、自分たちの部屋を出て、一緒に来なさい。

decisions.choice: consecrate the congregation: prepare the people to come before God
decisions.reason: Before meeting God the people made themselves ritually clean, washing their clothes and keeping apart from what made them unclean, including sexual relations (Exodus 19:10, 14-15). This may be why even the newly married are called.

decisions.choice: the bridegroom and the bride: not even the newly married are excused
decisions.reason: A newly married man was freed from going to war or other duties for a year (Deuteronomy 24:5). No one is excused from this assembly. The word for the bride's "chamber" is used of the wedding canopy or room (Psalm 19:6).

decisions.choice: everyone, from the elders to the nursing babies
decisions.reason: The list runs from the oldest to the youngest, the whole people with no exception, as in the call of 1:14.

decisions.choice: Let the bridegroom and the bride leave their rooms and come too.
decisions.reason: Readable joins the two lines about the bridegroom and the bride and says why they leave: to come to the assembly.

decisions.choice: a assembleia
decisions.reason: The gathered people (qahal) is "a assembleia", as the terms list has it; the solemn assembly of 1:14 and 2:15 is a different word, "reunião solene".

decisions.choice: освятите общину (L); освятите собрание (B)
decisions.reason: Consecrate the congregation is to prepare the people to come before God (meaning decision); Literal keeps the Pentateuch's "община" for qahal here as the English keeps "congregation".

source.text: בֵּ֤ין הָאוּלָם֙ וְלַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ יִבְכּוּ֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וְֽיֹאמְר֞וּ ח֧וּסָה יְהוָ֣ה עַל־עַמֶּ֗ךָ וְאַל־תִּתֵּ֨ן נַחֲלָתְךָ֤ לְחֶרְפָּה֙ לִמְשָׁל־בָּ֣ם גּוֹיִ֔ם לָ֚מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ בָֽעַמִּ֔ים אַיֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Between the porch and the altar let weep the priests, ministers of Yahweh, and let them say, Spare, Yahweh, your people, and do not give your inheritance to reproach, to a byword among them, nations. Why should they say among the peoples, Where [is] their God?

en.L: Between the porch and the altar \q let the priests weep, \q the ministers of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and let them say, "Spare {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and do not make {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} inheritance a reproach, a byword among the nations. \q Why should it be said among the peoples, \q 'Where [is] their God?'"
en.B: Between the porch and the altar \q let the priests weep, \q those who serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q Let them pray, "Have pity on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! Do not let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} inheritance become a disgrace, a byword among the nations. \q Why should the peoples be allowed to say, \q 'Where is their God?'"
en.R: The priests who serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} should weep \q between the altar and the entrance to the temple. \q They should pray, "{{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, have pity on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people. Do not let other nations make fun of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people and use their name as an insult. \q Why should the nations be able to say, 'Where is their God?'"

pt.L: Entre o pórtico e o altar \q chorem os sacerdotes, \q os ministros {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q e digam: "Poupa o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e não faças da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} herança um opróbrio, motivo de zombaria entre as nações. \q Por que se diria entre os povos: \q 'Onde [está] o Deus deles?'"
pt.B: Entre o pórtico e o altar \q chorem os sacerdotes, \q os que servem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. \q Que eles orem: "Tem compaixão do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}! Não deixes que a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} herança se torne uma vergonha, alvo de zombaria entre as nações. \q Por que os povos haveriam de dizer: \q 'Onde está o Deus deles?'"
pt.R: Os sacerdotes que servem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} devem chorar \q entre o altar e a entrada do templo. \q Devem orar: "{{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, tem pena do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo. Não deixes que outras nações zombem do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo e usem o nome dele como insulto. \q Por que as nações poderiam dizer: 'Onde está o Deus deles?'"

fr.L: Entre le vestibule et l’autel, \q que les prêtres pleurent, \q les serviteurs {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q et qu’ils disent : « Épargne {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et ne livre pas {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} héritage à l’opprobre, à la risée des nations. \q Pourquoi dirait-on parmi les peuples : \q “Où [est] leur Dieu ?” »
fr.B: Entre le vestibule et l’autel, \q que les prêtres pleurent, \q ceux qui servent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Qu’ils prient : « Aie pitié de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Ne laisse pas {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} héritage devenir une honte, la risée des nations. \q Pourquoi laisserait-on les peuples dire : \q “Où est leur Dieu ?” »
fr.R: Les prêtres qui servent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} doivent pleurer \q entre l’autel et l’entrée du temple. \q Qu’ils prient : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, aie pitié de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple. Ne laisse pas les autres nations se moquer de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple et se servir de son nom comme d’une insulte. \q Pourquoi les nations pourraient-elles dire : “Où est leur Dieu ?” »

es.L: Entre el pórtico y el altar \q lloren los sacerdotes, \q los ministros {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q y digan: «Ten piedad, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, y no entregues {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} heredad al oprobio, a ser refrán entre las naciones. \q ¿Por qué se ha de decir entre los pueblos: \q “¿Dónde [está] su Dios?”?»
es.B: Entre el pórtico y el altar \q lloren los sacerdotes, \q los que sirven {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. \q Que oren así: «¡Ten compasión de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! No permitas que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} heredad sea deshonrada, que las naciones hagan de ella un refrán. \q ¿Por qué se ha de permitir que los pueblos digan: \q “¿Dónde está su Dios?”?»
es.R: Los sacerdotes que sirven {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} deben llorar \q entre el altar y la entrada del templo. \q Deben orar así: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ten compasión de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo. No dejes que otras naciones se burlen de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo y usen su nombre como insulto. \q ¿Por qué han de poder decir las naciones: “¿Dónde está su Dios?”?»

sw.L: Kati ya baraza na madhabahu \q makuhani na walie, \q wahudumu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na waseme, "Wahurumie watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wala usiufanye urithi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kuwa aibu, mithali ya dhihaka kati ya mataifa. \q Kwa nini isemwe kati ya mataifa, \q 'Mungu wao yuko wapi?'"
sw.B: Kati ya baraza na madhabahu \q makuhani na walie, \q wale wanaomtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Na waombe, "Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uwahurumie watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}! Usiuache urithi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} uwe aibu, kitu cha kudhihakiwa kati ya mataifa. \q Kwa nini mataifa yaachwe yaseme, \q 'Mungu wao yuko wapi?'"
sw.R: Makuhani wanaomtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na walie \q kati ya madhabahu na mlango wa hekalu. \q Na waombe, "Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uwahurumie watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. Usiyaache mataifa mengine yawadhihaki watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na kulitumia jina lao kama tusi. \q Kwa nini mataifa yaweze kusema, 'Mungu wao yuko wapi?'"

vi.L: Giữa tiền sảnh và bàn thờ, \q hãy để các thầy tế lễ khóc lóc, \q là những người phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q và hãy để họ nói: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin tha cho dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và đừng để cơ nghiệp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thành sự sỉ nhục, thành câu châm biếm giữa các dân tộc. \q Sao lại để người ta nói giữa các dân: \q 'Đức Chúa Trời của họ ở đâu?'"
vi.B: Giữa tiền sảnh và bàn thờ, \q hãy để các thầy tế lễ khóc lóc, \q là những người phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Hãy để họ cầu nguyện: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin thương xót dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Xin đừng để cơ nghiệp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở thành sự sỉ nhục, thành trò cười giữa các dân tộc. \q Sao lại để các dân nói rằng: \q 'Đức Chúa Trời của họ ở đâu?'"
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hãy khóc lóc \q giữa bàn thờ và lối vào đền thờ. \q Họ hãy cầu nguyện: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin thương xót dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Xin đừng để các dân tộc khác chế nhạo dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và lấy tên họ làm lời lăng mạ. \q Sao lại để các dân nói được rằng: 'Đức Chúa Trời của họ ở đâu?'"

ko.L: 현관과 제단 사이에서 \q 제사장들이 울게 하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기는 자들이 \q 말하게 하여라. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 백성을 아껴 주십시오. 주님의 소유를 민족들 사이에서 수치와 조롱거리가 되게 하지 마십시오. \q 어찌하여 백성들 가운데서 \q '그들의 하나님이 어디 있느냐?' 하고 말하게 하겠습니까?"
ko.B: 현관과 제단 사이에서 \q 제사장들이 울게 하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기는 사람들이 \q 이렇게 기도하게 하여라. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 백성을 불쌍히 여겨 주십시오! 주님의 소유가 수치를 당하고 민족들 사이에서 조롱거리가 되게 하지 마십시오. \q 어찌하여 여러 민족이 \q '그들의 하나님이 어디 있느냐?' 하고 말하게 두시겠습니까?"
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기는 제사장들은 \q 제단과 성전 입구 사이에서 울어야 한다. \q 그들은 이렇게 기도해야 한다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 백성을 불쌍히 여겨 주십시오. 다른 민족들이 주님의 백성을 비웃고, 그 이름을 욕하는 말로 쓰지 못하게 해 주십시오. \q 어찌하여 그 민족들이 '그들의 하나님이 어디 있느냐?' 하고 말하게 두시겠습니까?"

am.L: በበረንዳውና በመሠዊያው መካከል \q ካህናቱ ያልቅሱ፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} አገልጋዮች፤ \q እንዲህም ይበሉ፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ለሕዝብህ ራራ፤ ርስትህንም ስድብ፣ በአሕዛብም መካከል መተረቻ አታድርገው። \q በሕዝቦች መካከል ለምን \q “አምላካቸው ወዴት [ነው]?” ይባላል?»
am.B: በበረንዳውና በመሠዊያው መካከል \q ካህናቱ ያልቅሱ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚያገለግሉት። \q እንዲህ ብለውም ይጸልዩ፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ለሕዝብህ ራራ! ርስትህ መሰደቢያ፣ በአሕዛብም መካከል መተረቻ እንዲሆን አትፍቀድ። \q ሕዝቦችስ ለምን \q “አምላካቸው የት አለ?” ይበሉ?»
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚያገለግሉ ካህናት \q በመሠዊያውና በቤተ መቅደሱ መግቢያ መካከል ያልቅሱ። \q እንዲህም ብለው ይጸልዩ፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ለሕዝብህ ራራ። ሌሎች ሕዝቦች በሕዝብህ ላይ እንዲያፌዙና ስማቸውን መሳደቢያ እንዲያደርጉ አትፍቀድ። \q ሕዝቦች “አምላካቸው የት አለ?” ብለው ለምን ይናገራሉ?»

hi.L: ओसारे और वेदी के बीच \q याजक रोएँ, \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सेवक, \q और वे कहें, "हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपनी प्रजा पर तरस खा, और अपने निज भाग को नामधराई और जातियों के बीच कहावत न बनने दे। \q देश-देश के लोगों में क्यों कहा जाए, \q 'उनका परमेश्वर कहाँ [है]?'"
hi.B: ओसारे और वेदी के बीच \q याजक रोएँ, \q वे जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की सेवा करते हैं। \q वे प्रार्थना करें, "हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपनी प्रजा पर दया कर! अपने निज भाग को अपमान का कारण, देशों के बीच कहावत न बनने दे। \q देश-देश के लोग क्यों कहने पाएँ, \q 'उनका परमेश्वर कहाँ है?'"
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की सेवा करनेवाले याजक \q वेदी और मंदिर के द्वार के बीच रोएँ। \q वे प्रार्थना करें, "हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपनी प्रजा पर दया कर। दूसरे देशों को अपने लोगों का मज़ाक़ उड़ाने और उनके नाम को गाली की तरह इस्तेमाल करने न दे। \q दूसरे देश क्यों कहने पाएँ, 'उनका परमेश्वर कहाँ है?'"

ru.L: Между притвором и жертвенником \q пусть плачут священники, \q служители {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q и пусть скажут: «Пощади, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} народ и не отдай {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} наследие на позор, на посмешище среди народов. \q Зачем говорить среди племён: \q “Где их Бог?”»
ru.B: Между притвором и жертвенником \q пусть плачут священники, \q служащие {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}. \q Пусть они молятся: «Сжалься, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, над {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} народом! Не дай {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} наследию стать позором, притчей среди народов. \q Почему народам должно быть позволено говорить: \q “Где же их Бог?”»
ru.R: Священники, которые служат {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, пусть плачут \q между жертвенником и входом в храм. \q Пусть молятся: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, сжалься над {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} народом. Не позволяй другим народам насмехаться над {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} народом и превращать его имя в оскорбление. \q Почему другие народы должны говорить: “Где их Бог?”»

ja.L: 玄関の間と祭壇との間で、 \q 祭司たちは泣くがよい、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に仕える者たちは。 \q そして言うがよい。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの民を惜しんでほしい。あなたの嗣業をそしりとし、国々の間で笑いぐさとしないでほしい。 \q なぜ、諸国の民の間で言われてよいだろうか。 \q 『彼らの神はどこにいるのか』と。」
ja.B: 玄関の間と祭壇の間で、 \q 祭司たちは泣くがよい。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に仕える者たちは。 \q そして、こう祈るがよい。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの民をあわれんでほしい！あなたの嗣業を恥とし、国々の間で物笑いの種としないでほしい。 \q どうして、諸国の民に \q 『彼らの神はどこにいるのか』と言わせてよいだろうか。」
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に仕える祭司たちは、泣くがよい。 \q 祭壇と神殿の入り口の間で。 \q そして、こう祈るがよい。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの民をあわれんでほしい。ほかの国々が、あなたの民をばかにし、その名をののしりの言葉に使うことがないようにしてほしい。 \q どうして、国々に『彼らの神はどこにいるのか』と言わせてよいだろうか。」

decisions.choice: between the porch and the altar: in the court of the temple, where the priests stood
decisions.reason: The porch was the entrance hall at the front of the temple, and the great altar of burnt offering stood in the courtyard before it. The space between them was the priests' place (Ezekiel 8:16; Matthew 23:35).

decisions.choice: your inheritance: Israel, the people the LORD has made his own
decisions.reason: An inheritance is a family's own land, held for good. Moses prayed with the same words, "do not destroy your people, your inheritance" (Deuteronomy 9:26, 29).

decisions.choice: a byword among the nations: a people whose name others use in mockery
alternatives: so that the nations rule over them
decisions.reason: The word, as the Hebrew is pointed, is a verb meaning "to rule", and the line can be read "so that the nations rule over them". Next to "reproach", and with 2:19 answering "I will no longer make you a reproach among the nations", it is read here as the noun for a proverb or byword: a people mocked by others (Deuteronomy 28:37; Jeremiah 24:9).

decisions.choice: "Where is their God?": the taunt of the nations
decisions.reason: The same taunt is heard in Psalm 79:10 and 115:2 and Micah 7:10. If God's people are left in ruin, the nations will say that their God could not or would not help them. The priests appeal to God's concern for his own name.

decisions.choice: Have pity on (B, R); Spare (L)
decisions.reason: The verb means to look on with pity and spare. Balanced and Readable say "have pity on". The priests' prayer takes double quotation marks, and the nations' words inside it take single ones.

decisions.choice: make fun of your people and use their name as an insult
decisions.reason: Readable explains "a reproach, a byword" (m3).

decisions.choice: "le vestibule" (L, B) for the temple porch
decisions.reason: The French name for the entrance hall of the temple, as 1 Kings 6:3 and the term sheet for Ezekiel; Readable says "l'entrée du temple" as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "la risée des nations" (L, B) for the byword
alternatives: "un sujet de proverbe parmi les nations"
decisions.reason: French "risée" says a people whose name others use in mockery (the meaning decision) in one common word.

decisions.choice: "Ten piedad" (L); "Ten compasión" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in 2:18 for the LORD's answer, so L has "tener piedad" in both verses and B and R "tener compasión" / "compadecerse", letting the reader see the prayer answered.

decisions.choice: «... “¿Dónde está su Dios?”?»
decisions.reason: The nations' taunt is quoted inside the priests' prayer, with “ ” inside « », and the outer question closes after it, as Psalms 79:10 and 115:2 in Spanish.

decisions.choice: "baraza" (L, B); "mlango wa hekalu" (R)
decisions.reason: The temple porch is "baraza", as 1 Kings 6:3; Readable names the place plainly, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Lạy CHÚA, xin ..." placed first in the prayer
alternatives: "Xin tha cho dân Ngài, lạy CHÚA"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese puts the address "Lạy CHÚA" at the head of a prayer; the people speak of God as "Ngài", as in the prayers of the Psalms.

decisions.choice: "tiền sảnh" (L, B); "lối vào đền thờ" (R)
decisions.reason: The temple porch ('ulam) is "tiền sảnh", as 1 Kings 6:3 and the term sheet; Readable says where it was, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The priests' prayer is 합쇼체, addressing God as "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여" and "주님" ("아껴 주십시오", "불쌍히 여겨 주십시오")
decisions.reason: Prayers in the prophets are 합쇼체 with the vocative name and "주님" (Isaiah and Jeremiah notes).

decisions.choice: "주님의 소유" for "your inheritance"
decisions.reason: The people the LORD has made his own; "기업" is the older word and is opaque to most readers today.

decisions.choice: Poupa (L); Tem compaixão (B); tem pena (R); "tu" to God
decisions.reason: The priests pray to God with "tu" (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4). The verb (r-en-1) is "poupar" at Literal and "ter compaixão" / "ter pena" at Balanced and Readable; verse 18 answers with the same words at Balanced and Readable. "Opróbrio" (L) and "vergonha" (B) return in verse 19, where the LORD answers this prayer.

decisions.choice: "ራራ" for "spare, have pity" (the verb of 2:18) and "ርስትህ" for your inheritance
decisions.reason: The LORD's answer in 2:18 uses the same Hebrew verb ("ለሕዝቡም ራራ"), so the prayer and its answer share one Amharic verb. Inheritance (naḥalah) is "ርስት", as the Pentateuch list has it.

decisions.choice: तरस खा (L); दया कर (B, R); निज भाग (L, B)
decisions.reason: The verb means to look on with pity and spare; Balanced and Readable say दया कर, as the English says "have pity". The priests pray to God with तू. "Your inheritance" is Israel (meaning decision m2), निज भाग as in the earlier books.

decisions.choice: «Где их Бог?»
decisions.reason: The nations' taunt in the words Psalms 79:10 and 115:2 use in this translation.

decisions.choice: The priests' prayer, inside the oracle, is plain with requests "〜てほしい / 〜ないでほしい", as the ISA convention (and Hosea 14:3); chus "惜しむ" (L, Jonah 4:10), "あわれむ" (B, R, as the English "have pity").
alternatives: "どうか…惜しんでください" (です・ます)
decisions.reason: Prayers inside a verse oracle keep the plain poetic voice; a reviewer may prefer 〜てください, as the Psalms.

decisions.choice: nachalah "嗣業" (L, B; PSA 2:8); mashal "笑いぐさ" (L), "物笑いの種" (B); 'ulam "玄関の間" (L, B, as 1 Kings 6:3), R "神殿の入り口".
decisions.reason: Keeps the settled temple and inheritance words.

records.literal_gloss: And Yahweh became jealous for his land and had pity on his people.

en.L: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} became jealous for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} land \q and had pity on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people.
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} became jealous for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} land \q and took pity on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people.
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} showed how deeply {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cared for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} land, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had pity on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people.

pt.L: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} foi zeloso pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} terra \q e teve compaixão do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo.
pt.B: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se encheu de zelo pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} terra \q e teve compaixão do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo.
pt.R: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} mostrou quanto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se importava com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} terra, \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} teve pena do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo.

fr.L: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fut jaloux pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} pays \q et eut pitié de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:se|Se}} montra jaloux pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} pays \q et prit pitié de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a montré combien {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} tenait à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} pays, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a eu pitié de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.

es.L: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se llenó de celo por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} tierra \q y tuvo piedad de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se mostró celoso por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} tierra \q y se compadeció de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo.
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mostró cuánto amaba {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} tierra, \q y tuvo compasión de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo.

sw.L: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaona wivu kwa ajili ya nchi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} \q akawahurumia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaionea wivu nchi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} \q akawaonea huruma watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaonyesha jinsi alivyoijali sana nchi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q akawahurumia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

vi.L: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi lòng ghen vì đất của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và thương xót dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi lòng ghen yêu vì đất của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và động lòng thương xót dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tỏ ra {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hết lòng quý mến đất của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thương xót dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 땅을 위하여 질투하시고 \q 그분의 백성을 불쌍히 여기셨다.
ko.B: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 땅을 위하여 열정을 품으시고 \q 그분의 백성을 불쌍히 여기셨다.
ko.R: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 땅을 얼마나 깊이 아끼시는지 보여 주셨다. \q 그분은 그분의 백성을 불쌍히 여기셨다.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ለምድሩ ቀና፤ \q ለሕዝቡም ራራ።
am.B: ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለምድሩ ቀና፤ \q ለሕዝቡም ራራ።
am.R: ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለምድሩ ምን ያህል እንደሚያስብ አሳየ፤ \q ለሕዝቡም ራራ።

hi.L: तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को अपने देश के लिए जलन हुई, \q और उन्होंने अपनी प्रजा पर तरस खाया।
hi.B: तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने देश के लिए जलन से भर गए \q और उन्होंने अपनी प्रजा पर दया की।
hi.R: तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने दिखाया कि वे अपने देश की कितनी गहरी चिंता करते हैं, \q और उन्होंने अपनी प्रजा पर दया की।

ru.L: И возревновал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} о своей земле \q и пощадил свой народ.
ru.B: Тогда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} возревновал о своей земле \q и сжалился над своим народом.
ru.R: Тогда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} показал, как сильно {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} заботится о своей земле, \q и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сжалился над своим народом.

ja.L: そこで、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はご自分の地のために熱情を燃やし、 \q ご自分の民をあわれまれた。
ja.B: すると{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分の地のために熱情を燃やし、 \q ご自分の民をあわれまれた。
ja.R: そこで{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分の地をどれほど深く心にかけておられるかを示し、 \q ご自分の民をあわれまれた。

decisions.choice: then the LORD became jealous: the turning point of the book
alternatives: a promise: the LORD will become jealous
decisions.reason: The verbs are the ones Hebrew uses to tell what happened next. The people did what the LORD asked, and he answered (verse 19). From here on the book is promise. Some read the verbs as a promise of what the LORD will do, but the Hebrew forms most naturally tell of what he did.

decisions.choice: jealous: the LORD's passionate, protective love for what is his
decisions.reason: The word describes a strong love that will not let what belongs to it be harmed or taken. With the LORD as subject it is often turned against his enemies on behalf of his people (Zechariah 1:14; 8:2; Isaiah 9:6).

decisions.choice: had pity: the same verb as "spare" in the priests' prayer
decisions.reason: The priests prayed, "Spare your people" (verse 17), and the LORD "spared", had pity on, his people. The answer uses the words of the prayer.

decisions.choice: showed how deeply he cared for (R)
decisions.reason: Readable avoids "jealous", which in everyday English suggests envy, and says what the word means here (m2).

decisions.choice: "nổi lòng ghen" (L); "nổi lòng ghen yêu" (B)
decisions.reason: The LORD's jealousy here is protective love for what is his (meaning decision); Literal keeps the published "ghen" (1 Kings 14:22), and Balanced adds "yêu" so the word cannot be read as envy.

decisions.choice: "질투하시고" (L); "열정을 품으시고" (B); "깊이 아끼시는지" (R)
decisions.reason: In Korean "질투" is mostly petty envy; Balanced and Readable say the protective, passionate love the meaning decision describes, and Literal keeps the familiar biblical word.

decisions.choice: passé simple at L and B ("fut jaloux", "répondit"); passé composé at R ("a montré", "a répondu") for 2:18-19a
decisions.reason: These two verses report what the LORD did, the turning point of the book (the meaning decision), so they are narrative, told as French written narrative tells it; the LORD's answer that follows is speech again.

decisions.choice: foi zeloso (L); se encheu de zelo (B)
decisions.reason: The word is the LORD's protective love for what is his (m2). Portuguese "ciúme" now suggests suspicion of a rival, so Literal and Balanced use "zelo"; Readable says what it means, as the English. "Teve compaixão" (L, B) and "teve pena" (R) answer the prayer of verse 17 (m3); Literal cannot repeat "poupar" here and still say "had pity".

decisions.choice: qinneʾ as "ቀና" (became jealous for)
decisions.reason: Amharic "ቀና ለ" is the jealous, protective love of "the jealous God" ("የሚቀና አምላክ", Exodus 20:5); the meaning decision says it is love for what is his, not envy.

decisions.choice: जलन (L, B); कितनी गहरी चिंता करते हैं (R)
decisions.reason: God's jealousy is जलन, as Exodus 34:14 in this translation; it is his protective love for what is his (meaning decision m2). Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does, since जलन alone can sound like envy.

decisions.choice: qinne' "熱情を燃やし" (L, B), R "どれほど深く心にかけておられるかを示し" as the English R; chamal "あわれまれた" every level, with light respect forms.
decisions.reason: "ねたむ" for a land reads as envy in Japanese; "熱情" is the Exodus B form for the LORD's jealous love (m2).

source.text: וַיַּ֨עַן יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְעַמּ֗וֹ הִנְנִ֨י שֹׁלֵ֤חַ לָכֶם֙ אֶת־הַדָּגָן֙ וְהַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֔ר וּשְׂבַעְתֶּ֖ם אֹת֑וֹ וְלֹא־אֶתֵּ֨ן אֶתְכֶ֥ם ע֛וֹד חֶרְפָּ֖ה בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And Yahweh answered and said to his people, Here I am sending to you the grain and the new wine and the fresh oil, and you will be satisfied with it; and I will not make you again a reproach among the nations.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} answered and said to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people: Look, I am sending you the grain, the new wine, and the fresh oil, \q and you will be satisfied with it; \q and I will no longer make you a reproach among the nations.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} answered {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people and said: I am sending you grain, new wine, and olive oil, \q and you will have all you want. \q Never again will I make you a disgrace among the nations.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} answered {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. He said: I am sending you grain, wine, and olive oil. \q You will have plenty to eat and drink. \q I will never again let the other nations make fun of you.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} respondeu e disse ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo: Eis que eu estou enviando a vocês o cereal, o vinho novo e o azeite fresco, \q e vocês ficarão saciados com isso; \q e não farei mais de vocês um opróbrio entre as nações.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} respondeu ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo e disse: Estou enviando a vocês cereal, vinho novo e azeite, \q e vocês terão tudo o que quiserem. \q Nunca mais farei de vocês uma vergonha entre as nações.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} respondeu ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo. Ele disse: Estou mandando a vocês cereal, vinho e azeite. \q Vocês vão ter bastante para comer e beber. \q Nunca mais vou deixar que as outras nações zombem de vocês.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} répondit et dit à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple : Voici, je vous envoie le grain, le vin nouveau et l’huile fraîche, \q et vous en serez rassasiés ; \q et je ne ferai plus de vous un opprobre parmi les nations.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} répondit à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple : Je vous envoie le grain, le vin nouveau et l’huile d’olive, \q et vous en aurez autant que vous voudrez. \q Jamais plus je ne ferai de vous la honte des nations.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a répondu à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. Il a dit : Je vous envoie du grain, du vin et de l’huile d’olive. \q Vous aurez largement de quoi manger et boire. \q Je ne laisserai plus jamais les autres nations se moquer de vous.

es.L: Y respondió {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y dijo a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo: He aquí, yo {{plural_you:les|os}} envío el grano, el mosto y el aceite fresco, \q y {{plural_you:se saciarán|os saciaréis}} de ello; \q y nunca más {{plural_you:los|os}} haré objeto de oprobio entre las naciones.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} respondió a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo y dijo: Yo {{plural_you:les|os}} envío grano, vino nuevo y aceite de oliva, \q y {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} todo lo que {{plural_you:quieran|queráis}}. \q Nunca más {{plural_you:los|os}} haré objeto de deshonra entre las naciones.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} respondió a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo y dijo: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} envío grano, vino y aceite de oliva. \q {{plural_you:Tendrán|Tendréis}} comida y bebida en abundancia. \q Nunca más dejaré que las otras naciones se burlen de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akajibu, akawaambia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}: Tazama, ninawapelekea nafaka, divai mpya na mafuta mapya, \q nanyi mtashiba navyo; \q wala sitawafanya tena kuwa aibu kati ya mataifa.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawajibu watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akasema: Ninawapelekea nafaka, divai mpya na mafuta ya zeituni, \q nanyi mtapata vyote mnavyotaka. \q Sitawafanya tena kamwe kuwa aibu kati ya mataifa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawajibu watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Akasema: Ninawapelekea nafaka, divai na mafuta ya zeituni. \q Mtakuwa na chakula na kinywaji tele. \q Sitayaacha tena kamwe mataifa mengine yawadhihaki.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp lời và phán với dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sai đến cho các ngươi lúa, rượu mới và dầu mới, \q và các ngươi sẽ được no nê với chúng; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không làm cho các ngươi thành sự sỉ nhục giữa các dân tộc nữa.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp lời dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và phán: Ta sẽ ban cho các ngươi lúa, rượu mới và dầu ô-liu, \q và các ngươi sẽ được thỏa thích. \q Ta sẽ không bao giờ để các ngươi thành sự sỉ nhục giữa các dân tộc nữa.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp lời dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài phán: Ta sẽ ban cho các ngươi lúa, rượu và dầu ô-liu. \q Các ngươi sẽ có dư dật để ăn uống. \q Ta sẽ không bao giờ để các dân tộc khác chế nhạo các ngươi nữa.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성에게 대답하여 말씀하셨다. 보라, 내가 너희에게 곡식과 새 포도주와 햇기름을 보내니, \q 너희가 그것으로 배부를 것이다. \q 내가 다시는 너희를 민족들 가운데서 수치가 되게 하지 않겠다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성에게 대답하셨다. 내가 너희에게 곡식과 새 포도주와 올리브기름을 보내겠다. \q 너희가 마음껏 먹고 마실 것이다. \q 다시는 내가 너희를 민족들 가운데서 수치를 당하게 하지 않겠다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성에게 대답하셨다. 그분께서 말씀하셨다. 내가 너희에게 곡식과 포도주와 올리브기름을 보내겠다. \q 너희는 먹고 마실 것이 넉넉할 것이다. \q 다시는 다른 민족들이 너희를 비웃지 못하게 하겠다.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም መለሰ፤ ለሕዝቡም እንዲህ አለ፦ እነሆ፣ እህልንና አዲሱን የወይን ጠጅ ዘይቱንም እልክላችኋለሁ፤ \q በእርሱም ትጠግባላችሁ፤ \q ከእንግዲህም በሕዝቦች መካከል ስድብ አላደርጋችሁም።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለሕዝቡ እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰ፦ እህልን፣ አዲስ የወይን ጠጅንና የወይራ ዘይትን እልክላችኋለሁ፤ \q የምትፈልጉትንም ሁሉ ታገኛላችሁ። \q ከእንግዲህ በሕዝቦች መካከል መሰደቢያ አላደርጋችሁም።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለሕዝቡ መለሰ። እንዲህ አለ፦ እህልን፣ የወይን ጠጅንና የወይራ ዘይትን እልክላችኋለሁ። \q የምትበሉትና የምትጠጡት በብዛት ይኖራችኋል። \q ከእንግዲህ ሌሎች ሕዝቦች እንዲያፌዙባችሁ አልፈቅድም።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपनी प्रजा को उत्तर दिया और कहा: देखो, मैं तुम्हारे पास अनाज, नया दाखमधु और ताज़ा तेल भेज रहा हूँ, \q और तुम उससे तृप्त होगे; \q और मैं फिर तुम्हें जातियों के बीच नामधराई का कारण न बनाऊँगा।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपनी प्रजा को उत्तर देकर कहा: मैं तुम्हारे पास अनाज, नया दाखमधु और जैतून का तेल भेज रहा हूँ, \q और तुम्हें जितना चाहिए उतना मिलेगा। \q मैं फिर कभी तुम्हें देशों के बीच अपमान का कारण नहीं बनाऊँगा।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपनी प्रजा को उत्तर दिया। उन्होंने कहा: मैं तुम्हारे पास अनाज, दाखमधु और जैतून का तेल भेज रहा हूँ। \q तुम्हारे पास खाने-पीने को भरपूर होगा। \q मैं फिर कभी दूसरे देशों को तुम्हारा मज़ाक़ उड़ाने नहीं दूँगा।

ru.L: И ответил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, и сказал своему народу: Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посылаю вам зерно, и молодое вино, и масло, \q и вы насытитесь им; \q и не сделаю вас больше позором среди народов.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} ответил своему народу и сказал: Я посылаю вам зерно, молодое вино и оливковое масло, \q и вы будете иметь вдоволь. \q Больше никогда не сделаю вас позором среди народов.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} ответил своему народу. Он сказал: Я посылаю вам зерно, вино и оливковое масло. \q У вас будет вдоволь еды и питья. \q Я больше никогда не позволю другим народам смеяться над вами.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は答えて、ご自分の民に言われた。見なさい、わたしはあなたがたに穀物と新しいぶどう酒と新しい油を送る。 \q あなたがたはそれで満ち足りる。 \q わたしは、もはやあなたがたを国々の間でそしりとはしない。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はご自分の民に答えて言われた。わたしはあなたがたに、穀物と新しいぶどう酒とオリーブ油を送る。 \q あなたがたは、それに満ち足りる。 \q わたしは二度と、あなたがたを国々の間で恥としない。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はご自分の民に答えて、こう言われた。わたしは、あなたたちに穀物とぶどう酒とオリーブ油を送る。 \q あなたたちは、食べ物にも飲み物にも困らなくなる。 \q わたしは二度と、ほかの国々にあなたたちをばかにさせない。

decisions.choice: the LORD answered: his answer runs on to the end of the chapter
decisions.reason: The LORD now speaks in the first person, answering the prayer of verse 17. His words run through verse 27, and the promises of chapter 3 continue in his voice.

decisions.choice: grain, new wine and fresh oil: the losses of 1:10 restored
