decisions.reason: The three products lost in 1:10 are given back, as in the promise of Hosea 2:24.

decisions.choice: no longer a reproach among the nations: the priests' prayer answered word for word
decisions.reason: The priests asked that the LORD's people not be made "a reproach" among the nations (verse 17). The LORD promises exactly that.

decisions.choice: no quotation marks for the LORD's words
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in the prophets, the LORD's own words take no quotation marks; a colon introduces them. The answer runs on through several verses (m1). Readable says "wine" for "new wine" and "olive oil" for "fresh oil", as Hosea 2:10.

decisions.choice: "el grano, el mosto y el aceite fresco" (L); "grano, vino nuevo y aceite de oliva" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The three harvests in the words of Deuteronomy 11:14 in Spanish (L "mosto", "aceite fresco"; B "vino nuevo").

decisions.choice: no quotation marks after "phán" for the LORD's answer
decisions.reason: As in the English and the prophets, God's first-person oracle takes no quotation marks; the answer runs to the end of the chapter.

decisions.choice: ḥerpah as "ስድብ" (L) and "መሰደቢያ" (B), the words of the priests' prayer in 2:17
decisions.reason: The answer takes up the prayer word for word (the meaning decision), so each level repeats its own word from 2:17.

decisions.choice: no quotation marks for the LORD's answer; God says तुम
decisions.reason: As the English, the LORD's own words take no quotation marks; a colon introduces them, and his answer runs on to the end of the chapter (meaning decision m1). God addresses his people with तुम.

decisions.choice: The LORD's words follow "言われた" without quotation marks, as the English; hinneni "見なさい、わたしは" (L) by the ISA hinneh rule, omitted at B and R as the English.
decisions.reason: The answer runs to the end of the chapter (m1), so no brackets open.

source.text: וְֽאֶת־הַצְּפוֹנִ֞י אַרְחִ֣יק מֵעֲלֵיכֶ֗ם וְהִדַּחְתִּיו֮ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ צִיָּ֣ה וּשְׁמָמָה֒ אֶת־פָּנָ֗יו אֶל־הַיָּם֙ הַקַּדְמֹנִ֔י וְסֹפ֖וֹ אֶל־הַיָּ֣ם הָאַֽחֲר֑וֹן וְעָלָ֣ה בָאְשׁ֗וֹ וְתַ֨עַל֙ צַחֲנָת֔וֹ כִּ֥י הִגְדִּ֖יל לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And the northerner I will remove far from you, and I will drive it into a land dry and desolate, its front into the eastern sea and its rear into the western sea; and its stench will go up, and its foul smell will rise; for it has done great things.

en.L: The northerner I will remove far from you and drive into a land dry and desolate, \q its front into the eastern sea, \q and its rear into the western sea; \q its stench will go up, and its foul smell will rise, \q for it has done great things.
en.B: I will drive the northern army far away from you, into a dry and desolate land, \q its vanguard into the eastern sea, \q and its rear into the western sea. \q Its stench will rise; its rotting smell will go up, \q for it has done great harm.
en.R: I will drive the army from the north far away from you, into a dry and empty land. \q Some of them will go into the Dead Sea in the east, \q and the rest into the Mediterranean Sea in the west. \q Their dead bodies will rot and stink, \q because of all the harm they have done.

pt.L: E o que vem do norte eu afastarei para longe de vocês e o lançarei numa terra seca e desolada, \q a sua frente para o mar oriental, \q e a sua retaguarda para o mar ocidental; \q e subirá o seu fedor, e subirá o seu mau cheiro, \q porque ele fez grandes coisas.
pt.B: Expulsarei para longe de vocês o exército do norte, para uma terra seca e desolada, \q a sua vanguarda para o mar do oriente, \q e a sua retaguarda para o mar do ocidente. \q O seu fedor subirá; o seu cheiro de podre se espalhará, \q pois ele fez grande mal.
pt.R: Vou expulsar para longe de vocês o exército que veio do norte, para uma terra seca e vazia. \q Uma parte deles vai cair no mar Morto, a leste, \q e o resto no mar Mediterrâneo, a oeste. \q Os corpos deles vão apodrecer e cheirar mal, \q por causa de todo o mal que eles fizeram.

fr.L: Celui du nord, je l’éloignerai de vous et je le chasserai vers une terre aride et désolée, \q sa tête vers la mer orientale, \q et sa queue vers la mer occidentale ; \q sa puanteur montera, et son odeur infecte s’élèvera, \q car il a fait de grandes choses.
fr.B: Je chasserai loin de vous l’armée du nord, vers une terre aride et désolée, \q son avant-garde vers la mer de l’est, \q et son arrière-garde vers la mer de l’ouest. \q Sa puanteur montera, son odeur de pourriture s’élèvera, \q car elle a fait de grands ravages.
fr.R: Je chasserai loin de vous l’armée venue du nord, vers un pays sec et vide. \q Une partie de ses soldats ira dans la mer Morte, à l’est, \q et le reste dans la mer Méditerranée, à l’ouest. \q Leurs cadavres pourriront et sentiront mauvais, \q à cause de tout le mal qu’ils ont fait.

es.L: Al del norte lo alejaré de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y lo arrojaré a una tierra seca y desolada, \q su frente hacia el mar oriental, \q y su retaguardia hacia el mar occidental; \q y subirá su hedor, y se levantará su pestilencia, \q porque ha hecho grandes cosas.
es.B: Alejaré de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} al ejército del norte y lo echaré a una tierra seca y desolada, \q su vanguardia al mar oriental \q y su retaguardia al mar occidental. \q Su hedor subirá; su olor a podrido se elevará, \q porque ha hecho mucho daño.
es.R: Echaré lejos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} al ejército del norte, a una tierra seca y vacía. \q Unos irán a parar al mar Muerto, en el oriente, \q y los demás al mar Mediterráneo, en el occidente. \q Sus cadáveres se pudrirán y apestarán, \q por todo el daño que han hecho.

sw.L: Na yule wa kaskazini nitamwondoa mbali nanyi, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitamfukuza aende katika nchi kavu na ya ukiwa, \q upande wake wa mbele kuelekea bahari ya mashariki, \q na upande wake wa nyuma kuelekea bahari ya magharibi; \q uvundo wake utapanda, na harufu yake mbaya itapanda, \q kwa maana amefanya mambo makubwa.
sw.B: Nitalifukuza jeshi la kaskazini mbali nanyi, hadi katika nchi kavu na ya ukiwa, \q askari wake wa mbele kuelekea bahari ya mashariki, \q na wa nyuma kuelekea bahari ya magharibi. \q Uvundo wake utapanda; harufu yake ya kuoza itapanda juu, \q kwa maana limefanya madhara makubwa.
sw.R: Nitalifukuza jeshi kutoka kaskazini mbali nanyi, hadi katika nchi kavu na tupu. \q Baadhi yao wataingia katika Bahari Mfu upande wa mashariki, \q na wengine katika Bahari ya Mediterania upande wa magharibi. \q Maiti zao zitaoza na kunuka, \q kwa sababu ya madhara yote waliyoyafanya.

vi.L: Kẻ từ phương bắc, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đuổi xa khỏi các ngươi và xua nó vào một xứ khô hạn và hoang vu, \q đầu nó hướng về biển phía đông, \q và đuôi nó về biển phía tây; \q mùi hôi thối của nó sẽ bốc lên, và mùi tanh tưởi của nó sẽ dâng lên, \q vì nó đã làm những việc lớn.
vi.B: Ta sẽ đuổi đạo quân phương bắc đi xa khỏi các ngươi, vào một xứ khô cằn và hoang vu, \q đạo tiền quân của nó vào biển phía đông, \q và đạo hậu quân vào biển phía tây. \q Mùi hôi thối của nó sẽ bốc lên; mùi xác rữa của nó sẽ dâng lên, \q vì nó đã gây ra bao nhiêu tai hại.
vi.R: Ta sẽ đuổi đạo quân từ phương bắc đi thật xa khỏi các ngươi, vào một xứ khô cằn và trống trải. \q Một số sẽ rơi xuống Biển Chết ở phía đông, \q và số còn lại xuống Biển Địa Trung Hải ở phía tây. \q Xác chúng sẽ thối rữa và bốc mùi hôi, \q vì mọi tai hại chúng đã gây ra.

ko.L: 북쪽에서 온 자를 내가 너희에게서 멀리 쫓아내어, 메마르고 황폐한 땅으로 몰아내겠다. \q 그 앞쪽은 동쪽 바다로, \q 그 뒤쪽은 서쪽 바다로 [몰아내겠다]. \q 그 악취가 올라오고, 그 썩는 냄새가 올라올 것이다. \q 그것이 큰일을 했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 내가 북쪽에서 온 군대를 너희에게서 멀리 쫓아내어, 메마르고 황폐한 땅으로 몰아내겠다. \q 그 선봉은 동쪽 바다로, \q 그 후미는 서쪽 바다로 몰아내겠다. \q 그 악취가 올라오고, 썩는 냄새가 진동할 것이다. \q 그들이 큰 해를 끼쳤기 때문이다.
ko.R: 내가 북쪽에서 온 군대를 너희에게서 멀리 쫓아내어, 메마르고 텅 빈 땅으로 몰아내겠다. \q 그들 가운데 일부는 동쪽의 사해로 들어가고, \q 나머지는 서쪽의 지중해로 들어갈 것이다. \q 그들의 시체가 썩어서 악취가 날 것이다. \q 그들이 그렇게 많은 해를 끼쳤기 때문이다.

am.L: ሰሜናዊውንም ከእናንተ አርቃለሁ፤ ወደ ደረቅና ባድማ ምድርም አባርረዋለሁ፤ \q ፊቱን ወደ ምሥራቁ ባሕር፣ \q ጀርባውንም ወደ ምዕራቡ ባሕር፤ \q ግማቱም ይወጣል፤ ክርፋቱም ይነሣል፤ \q ታላላቅ ነገሮችን አድርጓልና።
am.B: የሰሜኑን ሠራዊት ከእናንተ አርቄ ወደ ደረቅና ባድማ ምድር አባርረዋለሁ፤ \q ግንባር ቀደሙን ወደ ምሥራቁ ባሕር፣ \q ደጀኑንም ወደ ምዕራቡ ባሕር አስገባዋለሁ። \q ግማቱ ይወጣል፤ የበሰበሰ ሽታውም ይነሣል፤ \q ታላቅ ጉዳት አድርሷልና።
am.R: ከሰሜን የመጣውን ሠራዊት ከእናንተ አርቄ ወደ ደረቅና ባዶ ምድር አባርረዋለሁ። \q ከእነርሱ አንዳንዶቹ በምሥራቅ ወዳለው ወደ ሙት ባሕር ይገባሉ፤ \q የቀሩትም በምዕራብ ወዳለው ወደ ሜዲትራኒያን ባሕር ይገባሉ። \q ሬሳቸው ይበሰብሳል፤ ይገማልም። \q ይህም ስላደረሱት ጉዳት ሁሉ ነው።

hi.L: उत्तरवाले को मैं तुमसे दूर करूँगा और सूखे और उजाड़ देश में हाँक दूँगा, \q उसका अगला भाग पूर्वी समुद्र में, \q और उसका पिछला भाग पश्चिमी समुद्र में; \q उसकी दुर्गंध उठेगी, और उसकी सड़ाँध ऊपर जाएगी, \q क्योंकि उसने बड़े-बड़े काम किए हैं।
hi.B: मैं उत्तरी सेना को तुमसे दूर, सूखे और उजाड़ देश में हाँक दूँगा, \q उसकी अगली टुकड़ी को पूर्वी समुद्र में, \q और उसके पिछले भाग को पश्चिमी समुद्र में। \q उसकी दुर्गंध उठेगी; उसकी सड़ाँध ऊपर जाएगी, \q क्योंकि उसने बड़ी हानि की है।
hi.R: मैं उत्तर से आई सेना को तुमसे दूर, सूखे और सूने देश में भगा दूँगा। \q उसके कुछ सैनिक पूर्व में मृत सागर में जाएँगे, \q और बाक़ी पश्चिम में भूमध्य सागर में। \q उनकी लाशें सड़ेंगी और बदबू देंगी, \q क्योंकि उन्होंने बहुत हानि की है।

ru.L: И северного {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} удалю от вас и изгоню в землю сухую и пустынную, \q передний край его — в восточное море, \q и задний край его — в западное море; \q и поднимется его зловоние, и поднимется его смрад, \q потому что он сделал великое.
ru.B: Северное войско {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} прогоню далеко от вас, в сухую и пустынную землю, \q его передовые отряды — в восточное море, \q а задние — в западное море. \q Поднимется его зловоние, поднимется его смрад, \q потому что оно причинило великое зло.
ru.R: Войско, пришедшее с севера, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} прогоню далеко от вас, в сухую и пустую землю. \q Одни из них попадут в Мёртвое море на востоке, \q а остальные — в Средиземное море на западе. \q Их мёртвые тела будут гнить и смердеть \q за всё зло, которое они причинили.

ja.L: 北から来る者を、わたしはあなたがたから遠ざけ、乾いた荒れ果てた地に追いやる。 \q その前衛を東の海に、 \q その後衛を西の海に[追いやる]。 \q その悪臭は立ち上り、その腐臭は上る。 \q それが大いなることをしたからだ。
ja.B: わたしは北から来た軍勢を、あなたがたから遠くへ追い払い、乾いた荒れ果てた地に追いやる。 \q その先陣を東の海に、 \q その後陣を西の海に追い落とす。 \q その悪臭は立ち上り、腐った臭いが上る。 \q それが大きな害を行ったからだ。
ja.R: わたしは北から来た軍隊を、あなたたちから遠くへ追い払い、乾いた何もない地に追いやる。 \q その一部は東の死海に、 \q 残りは西の地中海に入る。 \q 彼らの死体は腐って、ひどい臭いを放つ。 \q 彼らが多くの害を行ったからだ。

decisions.choice: the northerner: the invading army, called by the name of the enemy from the north
alternatives: a human army from the north
decisions.reason: Invaders from Mesopotamia came into Israel from the north, and the prophets speak of the coming enemy as the one "from the north" (Jeremiah 1:14; 4:6; Ezekiel 38:6, 15). Locusts usually came from the south or east, so the name may be given to the locust army as the feared enemy of the prophets, or it may mean a human army that the locusts foreshadow.

decisions.choice: the eastern sea and the western sea: the Dead Sea and the Mediterranean
decisions.reason: These are the borders of the land to the east and west (Zechariah 14:8). The "dry and desolate land" between them is most likely the wilderness of Judah. Swarms of locusts driven by the wind into the sea die, and their bodies rot on the shore with a terrible smell; in Egypt a wind drove the locusts into the Red Sea (Exodus 10:19).

decisions.choice: for it has done great things: the enemy has acted proudly and done great harm
alternatives: the LORD has done great things
decisions.reason: The words are the same as in verse 21, where the LORD "has done great things". Here the subject is most likely the northerner: it has done great harm and acted proudly, and so it is destroyed. Some take the line with what follows, so that the LORD is the one who has done great things.

decisions.choice: the northern army (B); the army from the north (R); the Dead Sea, the Mediterranean Sea (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "army" (m1). Readable names the two seas (m2) and says "great harm" for the sense of "great things" here (m3), as Balanced does.

decisions.choice: "Celui du nord"; "sa tête ... sa queue" (L)
decisions.reason: French has no noun for "the northerner" that does not name a nationality, so Literal says "celui du nord"; "tête" and "queue" keep the Hebrew picture of the front and rear of the swarm, which Balanced says as an army's van and rear.

decisions.choice: "Al del norte"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's single word for the invader, "the northern one", without naming the army, as the English "the northerner".

decisions.choice: o que vem do norte (L)
decisions.reason: "Nortista" in Brazil names someone from the country's North region, so Literal says "o que vem do norte" for the northerner (m1); Balanced and Readable say "exército", as the English.

decisions.choice: "ታላላቅ ነገሮችን አድርጓልና" (L), the same words as the LORD's great deeds in 2:21
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets the enemy's "great things" against the LORD's in the next verse; Literal keeps one wording for both. Balanced and Readable say "great harm", as the English does.

decisions.choice: मृत सागर, भूमध्य सागर (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names the two seas (meaning decision m2), as the English Readable does; मृत सागर is the form Joshua 12:3 uses in this translation.

decisions.choice: Мёртвое море, Средиземное море
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, the two seas are named (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: hatstsefoni "北から来る者" (L), "北から来た軍勢" (B), "北から来た軍隊" (R); "東の海 / 西の海" (L, B), "東の死海 / 西の地中海" (R), as the English.
decisions.reason: The northerner is uncertain (m1); L keeps the bare word. L 2:20 "大いなることをした" and 2:21 "大いなることをなさった" keep the Hebrew echo.

source.text: אַל־תִּֽירְאִ֖י אֲדָמָ֑ה גִּ֣ילִי וּשְׂמָ֔חִי כִּֽי־הִגְדִּ֥יל יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not fear, land; be glad and rejoice, for Yahweh has done great things.

en.L: Do not fear, O land; \q be glad and rejoice, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has done great things.
en.B: Do not be afraid, O land! \q Be glad and rejoice, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has done great things!
en.R: Land, do not be afraid! \q Be glad and full of joy, \q because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has done great things.

pt.L: Não temas, ó terra; \q alegra-te e regozija-te, \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez grandes coisas.
pt.B: Não tenhas medo, ó terra! \q Alegra-te e exulta, \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez grandes coisas!
pt.R: Terra, não tenhas medo! \q Fica alegre e cheia de felicidade, \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez grandes coisas.

fr.L: Ne crains pas, ô terre ; \q sois dans l’allégresse et réjouis-toi, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait de grandes choses.
fr.B: N’aie pas peur, ô terre ! \q Sois dans la joie et réjouis-toi, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait de grandes choses !
fr.R: Terre, n’aie pas peur ! \q Sois heureuse et pleine de joie, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait de grandes choses.

es.L: No temas, oh tierra; \q alégrate y regocíjate, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho grandes cosas.
es.B: ¡No tengas miedo, tierra! \q ¡Alégrate y regocíjate, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho grandes cosas!
es.R: ¡Tierra, no tengas miedo! \q Ponte alegre y llena de gozo, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho grandes cosas.

sw.L: Usiogope, ee nchi; \q furahi na kushangilia, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amefanya mambo makubwa.
sw.B: Usiogope, ee nchi! \q Furahi na kushangilia, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amefanya mambo makubwa!
sw.R: Ewe nchi, usiogope! \q Furahi na ujae shangwe, \q kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amefanya mambo makubwa.

vi.L: Hỡi đất, đừng sợ; \q hãy hân hoan và vui mừng, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm những việc lớn.
vi.B: Hỡi đất, đừng sợ hãi! \q Hãy hân hoan và vui mừng, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm những việc lớn lao!
vi.R: Hỡi đất đai, đừng sợ! \q Hãy vui vẻ và tràn đầy niềm vui, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm những việc lớn lao.

ko.L: 땅아, 두려워하지 말아라. \q 기뻐하고 즐거워하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 큰일을 하셨다.
ko.B: 땅아, 두려워하지 말아라! \q 기뻐하고 즐거워하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 큰일을 하셨다!
ko.R: 땅아, 두려워하지 말아라! \q 기뻐하고 즐거워하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 큰일을 하셨다.

am.L: ምድር ሆይ፣ አትፍሪ፤ \q ደስ ይበልሽ፤ ሐሤትም አድርጊ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላላቅ ነገሮችን አድርጓልና።
am.B: ምድር ሆይ፣ አትፍሪ! \q ደስ ይበልሽ፤ ሐሤትም አድርጊ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላላቅ ነገሮችን አድርጓልና!
am.R: ምድር ሆይ፣ አትፍሪ! \q ደስ ይበልሽ፤ በደስታም ተሞዪ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላላቅ ነገሮችን አድርጓልና።

hi.L: हे भूमि, मत डरो; \q मगन हो और आनंद करो, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने बड़े-बड़े काम किए हैं।
hi.B: हे भूमि, मत डरो! \q मगन हो और आनंद मनाओ, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने बड़े-बड़े काम किए हैं!
hi.R: हे भूमि, मत डरो! \q ख़ुश हो और आनंद से भर जाओ, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने बड़े काम किए हैं।

ru.L: Не бойся, земля, \q радуйся и веселись, \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сделал великое.
ru.B: Не бойся, земля! \q Радуйся и веселись, \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} совершил великое!
ru.R: Земля, не бойся! \q Радуйся и веселись, \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сделал великие дела.

ja.L: 土地よ、恐れるな。 \q 喜び楽しめ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が大いなることをなさったからだ。
ja.B: 土地よ、恐れてはならない。 \q 喜び、楽しみなさい。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が大いなることをなさったのだ！
ja.R: 大地よ、恐れてはいけない。 \q 喜びなさい。うれしさでいっぱいになりなさい。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が大きなことをしてくださったのだ。

decisions.choice: the LORD has done great things: the answer to the enemy's great deeds
decisions.reason: The same words were used of the enemy at the end of verse 20. The LORD's great deeds overturn the enemy's. Psalm 126:2-3 uses the same words of the return from exile.

decisions.choice: land: the ground that mourned in 1:10
decisions.reason: The word is the same as "the ground" in 1:10, which "mourned". Now it is told to rejoice. Verse 22 speaks to the animals and verse 23 to the people, in the same order of loss as chapter 1.

decisions.choice: tú, feminine, to the land
decisions.reason: The land (Hebrew feminine) is addressed as one person with tú, and Spanish "tierra" is feminine too ("llena de gozo").

decisions.choice: tu to the land; vocês to the animals (verse 22) and the people (verse 23)
decisions.reason: The land is spoken to as one, so "tu"; the wild animals and the people of Zion are spoken to as groups, so "vocês" (m2).

decisions.choice: сделал великое
decisions.reason: Literal repeats the verb of verse 20, as the Hebrew does: the LORD's great deeds answer the enemy's.

decisions.choice: Prohibitions "恐れるな" (L), "恐れてはならない" (B), "恐れてはいけない" (R), the ISA convention.
decisions.reason: As the ISA notes.

source.text: אַל־תִּֽירְאוּ֙ בַּהֲמ֣וֹת שָׂדַ֔י כִּ֥י דָשְׁא֖וּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר כִּֽי־עֵץ֙ נָשָׂ֣א פִרְי֔וֹ תְּאֵנָ֥ה וָגֶ֖פֶן נָתְנ֥וּ חֵילָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not fear, animals of [the] field, for have become green [the] pastures of [the] wilderness; for [the] tree has borne its fruit; fig tree and vine have given their strength.

en.L: Do not fear, animals of the field, \q for the pastures of the wilderness have turned green; \q for the tree has borne its fruit; \q the fig tree and the vine have given their strength.
en.B: Do not be afraid, you wild animals, \q for the pastures in the wilderness are turning green. \q The trees are bearing their fruit; \q the fig tree and the vine give their full yield.
en.R: Wild animals, do not be afraid! \q The grasslands are turning green again. \q The trees are producing fruit. \q The fig trees and grapevines are loaded with fruit.

pt.L: Não temam, animais do campo, \q porque as pastagens do deserto reverdeceram; \q porque a árvore deu o seu fruto; \q a figueira e a videira deram a sua força.
pt.B: Não tenham medo, animais selvagens, \q porque as pastagens do deserto estão ficando verdes. \q As árvores estão dando os seus frutos; \q a figueira e a videira dão toda a sua colheita.
pt.R: Animais selvagens, não tenham medo! \q Os campos de pasto estão ficando verdes de novo. \q As árvores estão dando frutos. \q As figueiras e as parreiras estão carregadas de frutos.

fr.L: Ne craignez pas, bêtes des champs, \q car les pâturages du désert ont reverdi ; \q car l’arbre a porté son fruit ; \q le figuier et la vigne ont donné leur force.
fr.B: N’ayez pas peur, animaux sauvages, \q car les pâturages du désert reverdissent. \q Les arbres portent leurs fruits ; \q le figuier et la vigne donnent toute leur récolte.
fr.R: Animaux sauvages, n’ayez pas peur ! \q Les prairies redeviennent vertes. \q Les arbres produisent des fruits. \q Les figuiers et les vignes sont chargés de fruits.

es.L: No {{plural_you:teman|temáis}}, animales del campo, \q porque los pastos del desierto han reverdecido; \q porque el árbol ha dado su fruto; \q la higuera y la vid han dado su fuerza.
es.B: No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo, animales salvajes, \q porque los pastos del desierto reverdecen. \q Los árboles dan su fruto; \q la higuera y la vid dan su cosecha completa.
es.R: ¡Animales salvajes, no {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo! \q Los pastizales vuelven a ponerse verdes. \q Los árboles están dando fruto. \q Las higueras y las vides están cargadas de fruta.

sw.L: Msiogope, wanyama wa shambani, \q kwa maana malisho ya nyikani yamechipua majani mabichi; \q kwa maana mti umezaa matunda yake; \q mtini na mzabibu vimetoa nguvu zao.
sw.B: Msiogope, enyi wanyama wa porini, \q kwa maana malisho ya nyikani yanakuwa mabichi. \q Miti inazaa matunda yake; \q mtini na mzabibu vinatoa mavuno yao kamili.
sw.R: Enyi wanyama wa porini, msiogope! \q Nyanda za majani zinakuwa kijani tena. \q Miti inazaa matunda. \q Mitini na mizabibu imejaa matunda.

vi.L: Hỡi các thú đồng, đừng sợ, \q vì các đồng cỏ nơi hoang mạc đã xanh tươi; \q vì cây cối đã ra trái của nó; \q cây vả và cây nho đã sinh sức lực của chúng.
vi.B: Hỡi các loài thú hoang, đừng sợ hãi, \q vì các đồng cỏ nơi hoang mạc đang xanh tươi trở lại. \q Cây cối đang ra trái; \q cây vả và cây nho cho đầy hoa lợi.
vi.R: Hỡi các loài thú hoang, đừng sợ! \q Các đồng cỏ đang xanh tươi trở lại. \q Cây cối đang ra trái. \q Cây vả và cây nho trĩu nặng trái.

ko.L: 들의 짐승들아, 두려워하지 말아라. \q 광야의 목초지가 푸르러졌고, \q 나무가 그 열매를 맺었으며, \q 무화과나무와 포도나무가 그 힘을 다 내었다.
ko.B: 들짐승들아, 두려워하지 말아라. \q 광야의 풀밭이 푸르러지고 있다. \q 나무들이 열매를 맺고, \q 무화과나무와 포도나무가 열매를 가득 맺는다.
ko.R: 들짐승들아, 두려워하지 말아라! \q 풀밭이 다시 푸르러지고 있다. \q 나무마다 열매가 열린다. \q 무화과나무와 포도나무에 열매가 주렁주렁 달려 있다.

am.L: የሜዳ እንስሳት ሆይ፣ አትፍሩ፤ \q የምድረ በዳው መሰማሪያዎች ለምልመዋልና፤ \q ዛፉ ፍሬውን አፍርቷልና፤ \q በለስና ወይንም ኃይላቸውን ሰጥተዋል።
am.B: እናንተ የዱር አራዊት፣ አትፍሩ፤ \q በምድረ በዳ ያሉት መሰማሪያዎች እየለመለሙ ናቸው። \q ዛፎቹ ፍሬያቸውን እያፈሩ ናቸው፤ \q በለስና ወይንም ሙሉ ፍሬያቸውን ይሰጣሉ።
am.R: የዱር አራዊት ሆይ፣ አትፍሩ! \q የግጦሹ መሬት እንደ ገና እየለመለመ ነው። \q ዛፎቹ ፍሬ እያፈሩ ናቸው። \q በለሶቹና የወይን ተክሎቹ በፍሬ ተሞልተዋል።

hi.L: हे मैदान के पशुओ, मत डरो, \q क्योंकि निर्जन प्रदेश की चरागाहें हरी हो गई हैं; \q क्योंकि पेड़ ने अपना फल दिया है; \q अंजीर के पेड़ और दाखलता ने अपना बल दिया है।
hi.B: हे जंगली पशुओ, मत डरो, \q क्योंकि निर्जन प्रदेश की चरागाहें हरी हो रही हैं। \q पेड़ अपने फल ला रहे हैं; \q अंजीर और दाखलता भरपूर उपज दे रहे हैं।
hi.R: हे जंगली पशुओ, मत डरो! \q घास के मैदान फिर से हरे हो रहे हैं। \q पेड़ों पर फल लग रहे हैं। \q अंजीर के पेड़ और अंगूर की बेलें फलों से लदी हैं।

ru.L: Не бойтесь, животные поля, \q потому что зазеленели пастбища пустыни, \q потому что дерево принесло свой плод, \q смоковница и лоза отдали свою силу.
ru.B: Не бойтесь, дикие звери, \q потому что зеленеют пастбища в пустыне. \q Деревья приносят свои плоды, \q смоковница и виноградная лоза дают свой полный урожай.
ru.R: Дикие звери, не бойтесь! \q Пастбища снова зеленеют. \q Деревья приносят плоды. \q Смоковницы и виноградные лозы полны плодов.

ja.L: 野の獣たちよ、恐れるな。 \q 荒野の牧草地は青々となり、 \q 木はその実を結び、 \q いちじくの木とぶどうの木はその力を出したからだ。
ja.B: 野の獣たちよ、恐れてはならない。 \q 荒野の牧草地は緑になり、 \q 木々は実を結び、 \q いちじくの木もぶどうの木も豊かに実る。
ja.R: 野の動物たちよ、恐れてはいけない。 \q 草原は、また緑になってきている。 \q 木々は実をつけている。 \q いちじくの木もぶどうの木も、実がたくさんなっている。

decisions.choice: the losses of chapter 1 reversed
decisions.reason: The wild animals that longed for God (1:20), the burned pastures of the wilderness (1:19-20), and the fig tree and vine (1:7, 12) are each named again, now restored. The verbs describe what the LORD's promise has already begun.

decisions.choice: have given their strength: given their full yield
decisions.reason: The word for "strength" also means wealth or produce. The trees give all they can bear.

decisions.choice: wild animals (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:20, "animals of the field" are the wild animals.

source.text: וּבְנֵ֣י צִיּ֗וֹן גִּ֤ילוּ וְשִׂמְחוּ֙ בַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־נָתַ֥ן לָכֶ֛ם אֶת־הַמּוֹרֶ֖ה לִצְדָקָ֑ה וַיּ֣וֹרֶד לָכֶ֗ם גֶּ֛שֶׁם מוֹרֶ֥ה וּמַלְק֖וֹשׁ בָּרִאשֽׁוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And children of Zion, be glad and rejoice in Yahweh your God, for he has given to you the early rain for righteousness; and he has brought down for you rain, early rain and late rain, in the first.

en.L: Children of Zion, be glad and rejoice in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, \q for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given to you the early rain for righteousness; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has sent down rain for you, the early rain and the late rain, as before.
en.B: People of Zion, be glad; rejoice in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God! \q He has given you the autumn rain in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithfulness. \q He has poured down rain for you, the autumn rain and the spring rain, as before.
en.R: People of Zion, be glad! Rejoice in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God! \q He has given you the autumn rain because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is faithful to you. \q He has sent you plenty of rain, the autumn rain and the spring rain, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did before.

pt.L: Filhos de Sião, alegrem-se e regozijem-se {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deu a vocês a chuva temporã para retidão; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez descer para vocês a chuva, a chuva temporã e a chuva tardia, como antes.
pt.B: Povo de Sião, alegrem-se; regozijem-se {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}, o Deus de vocês! \q Ele deu a vocês a chuva de outono, na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} fidelidade. \q Fez cair para vocês muita chuva, a chuva de outono e a de primavera, como antes.
pt.R: Povo de Sião, fiquem alegres! Alegrem-se {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}, o Deus de vocês! \q Ele deu a vocês a chuva de outono, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é fiel a vocês. \q Mandou muita chuva para vocês, a chuva de outono e a chuva de primavera, como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fazia antes.

fr.L: Enfants de Sion, soyez dans l’allégresse et réjouissez-vous {{divine_name:dans le SEIGNEUR|en Yahvé}} votre Dieu, \q car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a donné la pluie précoce pour la justice ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait descendre pour vous la pluie, la pluie précoce et la pluie tardive, comme auparavant.
fr.B: Peuple de Sion, soyez dans la joie ; réjouissez-vous {{divine_name:dans le SEIGNEUR|en Yahvé}} votre Dieu ! \q Il vous a donné la pluie d’automne, dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fidélité. \q Il a fait tomber pour vous la pluie, la pluie d’automne et la pluie de printemps, comme autrefois.
fr.R: Peuple de Sion, soyez heureux ! Réjouissez-vous {{divine_name:dans le SEIGNEUR|en Yahvé}} votre Dieu ! \q Il vous a donné la pluie d’automne, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous est fidèle. \q Il vous a envoyé beaucoup de pluie, la pluie d’automne et la pluie de printemps, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le faisait autrefois.

es.L: Hijos de Sion, {{plural_you:alégrense|alegraos}} y {{plural_you:regocíjense|regocijaos}} en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, \q porque {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado la lluvia temprana para justicia; \q ha hecho descender para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} la lluvia, la lluvia temprana y la tardía, como antes.
es.B: Pueblo de Sion, {{plural_you:alégrense|alegraos}}; {{plural_you:regocíjense|regocijaos}} en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}. \q Él {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado la lluvia de otoño en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} fidelidad. \q Ha derramado lluvia para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, la lluvia de otoño y la de primavera, como antes.
es.R: ¡Pueblo de Sion, {{plural_you:alégrense|alegraos}}! ¡{{plural_you:Regocíjense|Regocijaos}} en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}! \q Él {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado la lluvia de otoño porque es fiel con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. \q {{plural_you:Les|Os}} ha enviado lluvia en abundancia, la lluvia de otoño y la de primavera, como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo hizo antes.

sw.L: Enyi wana wa Sayuni, furahini na kushangilia katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, \q kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} amewapa mvua ya vuli kwa haki; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} amewanyeshea mvua, mvua ya vuli na mvua ya masika, kama kwanza.
sw.B: Enyi watu wa Sayuni, furahini; shangilieni katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu! \q Amewapa mvua ya vuli kwa uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Amewanyeshea mvua tele, mvua ya vuli na mvua ya masika, kama hapo mwanzo.
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Sayuni, furahini! Shangilieni katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu! \q Amewapa mvua ya vuli kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mwaminifu kwenu. \q Amewaletea mvua nyingi, mvua ya vuli na ya masika, kama alivyofanya zamani.

vi.L: Hỡi con cái Si-ôn, hãy hân hoan và vui mừng trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho các ngươi mưa đầu mùa vì sự công chính; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cho mưa xuống cho các ngươi, mưa đầu mùa và mưa cuối mùa, như trước kia.
vi.B: Hỡi dân Si-ôn, hãy hân hoan; hãy vui mừng trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi! \q Ngài đã ban cho các ngươi mưa mùa thu vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thành tín. \q Ngài đã đổ mưa xuống cho các ngươi, mưa mùa thu và mưa mùa xuân, như trước kia.
vi.R: Hỡi dân Si-ôn, hãy vui mừng! Hãy vui mừng trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi! \q Ngài đã ban cho các ngươi mưa mùa thu vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thành tín với các ngươi. \q Ngài đã cho các ngươi mưa dồi dào, mưa mùa thu và mưa mùa xuân, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm trước kia.

ko.L: 시온의 자녀들아, 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 안에서 기뻐하고 즐거워하여라. \q 그분께서 너희에게 의를 따라 이른 비를 주셨고, \q 너희를 위하여 비를, 곧 이른 비와 늦은 비를 전처럼 내리셨다.
ko.B: 시온 백성아, 기뻐하여라. 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 안에서 즐거워하여라! \q 그분께서 신실하게 너희에게 가을비를 주셨다. \q 너희를 위하여 비를, 곧 가을비와 봄비를 전처럼 쏟아 주셨다.
ko.R: 시온 백성아, 기뻐하여라! 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 때문에 즐거워하여라! \q 그분은 너희에게 신실하셔서 가을비를 주셨다. \q 그분께서 전에 하셨던 것처럼 너희에게 비를 넉넉히 내려 주셨다. 가을비와 봄비를 내려 주셨다.

am.L: የጽዮን ልጆች ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} አምላካችሁ ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ ሐሤትም አድርጉ፤ \q የፊተኛውን ዝናብ ለጽድቅ ሰጥቷችኋልና፤ \q ዝናብንም፣ የፊተኛውንና የኋለኛውን ዝናብ፣ እንደ ቀድሞው አውርዶላችኋል።
am.B: የጽዮን ሕዝብ ሆይ፣ ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} አምላካችሁ ሐሤት አድርጉ! \q በታማኝነቱ የመጸውን ዝናብ ሰጥቷችኋል። \q የመጸውንና የበልጉን ዝናብ እንደ ቀድሞው አዝንቦላችኋል።
am.R: የጽዮን ሕዝብ ሆይ፣ ደስ ይበላችሁ! {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} አምላካችሁ ሐሤት አድርጉ! \q ለእናንተ ታማኝ ስለ ሆነ የመጸውን ዝናብ ሰጥቷችኋል። \q እንደ ቀድሞው ብዙ ዝናብ፣ የመጸውንና የበልጉን ዝናብ ልኮላችኋል።

hi.L: हे सिय्योन की सन्तान, अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} में मगन हो और आनंद करो, \q क्योंकि उन्होंने तुम्हें धार्मिकता के लिए पहली वर्षा दी है; \q उन्होंने तुम्हारे लिए वर्षा, पहली और पिछली वर्षा, पहले के समान बरसाई है।
hi.B: हे सिय्योन के लोगो, मगन हो; अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} में आनंद करो! \q उन्होंने अपनी विश्वासयोग्यता में तुम्हें शरद ऋतु की वर्षा दी है। \q उन्होंने तुम्हारे लिए वर्षा बरसाई है, शरद की और वसंत की वर्षा, पहले के समान।
hi.R: हे सिय्योन के लोगो, ख़ुश हो! अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} में आनंद करो! \q उन्होंने तुम्हें शरद ऋतु की वर्षा दी है, क्योंकि वे तुम्हारे प्रति विश्वासयोग्य हैं। \q उन्होंने तुम्हें भरपूर वर्षा दी है, शरद की और वसंत की वर्षा, जैसे पहले देते थे।

ru.L: И дети Сиона, радуйтесь и веселитесь о {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЕ|Яхве}}, вашем Боге, \q потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} дал вам ранний дождь по праведности; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} ниспослал вам дождь, ранний и поздний, как прежде.
ru.B: Жители Сиона, радуйтесь, веселитесь о {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЕ|Яхве}}, вашем Боге! \q Он дал вам осенний дождь по своей верности. \q Он излил на вас дождь, осенний и весенний, как прежде.
ru.R: Жители Сиона, радуйтесь! Веселитесь о {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЕ|Яхве}}, вашем Боге! \q Он дал вам осенний дождь, потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} верен вам. \q Он послал вам много дождя, осенний и весенний, как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} делал прежде.

ja.L: シオンの子らよ、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}によって喜び楽しめ。 \q その方は義にかなって、先の雨をあなたがたに与え、 \q あなたがたのために雨を降らせられた。先の雨と後の雨を、初めのように。
ja.B: シオンの人々よ、喜びなさい。あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}によって楽しみなさい。 \q その方は真実をもって、あなたがたに秋の雨を与えられた。 \q あなたがたに雨を降り注ぎ、以前のように秋の雨と春の雨を降らせてくださった。
ja.R: シオンの人々よ、喜びなさい！あなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を喜びなさい！ \q その方はあなたたちに真実なので、秋の雨を与えてくださった。 \q 以前のように、秋にも春にも、たくさんの雨を降らせてくださった。

decisions.choice: the early rain and the late rain: the autumn and spring rains on which the harvest depended
decisions.reason: The early rain came in autumn, softening the ground for plowing and sowing; the late rain came in spring and filled out the grain before harvest. Both are promised to a faithful people (Deuteronomy 11:14; Jeremiah 5:24; Hosea 6:3).

decisions.choice: for righteousness: given in the LORD's faithfulness, as a sign that he has put things right with his people
decisions.reason: The word is the usual word for righteousness. Here it most likely means the LORD's right and faithful dealing with his people, shown in sending the rain: the rain proves that he has turned to them again. It may also mean rain "in the right measure". The word for "early rain" can also mean "teacher", and the phrase has been read as "the teacher of righteousness", as in the Latin Vulgate; some think the community of the Dead Sea Scrolls drew its title "the Teacher of Righteousness" from this phrase or from Hosea 10:12. The rains named in the next line show that rain is meant here.

decisions.choice: as before: the Hebrew says "in the first"
decisions.reason: The phrase is short and can mean "at first", "as before", or "in the first month". The first month of the year, in spring, would suit the late rain but not the early rain, so it is read here as "as before", as in the past.

decisions.choice: autumn rain, spring rain (B, R); in his faithfulness (B); because he is faithful to you (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the seasons of the two rains (m1). For "for righteousness" they say what it means here, the LORD's faithful dealing with his people (m2). Literal keeps "for righteousness". "Children of Zion" means the people of Zion.

decisions.choice: "Enfants de Sion" (L), "Peuple de Sion" (B, R); "la pluie précoce ... tardive" (L), "d'automne ... de printemps" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Enfants" is the plain French for the people of a place and needs no gender setting; Balanced and Readable say "peuple", as daughter Zion is "le peuple de Sion" at Readable. Literal keeps the Hebrew's early and late rain; Balanced and Readable name the seasons, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "la lluvia temprana y la tardía" (L); "la lluvia de otoño y la de primavera" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As Deuteronomy 11:14 and Jeremiah 5:24 in Spanish.

decisions.choice: "Pueblo de Sion" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The children of Zion are its people; "Hijos de Sion" is kept at L, and includes women, so no gender span.

decisions.choice: "mvua ya vuli" and "mvua ya masika" at every level
decisions.reason: As Jeremiah 5:24: East African Swahili already names the two rainy seasons, the short rains (vuli) and the long rains (masika), so they render the early and late rains at every level, where the English Balanced and Readable say autumn and spring rain.

decisions.choice: "mưa đầu mùa", "mưa cuối mùa" (L); "mưa mùa thu", "mưa mùa xuân" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of the first and last rains of the year; Balanced and Readable name the seasons, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Hỡi con cái Si-ôn" (L); "Hỡi dân Si-ôn" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Children of Zion" are its people; Literal keeps "con cái", the others say "dân", as daughter Zion is "dân Si-ôn" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "이른 비, 늦은 비" (L); "가을비, 봄비" (B, R)
alternatives: "이른 비와 늦은 비" at every level
decisions.reason: The rains of autumn and spring, as the English Balanced and Readable say; Literal keeps the traditional pair.

decisions.choice: a chuva temporã e a chuva tardia (L); a chuva de outono e a de primavera (B, R)
decisions.reason: The two rains (m1) take the words of Deuteronomy 11:14 in Portuguese: the old names "temporã" and "tardia" at Literal, the seasons at Balanced and Readable, as the English.

decisions.choice: para retidão (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew word with "retidão", the word the prophets' Portuguese uses for this root, leaving "justiça" for mishpat; Balanced and Readable say what it means here (m2), as the English.

decisions.choice: the early and the late rain: "የፊተኛውና የኋለኛው ዝናብ" (L), "የመጸውና የበልጉ ዝናብ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As Deuteronomy 11:14 on main. The autumn and spring rains are the Ethiopian መጸው and በልግ, so Balanced and Readable name the seasons, as the English does.

decisions.choice: पहली और पिछली वर्षा, धार्मिकता के लिए (L); शरद और वसंत की वर्षा, अपनी विश्वासयोग्यता में (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew names of the two rains and "for righteousness"; Balanced and Readable name their seasons (meaning decision m1) and say what "for righteousness" means here, God's faithful dealing with his people (m2), as the English does.

decisions.choice: осенний и весенний дождь (B, R); ранний и поздний (L)
decisions.reason: The early and late rains are the autumn and spring rains (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable name the seasons, as the English.

decisions.choice: moreh / malqosh "先の雨と後の雨" (L), "秋の雨と春の雨" (B), "秋にも春にも" (R), as the Deuteronomy notes; litsdaqah "義にかなって" (L), "真実をもって" (B), "あなたたちに真実なので" (R), as the English.
alternatives: "義の教師" (the reading "teacher" for moreh, in the footnote)
decisions.reason: The sense is uncertain (m2); the English reading is followed.

source.text: וּמָלְא֥וּ הַגֳּרָנ֖וֹת בָּ֑ר וְהֵשִׁ֥יקוּ הַיְקָבִ֖ים תִּיר֥וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be full the threshing floors [of] grain, and will overflow the vats [with] new wine and fresh oil.

en.L: And the threshing floors will be filled with grain, \q and the vats will overflow with new wine and fresh oil.
en.B: The threshing floors will be heaped with grain; \q the vats will overflow with new wine and olive oil.
en.R: The threshing floors will be piled high with grain. \q The vats will overflow with new wine and olive oil.

pt.L: E as eiras se encherão de cereal, \q e os tanques transbordarão de vinho novo e de azeite fresco.
pt.B: As eiras ficarão cheias de cereal; \q os tanques dos lagares transbordarão de vinho novo e de azeite.
pt.R: As eiras vão ficar cheias de cereal amontoado. \q Os tanques dos lagares vão transbordar de vinho novo e de azeite.

fr.L: Et les aires seront remplies de grain, \q et les cuves déborderont de vin nouveau et d’huile fraîche.
fr.B: Les aires se couvriront de tas de grain ; \q les cuves déborderont de vin nouveau et d’huile d’olive.
fr.R: Sur les aires de battage, le grain s’entassera en hautes piles. \q Les cuves déborderont de vin nouveau et d’huile d’olive.

es.L: Y las eras se llenarán de grano, \q y los lagares rebosarán de mosto y aceite fresco.
es.B: Las eras se colmarán de grano; \q los lagares rebosarán de vino nuevo y aceite de oliva.
es.R: En las eras se amontonará el grano. \q Los lagares rebosarán de vino nuevo y aceite de oliva.

sw.L: Na viwanja vya kupuria vitajaa nafaka, \q na mashinikizo yatafurika divai mpya na mafuta mapya.
sw.B: Viwanja vya kupuria vitajaa nafaka; \q mashinikizo yatafurika divai mpya na mafuta ya zeituni.
sw.R: Viwanja vya kupuria vitajaa nafaka mpaka juu. \q Mashinikizo yatafurika divai mpya na mafuta ya zeituni.

vi.L: Và các sân đập lúa sẽ đầy ngũ cốc, \q và các bồn ép sẽ tràn rượu mới và dầu mới.
vi.B: Các sân đập lúa sẽ đầy ắp ngũ cốc; \q các bồn ép sẽ tràn đầy rượu mới và dầu ô-liu.
vi.R: Lúa sẽ chất cao trên các sân đập lúa. \q Các bồn ép sẽ tràn đầy rượu mới và dầu ô-liu.

ko.L: 타작마당들이 곡식으로 가득 차고, \q 포도주 통들이 새 포도주와 햇기름으로 넘칠 것이다.
ko.B: 타작마당에는 곡식이 수북이 쌓이고, \q 포도주 통에는 새 포도주와 올리브기름이 넘칠 것이다.
ko.R: 타작마당에 곡식이 높이 쌓일 것이다. \q 통마다 새 포도주와 올리브기름이 넘쳐흐를 것이다.

am.L: አውድማዎችም በእህል ይሞላሉ፤ \q ገንዳዎቹም በአዲስ የወይን ጠጅና በዘይት ይትረፈረፋሉ።
am.B: አውድማዎቹ በእህል ይከመራሉ፤ \q የመጭመቂያ ገንዳዎቹም በአዲስ የወይን ጠጅና በወይራ ዘይት ይትረፈረፋሉ።
am.R: አውድማዎቹ በእህል ክምር ይሞላሉ። \q የመጭመቂያ ገንዳዎቹም በአዲስ የወይን ጠጅና በወይራ ዘይት ይትረፈረፋሉ።

hi.L: और खलिहान अनाज से भर जाएँगे, \q और कुंड नए दाखमधु और ताज़े तेल से उमड़ पड़ेंगे।
hi.B: खलिहान अनाज के ढेरों से भर जाएँगे; \q कुंड नए दाखमधु और जैतून के तेल से उमड़ पड़ेंगे।
hi.R: खलिहानों में अनाज के ऊँचे ढेर लगेंगे। \q कुंड नए दाखमधु और जैतून के तेल से उमड़ पड़ेंगे।

ru.L: И наполнятся гумна зерном, \q и переполнятся чаны молодым вином и маслом.
ru.B: Гумна будут полны зерна, \q чаны переполнятся молодым вином и оливковым маслом.
ru.R: На гумнах будут высокие груды зерна. \q Чаны переполнятся молодым вином и оливковым маслом.

ja.L: 打ち場は穀物で満ち、 \q 酒ぶねは新しいぶどう酒と新しい油であふれる。
ja.B: 打ち場は穀物で山となり、 \q 酒ぶねは新しいぶどう酒とオリーブ油であふれる。
ja.R: 打ち場には、穀物が山のように積まれる。 \q 酒ぶねは、ぶどう酒とオリーブ油であふれる。

decisions.choice: threshing floors and vats: where the grain, wine and oil were gathered
decisions.reason: A threshing floor was a flat open place where grain was beaten out and winnowed. The vats were the basins below a winepress or olive press, into which the juice or oil ran.

decisions.choice: the vats will overflow: the same words return in 4:13
decisions.reason: Here the overflowing vats are the LORD's blessing on his people. In 4:13 the same words picture his judgment on the nations, as a winepress trodden full.

decisions.choice: os tanques (L); os tanques dos lagares (B, R)
decisions.reason: The vats are the basins below the press (m1). "Tanques" keeps them apart from the press itself, "lagar", which 4:13 names beside them; Balanced and Readable add "dos lagares" so the reader sees where they are. The same words return in 4:13 (m2).

decisions.choice: yeqavim as "ገንዳዎች" (L), "የመጭመቂያ ገንዳዎች" (B, R), and "ይትረፈረፋሉ" for "overflow", as in 4:13
decisions.reason: The vats are the basins under the press; "መጭመቂያ" alone is kept for the press itself (gat, 4:13). The same words return in 4:13 (the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: goren "打ち場", yeqev "酒ぶね" every level (Hosea 9:2), repeated in 4:13.
decisions.reason: As the HOS notes.

source.text: וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֤י לָכֶם֙ אֶת־הַשָּׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר֙ אָכַ֣ל הָֽאַרְבֶּ֔ה הַיֶּ֖לֶק וְהֶחָסִ֣יל וְהַגָּזָ֑ם חֵילִי֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר שִׁלַּ֖חְתִּי בָּכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will repay to you the years which has eaten the swarming locust, the hopping locust, and the stripping locust, and the cutting locust, my army the great which I sent among you.

en.L: And I will repay you for the years \q that the swarming locust has eaten, \q the hopping locust, the stripping locust, and the cutting locust, \q {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} great army, \q which I sent among you.
en.B: I will make up to you for the years \q that the swarming locust has eaten, \q the hopping locust, the stripping locust, and the cutting locust, \q {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} great army \q that I sent against you.
en.R: I will give back to you what you lost in the years \q when one swarm of locusts after another ate your crops. \q They were {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} great army, \q which I sent against you.

pt.L: E eu compensarei vocês pelos anos \q que o gafanhoto migrador comeu, \q o gafanhoto saltador, o gafanhoto devorador e o gafanhoto cortador, \q o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} grande exército, \q que enviei entre vocês.
pt.B: Eu vou compensar vocês pelos anos \q que o gafanhoto migrador comeu, \q o gafanhoto saltador, o gafanhoto devorador e o gafanhoto cortador, \q o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} grande exército \q que enviei contra vocês.
pt.R: Vou devolver a vocês o que vocês perderam nos anos \q em que um enxame de gafanhotos depois do outro comeu as suas colheitas. \q Eles eram o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} grande exército, \q que eu enviei contra vocês.

fr.L: Et je vous rendrai les années \q qu’a dévorées la sauterelle en essaim, \q la sauterelle qui bondit, la sauterelle qui dévaste et la sauterelle qui ronge, \q {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} grande armée, \q que j’ai envoyée parmi vous.
fr.B: Je vous dédommagerai des années \q que la sauterelle en essaim a dévorées, \q la sauterelle qui bondit, la sauterelle qui dévaste et la sauterelle qui ronge, \q {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} grande armée \q que j’ai envoyée contre vous.
fr.R: Je vous rendrai ce que vous avez perdu pendant les années \q où des nuées de sauterelles, l’une après l’autre, ont mangé vos récoltes. \q C’était {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} grande armée, \q que j’avais envoyée contre vous.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:les|os}} restituiré los años \q que comió la langosta migratoria, \q la langosta saltadora, la langosta devoradora y la langosta cortadora, \q {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gran ejército, \q que envié entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} compensaré por los años \q que devoró la langosta migratoria, \q la langosta saltadora, la langosta devoradora y la langosta cortadora, \q {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gran ejército \q que envié contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} devolveré lo que {{plural_you:perdieron|perdisteis}} en los años \q en que una nube de langostas tras otra se comió {{plural_you:sus cosechas|vuestras cosechas}}. \q Eran {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gran ejército, \q que envié contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

sw.L: Nami nitawalipa kwa ajili ya miaka \q ambayo nzige wa makundi wameila, \q nzige warukaji, nzige waharibifu na nzige wakataji, \q jeshi {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} kubwa, \q nililolituma kati yenu.
sw.B: Nitawalipa kwa ajili ya miaka \q ambayo nzige wa makundi wameila, \q nzige warukaji, nzige waharibifu na nzige wakataji, \q jeshi {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} kubwa \q nililolituma dhidi yenu.
sw.R: Nitawarudishia yale mliyopoteza katika miaka \q ambayo kundi moja la nzige baada ya jingine lilikula mazao yenu. \q Walikuwa jeshi {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} kubwa, \q nililolituma dhidi yenu.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đền bù cho các ngươi những năm \q mà châu chấu đàn đã ăn, \q châu chấu non, cào cào ăn trụi và châu chấu cắn phá, \q là đạo quân lớn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sai đến giữa các ngươi.
vi.B: Ta sẽ bù lại cho các ngươi những năm \q mà châu chấu đàn đã ăn mất, \q cùng châu chấu non, cào cào ăn trụi và châu chấu cắn phá, \q là đạo quân lớn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sai đến nghịch cùng các ngươi.
vi.R: Ta sẽ trả lại cho các ngươi những gì đã mất trong những năm \q hết đàn châu chấu này đến đàn châu chấu khác ăn sạch mùa màng các ngươi. \q Chúng là đạo quân lớn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sai đến nghịch cùng các ngươi.

ko.L: 내가 너희에게 그 해들을 갚아 주겠다. \q 떼 지어 다니는 메뚜기가 먹어 치운 해들, \q 뛰는 메뚜기와 갉아 먹는 메뚜기와 자르는 메뚜기가 [먹어 치운 해들이다]. \q 그것들은 나의 큰 군대, \q 내가 너희 가운데로 보낸 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 그 해들을 보상해 주겠다. \q 떼 지어 다니는 메뚜기가 먹어 치운 해들, \q 뛰는 메뚜기와 갉아 먹는 메뚜기와 자르는 메뚜기가 먹어 치운 해들이다. \q 그것들은 나의 큰 군대, \q 내가 너희를 치려고 보낸 군대였다.
ko.R: 메뚜기 떼가 잇달아 몰려와 너희 곡식을 먹어 치운 해들에 \q 너희가 잃은 것을 내가 돌려주겠다. \q 그 메뚜기 떼는 나의 큰 군대였다. \q 내가 너희를 치려고 보낸 것이었다.

am.L: ዓመታቱንም እመልስላችኋለሁ፤ \q አንበጣው የበላቸውን፣ \q ዘላዩ አንበጣ፣ ኩብኩባውና ቆራጩ አንበጣ [የበሏቸውን]፤ \q ታላቁ ሠራዊቴ፣ \q በመካከላችሁ የላክኩት።
am.B: ያጣችኋቸውን ዓመታት እክሳችኋለሁ፤ \q አንበጣው የበላቸውን፣ \q ዘላዩ አንበጣ፣ ኩብኩባውና ቆራጩ አንበጣ የበሏቸውን። \q እነርሱ ታላቁ ሠራዊቴ ናቸው፤ \q በእናንተ ላይ የላክኩት።
am.R: በእነዚያ ዓመታት ያጣችሁትን መልሼ እሰጣችኋለሁ፤ \q የአንበጣ መንጋ አንዱ ከሌላው ቀጥሎ ሰብላችሁን በበላበት ጊዜ። \q እነርሱ ታላቁ ሠራዊቴ ነበሩ፤ \q በእናንተ ላይ የላክኩት።

hi.L: और मैं उन वर्षों [की हानि] तुम्हें भर दूँगा \q जिन्हें झुंडवाली टिड्डी ने खाया है, \q फुदकनेवाली टिड्डी, नोचनेवाली टिड्डी और कुतरनेवाली टिड्डी ने, \q मेरी बड़ी सेना ने, \q जिसे मैंने तुम्हारे बीच भेजा।
hi.B: मैं तुम्हें उन वर्षों की भरपाई कर दूँगा \q जिनकी उपज झुंडवाली टिड्डी ने खा ली, \q और फुदकनेवाली टिड्डी, नोचनेवाली टिड्डी और कुतरनेवाली टिड्डी ने भी, \q मेरी बड़ी सेना ने, \q जिसे मैंने तुम्हारे विरुद्ध भेजा।
hi.R: उन वर्षों में तुम्हारा जो कुछ नष्ट हुआ, वह मैं तुम्हें लौटा दूँगा, \q जब टिड्डियों के दल पर दल तुम्हारी फ़सलें खा गए। \q वे मेरी बड़ी सेना थे, \q जिसे मैंने तुम्हारे विरुद्ध भेजा था।

ru.L: И возмещу вам годы, \q которые съела налетающая саранча, \q прыгающая саранча, пожирающая саранча и грызущая саранча, \q {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} великое войско, \q которое {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} послал на вас.
ru.B: Я возмещу вам годы, \q которые съела налетающая саранча, \q прыгающая саранча, пожирающая саранча и грызущая саранча, \q {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} великое войско, \q которое {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} послал против вас.
ru.R: Я верну вам то, что вы потеряли за те годы, \q когда одна стая саранчи за другой поедала ваш урожай. \q Это было {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} великое войско, \q которое {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} послал против вас.

ja.L: わたしはあなたがたに、年々[の損失]を償う。 \q それは群がるいなごが食べ、 \q 跳ねるいなご、食い荒らすいなご、かみつくいなごが[食べた年々]、 \q わたしの大いなる軍勢、 \q わたしがあなたがたの中に送ったものが[食べた年々だ]。
ja.B: わたしはあなたがたに、失われた年々を償う。 \q 群がるいなごが食い尽くし、 \q 跳ねるいなご、食い荒らすいなご、かみつくいなごが食い尽くした年々を。 \q それは、わたしの大いなる軍勢、 \q わたしがあなたがたに向けて送ったものだ。
ja.R: わたしは、あなたたちが失った年々のものを、あなたたちに返す。 \q そのころ、いなごの群れが次から次へとやって来て、あなたたちの作物を食べた。 \q それは、わたしの大きな軍隊であり、 \q わたしがあなたたちに向けて送ったものだ。

decisions.choice: the four locusts of 1:4, named in a different order
alternatives: four stages in the growth of one kind of locust
decisions.reason: The same four names as in 1:4 come here in a different order: swarming, hopping, stripping, cutting. Whether they are kinds or stages of locust is uncertain (see 1:4); the change of order suggests that they are four names for one plague.

decisions.choice: I will repay you for the years: make good the loss
decisions.reason: The verb is used of paying back what is owed or making good a loss (Exodus 22:4-5). "The years" suggests that the damage lasted more than one season. The LORD will make up for every lost harvest.

decisions.choice: my great army, which I sent: the LORD sent the locusts
decisions.reason: The LORD owns the disaster as his own act of judgment (2:11). The one who sent it is the one who now repays.

decisions.choice: the locust names as in 1:4 (L, B); one swarm of locusts after another (R)
decisions.reason: The names follow 1:4 at Literal and Balanced, in the order this verse gives them. Readable uses the phrase set for these names. "Against you" at Balanced and Readable says the sense of "among you": the army was sent as judgment.

decisions.choice: "la sauterelle en essaim, la sauterelle qui bondit, la sauterelle qui dévaste, la sauterelle qui ronge" (L, B); "des nuées de sauterelles, l'une après l'autre" (R)
decisions.reason: The French names of the four locusts of 1:4, here in this verse's order; each describes what the insect does, since it is unsure whether the Hebrew names are kinds or stages of locust. Readable says one swarm after another, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "la langosta migratoria, la langosta saltadora, la langosta devoradora y la langosta cortadora" (L, B); "una nube de langostas tras otra" (R)
decisions.reason: The four names as the terms note sets them for 1:4, here in the Hebrew's new order (arbeh, yeleq, chasil, gazam). "Migratoria" for the common swarming locust is a first choice for a native reviewer.

decisions.choice: "nzige wa makundi, nzige warukaji, nzige waharibifu, nzige wakataji" (L, B); "kundi moja la nzige baada ya jingine" (R)
decisions.reason: The four locust names of 1:4, here in the Hebrew's different order, worded from what each name describes (cutting, swarming, hopping, stripping) and kept clear of the Union Version's names. Whether they are kinds or stages of locust is not known.

decisions.choice: "châu chấu đàn, châu chấu non, cào cào ăn trụi và châu chấu cắn phá" (L, B); "hết đàn châu chấu này đến đàn châu chấu khác" (R)
decisions.reason: The four locust names of 1:4, in the order of this verse, take the terms-sheet wording ("châu chấu non" as Psalm 105:34, "cào cào ăn trụi" as 1 Kings 8:37); Readable gives the sense, one swarm after another, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: The four locust names as in 1:4: "자르는 메뚜기, 떼 지어 다니는 메뚜기, 뛰는 메뚜기, 갉아 먹는 메뚜기" (L, B), here in the Hebrew's order; "메뚜기 떼가 잇달아" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's names for Joel's locusts; Readable says "one swarm after another", as the English does.

decisions.choice: the four locust names of 1:4, in this verse's order
decisions.reason: The names keep the Portuguese set in 1:4 ("migrador, saltador, devorador, cortador"), in the order this verse gives them; Readable keeps its phrase "um enxame de gafanhotos depois do outro". "Compensar" says making good a loss (m2).

decisions.choice: the four locust names as in 1:4: "አንበጣ", "ዘላይ አንበጣ", "ኩብኩባ", "ቆራጭ አንበጣ", in the Hebrew order of this verse
decisions.reason: The four are named again in a different order (the meaning decision); each keeps its Amharic word from 1:4. Readable says "one swarm after another", as in 1:4.

decisions.choice: the locust names of 1:4 (L, B); टिड्डियों के दल पर दल (R)
decisions.reason: The four locusts of 1:4 return in another order (meaning decision m1); Literal and Balanced use the names settled there, in this verse's order, and Readable the phrase set there.

decisions.choice: the four locust names of 1:4, in this verse's order
decisions.reason: The names keep their wording from 1:4 (налетающая, прыгающая, пожирающая, грызущая саранча at L and B; one swarm after another at R).

decisions.choice: The four locust words in the forms of 1:4 (L, B), in this verse's order: "群がるいなご、跳ねるいなご、食い荒らすいなご、かみつくいなご"; R "いなごの群れが次から次へと" as 1:4 R.
decisions.reason: Fixed forms let the reader see the same four names in a new order (m1).

source.text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אָכוֹל֙ וְשָׂב֔וֹעַ וְהִלַּלְתֶּ֗ם אֶת־שֵׁ֤ם יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֥ה עִמָּכֶ֖ם לְהַפְלִ֑יא וְלֹא־יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ עַמִּ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will eat, eating and being satisfied, and you will praise the name of Yahweh your God, who has dealt with you wonderfully; and will not be ashamed my people forever.

en.L: You will eat abundantly and be satisfied, \q and will praise the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, \q who has acted wondrously with you; \q and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people will never be put to shame.
en.B: You will eat your fill and be satisfied, \q and you will praise the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, \q the one who has worked wonders for you. \q Never again will {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people be put to shame.
en.R: You will have all the food you want, \q and you will praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, \q because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done amazing things for you. \q My people will never again be ashamed.

pt.L: Vocês comerão fartamente e ficarão saciados, \q e louvarão o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, \q que agiu maravilhosamente com vocês; \q e o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo nunca será envergonhado.
pt.B: Vocês comerão à vontade e ficarão satisfeitos, \q e louvarão o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, \q aquele que fez maravilhas por vocês. \q Nunca mais o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo será envergonhado.
pt.R: Vocês vão ter toda a comida que quiserem, \q e vão louvar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez coisas maravilhosas por vocês. \q O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo nunca mais vai passar vergonha.

fr.L: Vous mangerez abondamment et serez rassasiés, \q et vous louerez le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu, \q qui a agi avec vous de façon merveilleuse ; \q et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple ne sera jamais plus couvert de honte.
fr.B: Vous mangerez à votre faim et vous serez rassasiés, \q et vous louerez le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu, \q qui a fait pour vous des merveilles. \q Jamais plus {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple ne sera couvert de honte.
fr.R: Vous aurez toute la nourriture que vous voudrez, \q et vous louerez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, \q car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait pour vous des choses extraordinaires. \q Mon peuple n’aura plus jamais honte.

es.L: {{plural_you:Comerán|Comeréis}} en abundancia y {{plural_you:se saciarán|os saciaréis}}, \q y {{plural_you:alabarán|alabaréis}} el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, \q que ha obrado maravillas con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; \q y nunca jamás será avergonzado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Comerán|Comeréis}} hasta {{plural_you:saciarse|saciaros}}, \q y {{plural_you:alabarán|alabaréis}} el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, \q que ha hecho maravillas por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. \q Nunca más será avergonzado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Tendrán|Tendréis}} toda la comida que {{plural_you:quieran|queráis}}, \q y {{plural_you:alabarán|alabaréis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho cosas asombrosas por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. \q Mi pueblo nunca más quedará en vergüenza.

sw.L: Nanyi mtakula kwa wingi na kushiba, \q na mtalisifu jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, \q aliyetenda nanyi kwa ajabu; \q na watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hawataaibika kamwe.
sw.B: Mtakula mpaka mshibe, \q nanyi mtalisifu jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliyewatendea maajabu. \q Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hawataaibishwa tena kamwe.
sw.R: Mtakuwa na chakula chote mnachotaka, \q nanyi mtamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, \q kwa sababu amewatendea mambo ya ajabu. \q Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hawataona aibu tena kamwe.

vi.L: Các ngươi sẽ ăn uống dư dật và được no nê, \q và sẽ ca ngợi danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, \q Đấng đã đối xử kỳ diệu với các ngươi; \q và dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chẳng bao giờ bị hổ thẹn.
vi.B: Các ngươi sẽ ăn no nê thỏa thích, \q và các ngươi sẽ ca ngợi danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, \q Đấng đã làm những việc kỳ diệu cho các ngươi. \q Dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không bao giờ còn bị hổ thẹn nữa.
vi.R: Các ngươi sẽ có thức ăn đầy đủ như ý muốn, \q và các ngươi sẽ ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm những việc lạ lùng cho các ngươi. \q Dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không bao giờ còn phải xấu hổ nữa.

ko.L: 너희가 먹고 또 먹어 배부를 것이며, \q 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 찬양할 것이다. \q 그분께서 너희에게 놀라운 일을 행하셨다. \q 내 백성은 영원히 수치를 당하지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 너희가 마음껏 먹고 배부를 것이며, \q 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 찬양할 것이다. \q 그분은 너희를 위하여 놀라운 일을 하신 분이다. \q 내 백성이 다시는 수치를 당하지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 너희는 먹을 것이 넉넉하여 배부를 것이다. \q 너희는 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양할 것이다. \q 그분께서 너희를 위하여 놀라운 일을 하셨기 때문이다. \q 내 백성은 다시는 부끄러움을 당하지 않을 것이다.

am.L: በብዛት ትበላላችሁ፤ ትጠግባላችሁም፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} አምላካችሁንም ስም ታመሰግናላችሁ፤ \q ከእናንተ ጋር በድንቅ የሠራውን፤ \q ሕዝቤም ለዘላለም አያፍርም።
am.B: እስክትጠግቡ ትበላላችሁ፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} አምላካችሁንም ስም ታመሰግናላችሁ፤ \q ለእናንተ ድንቅ ነገሮችን ያደረገውን። \q ከእንግዲህ ሕዝቤ ፈጽሞ አያፍርም።
am.R: የምትፈልጉትን ምግብ ሁሉ ታገኛላችሁ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አምላካችሁን ታመሰግናላችሁ፤ \q ለእናንተ አስደናቂ ነገሮችን አድርጓልና። \q ሕዝቤ ከእንግዲህ ፈጽሞ አያፍርም።

hi.L: तुम भरपेट खाओगे और तृप्त होगे, \q और अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम की स्तुति करोगे, \q जिन्होंने तुम्हारे साथ अद्भुत काम किए हैं; \q और मेरी प्रजा फिर कभी लज्जित न होगी।
hi.B: तुम पेट भर खाओगे और तृप्त होगे, \q और अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम की स्तुति करोगे, \q जिन्होंने तुम्हारे लिए अद्भुत काम किए हैं। \q मेरी प्रजा फिर कभी लज्जित नहीं होगी।
hi.R: तुम्हारे पास जितना चाहो उतना भोजन होगा, \q और तुम अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करोगे, \q क्योंकि उन्होंने तुम्हारे लिए अद्भुत काम किए हैं। \q मेरी प्रजा फिर कभी शर्मिंदा नहीं होगी।

ru.L: И будете есть, есть досыта, \q и восхвалите имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, вашего Бога, \q который поступил с вами чудесно; \q и не будет посрамлён {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ вовеки.
ru.B: Вы будете есть досыта и насыщаться \q и восхвалите имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, вашего Бога, \q который совершил для вас чудеса. \q Никогда больше {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ не будет посрамлён.
ru.R: У вас будет вся еда, какую вы захотите, \q и вы будете хвалить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, вашего Бога, \q потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сделал для вас удивительные дела. \q Мой народ больше никогда не будет опозорен.

ja.L: あなたがたは食べに食べて満ち足り、 \q あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名をほめたたえる。 \q あなたがたに驚くべきことを行った[神の名を]。 \q わたしの民は、とこしえに恥を見ることがない。
ja.B: あなたがたは食べ飽きるほど食べて満ち足り、 \q あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名をたたえる。 \q あなたがたのために不思議な業を行った方の名を。 \q わたしの民は、二度と恥を見ることがない。
ja.R: あなたたちは、食べたいだけ食べられるようになる。 \q そして、あなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を賛美する。 \q その神が、あなたたちのために驚くようなことをしたからだ。 \q わたしの民は、二度と恥ずかしい思いをすることはない。

decisions.choice: you will eat and be satisfied and praise: as Moses promised
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 8:10 says: "You will eat and be satisfied, and you will bless the LORD your God for the good land he has given you." The doubled verbs ("eat, eating") stress the abundance.

decisions.choice: be put to shame: be disgraced and disappointed
decisions.reason: This is the verb used of the farmers in 1:11 ("be ashamed") and the joy that "dried up" in 1:12. What the people suffered then will not happen again.

decisions.choice: forever: never again
decisions.reason: With "not", the phrase means "never". The promise is repeated at the end of verse 27.

decisions.choice: praise the LORD your God (R)
decisions.reason: "The name" of the LORD stands for the LORD himself; Readable says "praise the LORD".

decisions.choice: "그분께서 … 행하셨다" with -시- inside God's speech
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns to the third person ("who has dealt with you"), as the people's praise; Korean gives the honorific there, while God's first person ("내 백성") stays without it.

decisions.choice: The LORD speaks of himself in the third person without respect forms ("行った", "した"), as Amos 4:11.
decisions.reason: God does not honour himself in his own speech (ISA, AMO notes).

source.text: וִידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּ֣י בְקֶ֤רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אָ֔נִי וַאֲנִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם וְאֵ֣ין ע֑וֹד וְלֹא־יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ עַמִּ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And you will know that in [the] midst of Israel [am] I, and I [am] Yahweh your God, and there is no other; and will not be ashamed my people forever.

en.L: And you will know that in the midst of Israel [am] I, \q and I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and there is no other; \q and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people will never be put to shame.
en.B: Then you will know that I am in the midst of Israel, \q that I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, am your God, and there is no other. \q Never again will {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people be put to shame.
en.R: Then you will know that I live among the people of Israel. \q You will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. There is no other God. \q My people will never again be ashamed.

pt.L: E vocês saberão que no meio de Israel [estou] eu, \q e eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, e não há outro; \q e o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo nunca será envergonhado.
pt.B: Então vocês saberão que eu estou no meio de Israel, \q que eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, sou o Deus de vocês, e não há outro. \q Nunca mais o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo será envergonhado.
pt.R: Então vocês vão saber que eu vivo no meio do povo de Israel. \q Vão saber que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês. Não existe outro Deus. \q O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo nunca mais vai passar vergonha.

fr.L: Et vous saurez qu’au milieu d’Israël [je suis], {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, \q et que {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, et il n’y en a pas d’autre ; \q et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple ne sera jamais plus couvert de honte.
fr.B: Alors vous saurez que je suis au milieu d’Israël, \q que {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je suis votre Dieu, et qu’il n’y en a pas d’autre. \q Jamais plus {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple ne sera couvert de honte.
fr.R: Alors vous saurez que je vis au milieu du peuple d’Israël. \q Vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu. Il n’y a pas d’autre Dieu. \q Mon peuple n’aura plus jamais honte.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que en medio de Israel [estoy] yo, \q y [que] yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, y no hay otro; \q y nunca jamás será avergonzado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo.
es.B: Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo estoy en medio de Israel, \q que yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, soy {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, y no hay otro. \q Nunca más será avergonzado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo.
es.R: Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo vivo en medio del pueblo de Israel. \q {{plural_you:Sabrán|Sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}. No hay otro Dios. \q Mi pueblo nunca más quedará en vergüenza.

sw.L: Nanyi mtajua kwamba katikati ya Israeli [niko] {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, \q na kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, wala hakuna mwingine; \q na watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hawataaibika kamwe.
sw.B: Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niko katikati ya Israeli, \q kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ndimi Mungu wenu, wala hakuna mwingine. \q Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hawataaibishwa tena kamwe.
sw.R: Ndipo mtajua kwamba ninaishi kati ya watu wa Israeli. \q Mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu. Hakuna Mungu mwingine. \q Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hawataona aibu tena kamwe.

vi.L: Và các ngươi sẽ biết rằng ở giữa Y-sơ-ra-ên [có] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, và không có ai khác; \q và dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chẳng bao giờ bị hổ thẹn.
vi.B: Bấy giờ các ngươi sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở giữa Y-sơ-ra-ên, \q rằng chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, và không có ai khác. \q Dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không bao giờ còn bị hổ thẹn nữa.
vi.R: Khi ấy các ngươi sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sống giữa dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. \q Các ngươi sẽ biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi. Không có Đức Chúa Trời nào khác. \q Dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không bao giờ còn phải xấu hổ nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 너희는 내가 이스라엘 가운데 있고, \q 내가 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이며 다른 이가 없음을 알 것이다. \q 내 백성은 영원히 수치를 당하지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그때에 너희는 내가 이스라엘 가운데 있다는 것과, \q 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 너희 하나님이며 다른 신은 없다는 것을 알게 될 것이다. \q 내 백성이 다시는 수치를 당하지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 너희는 내가 이스라엘 백성 가운데 산다는 것을 알게 될 것이다. \q 내가 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이고, 다른 신은 없다는 것을 알게 될 것이다. \q 내 백성은 다시는 부끄러움을 당하지 않을 것이다.

am.L: እኔ በእስራኤል መካከል እንዳለሁ ታውቃላችሁ፤ \q እኔም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላካችሁ እንደ ሆንኩ፣ ሌላም እንደሌለ፤ \q ሕዝቤም ለዘላለም አያፍርም።
am.B: ያን ጊዜ እኔ በእስራኤል መካከል እንዳለሁ፣ \q እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላካችሁ እንደ ሆንኩ፣ ሌላም እንደሌለ ታውቃላችሁ። \q ከእንግዲህ ሕዝቤ ፈጽሞ አያፍርም።
am.R: ያን ጊዜ እኔ በእስራኤል ሕዝብ መካከል እንደምኖር ታውቃላችሁ። \q እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላካችሁ እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቃላችሁ። ሌላ አምላክ የለም። \q ሕዝቤ ከእንግዲህ ፈጽሞ አያፍርም።

hi.L: और तुम जानोगे कि इस्राएल के बीच में मैं [हूँ], \q और मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर [हूँ], और दूसरा कोई नहीं; \q और मेरी प्रजा फिर कभी लज्जित न होगी।
hi.B: तब तुम जानोगे कि मैं इस्राएल के बीच में हूँ, \q कि मैं, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तुम्हारा परमेश्वर हूँ, और दूसरा कोई नहीं। \q मेरी प्रजा फिर कभी लज्जित नहीं होगी।
hi.R: तब तुम जानोगे कि मैं इस्राएल के लोगों के बीच रहता हूँ। \q तुम जानोगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर हूँ। मेरे सिवा कोई दूसरा परमेश्वर नहीं। \q मेरी प्रजा फिर कभी शर्मिंदा नहीं होगी।

ru.L: И узнаете, что посреди Израиля — {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, и нет иного; \q и не будет посрамлён {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ вовеки.
ru.B: Тогда вы узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посреди Израиля, \q что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — ваш Бог, и нет иного. \q Никогда больше {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ не будет посрамлён.
ru.R: Тогда вы узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} живу среди народа Израиля. \q Вы узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог. Нет другого Бога. \q Мой народ больше никогда не будет опозорен.

ja.L: そして、あなたがたは知る。わたしがイスラエルのただ中にいること、 \q わたしがあなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であって、ほかにはいないことを。 \q わたしの民は、とこしえに恥を見ることがない。
ja.B: そのとき、あなたがたは知る。わたしがイスラエルのただ中にいること、 \q わたし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたがたの神であり、ほかにはいないことを。 \q わたしの民は、二度と恥を見ることがない。
ja.R: そのとき、あなたたちは知る。わたしがイスラエルの人々の中に住んでいることを。 \q わたしが、あなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを。ほかに神はいない。 \q わたしの民は、二度と恥ずかしい思いをすることはない。

decisions.choice: you will know that I am the LORD your God: the knowledge of God that his acts bring
decisions.reason: The LORD's acts make him known (Exodus 6:7; 29:45-46, where he dwells among his people). Ezekiel uses the same kind of words more than sixty times. "There is no other" is the confession of Deuteronomy 4:35 and Isaiah 45:5-6, 18.

decisions.choice: the last line repeats verse 26
decisions.reason: The repeated promise closes the LORD's answer to the people's lament.

decisions.choice: live among the people of Israel; no other God (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "live among" for "in the midst of" and supplies "God" to make "there is no other" plain.

decisions.choice: "sabrán / sabréis que ..."
decisions.reason: "You will know" follows the Ezekiel formula of the terms note, with plural_you, and B and R "Entonces".

decisions.choice: "các ngươi sẽ biết rằng" (L); "Bấy giờ các ngươi sẽ biết rằng" (B); "Khi ấy các ngươi sẽ biết" (R)
decisions.reason: The knowledge formula keeps the wording settled for Ezekiel's "you will know that I am the LORD" at each level, so the same promise reads the same across the prophets.

decisions.choice: "እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቃላችሁ" for "you will know that I am the LORD your God", here and in 4:17
decisions.reason: The recognition formula as the Ezekiel list sets it; the last line repeats verse 26 in each level's own wording.
